data.description: A bizarre humanoid creature with a calculating stare.  Its twitching hands move so fast they appear to be nothing but blurs.

data.name: groundhog
data.description: Also known as the woodchuck, this ground squirrel has no actual talent for chucking wood.

data.name: half worm
data.description: A squiggling severed portion of a wounded giant worm.

data.name: your mother
data.description: Mom?

data.name: evil multi-cooker
data.description: The multi-cooker's got a mind of its own!  Look out!!

data.name: jackrabbit
data.description: The snowshoe hare, a small grass-eater with a brown fur coat that changes to white in the wintertime.

data.name: cleaner bot
data.description: The Ford Sanitron, a utility robot designed for cleaning up waste material in hazardous conditions.

data.name: tentacle dog
data.description: A dog's body with a mass of ropey, black tentacles reaching out from its head.

data.name: homunculus
data.description: A pale hairless man with an impressive athletic physique.  Its lidless eyes are totally black, and seeping with blood.

data.name: horse
data.description: A hooved grazing mammal with a mane of hair, a sweeping tail, and powerful-looking muscles.

data.name: human snail
data.description: An enormous fleshy snail, with an oddly human face.  Eyestalks protrude from where the eyes should be.

data.name: hunting horror
data.description: A man-sized worm-like creature that swoops around on bat-like wings.  Its form dramatically shifts and changes from moment to moment, although its gigantic eyes and teeth are always prominent.

data.name: irradiated wanderer
data.description: This rotting corpse seeps a glowing ooze from its lesions.  A strange tattered jumpsuit marks it as an oddity across the wasteland.

data.name: irradiated wanderer
data.description: This rotting corpse seeps a glowing ooze from its lesions.  A strange tattered jumpsuit marks it as an oddity across the wasteland.

data.name: irradiated wanderer
data.description: This rotting corpse seeps a glowing ooze from its lesions.  A strange tattered jumpsuit marks it as an oddity across the wasteland.

data.name: irradiated wanderer
data.description: This rotting corpse seeps a glowing ooze from its lesions.  A strange tattered jumpsuit marks it as an oddity across the wasteland.

data.name: jabberwock
data.description: A putrid amalgamation of body parts from humans and other creatures have fused together in this aberration of flesh.  The eyes of all the heads dart about rapidly and the mouths form a chorus of groaning screams.

data.name: kreck
data.description: A fat humanoid the size of a dog, with twisted red flesh and a distended neck.  It scampers around, panting and grunting.

data.name: lemming
data.description: The Northern bog lemming, a small, predominantly vegetarian rodent that spends its life in the murk of swamps and other wetlands.  Contrary to popular belief, these creatures are not particularly hapless or suicidal, but they can eat themselves into scarcity within a few generations.

data.name: mi-go
data.description: A flexuous monstrosity seeming as a giant crab covered in writhing antennae, clawed tentacles, and star-shaped growths, with a head like the insides of a fish but for its dire utterance.

data.name: mink
data.description: The American mink, a partially-aquatic weasel, once factory-farmed for its fur.  It is a capable fisher, but the presence of otters in these parts makes it rely more on food from the land.

data.name: miner bot
data.description: A snake-like, segmented robot built to tunnel into the ground and detonate landmines.

data.name: moose
data.description: The Eastern moose, the largest living species of deer.  The bulls are quite ill-tempered, especially in the rutting season.

data.name: giant mosquito
data.description: An enormous mutant mosquito, fluttering erratically.  Its face is dominated by a long, spear-tipped proboscis.

data.name: muskrat
data.description: A large omnivorous rodent with a thick furry pelt, found in wetlands across the northern hemisphere.  It marks its territory with a musky odor for which it is named.

data.name: cyclopean
data.description: A relatively humanoid mutant with purple hair and a grapefruit-sized bloodshot eye.

data.name: opossum
data.description: The Virginia opossum, a small omnivorous marsupial native to North America.  About the size of a cat, it is hardy and adaptive, and a fairly common sight in urban areas.

data.name: otter
data.description: The North American river otter is a shy water dwelling relative of the weasel living in large families along the banks of streams.  It is an excellent fisher and a resourceful survivor, using the abandoned dens of beavers and other animals to raise its own young.

data.name: pig
data.description: A domesticated omnivore descended from the wild boar, intelligent and inquisitive.  Left to its own devices, it has gone feral.

data.name: slimespring
data.description: A familiar-looking blob of goo.  It sprouts the occasional eyestalk.

data.name: pregnant giant cockroach
data.description: A mutant cockroach the size of a small dog.  It's abdomen is heavily swollen.

data.name: rabbit
data.description: A small mammal with a cute wiggling nose, cotton tail, and made of delicious flesh.

data.name: raccoon
data.description: A small mammal native to North America, distinctive for its dexterous paws and facial markings.  It is resourceful and agile enough to open sealed containers with its paws.

data.name: rat king
data.description: A towering swarm of mutated rats, their tails knotted together in a filthy mass.  A fetid stench flows from its filthy presence.

data.name: rattlesnake
data.description: The timber rattlesnake is the most venomous viper native to New England.  Climatic changes have extended its range far into the north.

data.name: giant rattlesnake
data.description: A mutated timber rattlesnake, about three times as large as the norm.  While it isn't big enough to regard humans as potential prey, it is more aggresive and dangerous compared to a normal rattler.

data.name: razorclaw
data.description: A man-sized crustacean clad in an iron-like chitin, capable of emitting the most horrible of shrieks.  Often spotted near shipwrecks or other dark damp places, which it uses as nesting grounds.

data.name: riot control bot
data.description: Nonviolent riot-control bot.  Designed to suppress riots and make mass arrests of those participating.  Though its relaxation gas is by far its best-known weapon, it carries a blinding flash and a low-powered stungun for self-defense--in addition to its supply of electronic handcuffs.

data.name: seweranha
data.description: A large mutant variety of carp.  It has shimmering green scales and a mouth lined with three jagged rows of razor-sharp teeth.

data.name: sewer rat
data.description: A worm-tailed rodent with long whiskers and beady eyes.  The way it squeaks makes it sound...  hungry.

data.name: sewer snake
data.description: An aggressive mutant variety of the worm snake, turned pale yellow from its underground life.  It swarms beneath the ground and is named for its habit of infesting sewer lines.

data.name: shadow
data.description: A strange moving darkness, bringing with it the softest of whispers.

data.name: shadow snake
data.description: A translucent black snake, long and fearsome looking.

data.name: sheep
data.description: A timid, hooved grazing mammal, and one of the first animals ever domesticated, its body is covered in a thick layer of wool, and the males have long, spiralling horns.

data.name: Shia LaBeouf
data.description:
Living in the woods, 
killing for sport, 
eating all the bodies, 
actual cannibal Shia LaBeouf.

data.name: shoggoth
data.description: A gargantuan protoplasmic blob, constantly reshaping, forming new pseudopods seemingly at will.  All over its body are eyes that form and disappear.  It looks at you with malice.

data.name: skeleton
data.description: With its skin so tight the cracked bones are visible beneath it, covered in scar tissue and coils of scabbed black liquid and with eyes so deeply sunken into its skull they are barely visible, it's a wonder this once-human creature can move at all.

data.name: skitterbot
data.description: A insectoid robot the size of a small dog, designed for home security.  Armed with two close-range tazers, it can skate across the ground with great speed.

data.name: sludge crawler
data.description: A sluglike creature, eight feet long and the width of a refrigerator.  Its black body glistens as it oozes its way along the ground.  Eye stalks occasionally push their way out of the oily mass and look around.

data.name: giant slug
data.description: A mutated leopard slug, as wide as a golf cart.  Venom dripping from its fanged maw, it slithers ahead slowly, leaving a trail of glistening slime.

data.name: giant cellar spider
data.description: A twitchy mutant brown spider, with a relatively small body and spindly long legs.  Its smaller brethren are known for being agile, and for preying upon other spiders.
data.//: No, they are not in fact the most venomous spider in the world.

data.name: immature giant cellar spider
data.description: A newly-hatched giant cellar spider.  Too small to possess much venom, but still quick and agile like an adult.

data.name: giant jumping spider
data.description: A giant spider with big forelegs and two pairs of inquisitive-looking eyes.  It can leap quite quickly, even into the treetops.

data.name: giant trapdoor spider
data.description: A gigantic spider with a bulbous thorax.  It digs a deep underground burrow that serves as a pit to trap unwary prey.

data.name: giant web spider
data.description: A giant mutated grass spider, it waits for prey to become ensnared in the vast webs that it weaves between the trees.

data.name: immature giant web spider
data.description: A still immature giant grass spider.  Too young to be venomous, or to walk proficiently for that matter

data.name: giant black widow
data.description: A giant mutated black widow spider.  A highly venomous nightmare come to life.

data.name: giant black widow spiderling
data.description: The horrid spawn of a giant black widow spider.  Even as a newborn, this foul creature knows only how to kill.

data.name: giant wolf spider
data.description: A wolf spider mutated to about thirty times its normal size, it moves quickly and aggressively to catch and consume prey.

data.name: spore cloud
data.description: A mass of spores the size of a balled fist, wafting around in the air.

data.name: squirrel
data.description: A small granivorous rodent with a long bushy tail, often seen darting amid the branches of trees.  A skittish varmint with an expression of unwavering austerity, it is the mortal enemy of cat and dog alike.

data.name: squirrel
data.description: A tiny opportunistic rodent with a long bushy tail.  The pine squirrel is clever and cute, and hunted by nearly everything in the woods with a taste for meat.

data.name: tank drone
data.description: The Northrup Emancipator is the first and only automated tank ever produced, made shortly after the split-up of Northrup Grumman.  Clad in depleted uranium plating, and armed with advanced munitions and a 120-mm gun, it is capable of delivering extraordinary firepower.

data.name: thing
data.description: An amorphous black creature, detaching and sprouting tentacles without any apparent pause.

data.name: triffid
data.description: A creeping animate plant, growing as tall as a moose.  It has a single bark-covered stalk supporting a flowery head with a paralyzing sting concealed within.

data.name: triffid heart
data.description: A knot of tubular roots, flowing with sap and beating like a heart.  Strands of vascular tissue reach out to the surrounding root walls.

data.name: triffid queen
data.description: A ponderous and particularly arborescent triffid.  It has enormous red petals surrounded by a haze of spores, and two thick barbed vines stick out from the stems like wary harpoons.

data.name: triffid sprout
data.description: A small triffid, only a few feet tall.  It has not yet developed bark, but its sting is still sharp and deadly.

data.name: tribot
data.description: The Honda Regnal, a tall robot walking on three spidery legs.  For weapons, it has a trio of spiked retractable cables and a flamethrower mounted on its head.

data.name: turkey
data.description: A large and colorful game bird native to the forests of North America.  Its head and beak are covered in fleshy protuberances.

data.name: milspec searchlight
data.description: Three high-powered searchlights with automated search AI and mounting, continually seeking targets.

data.name: twisted body
data.description: A human body, but with its limbs, neck, and hair impossibly twisted.  It clambers around swiftly, making awful screeching sounds.

data.name: vine beast
data.description: An animated mass of roots and vines, creeping along the ground with alarming speed.  The tangle is thick enough that the center from which they grow is concealed.

data.name: vortex
data.description: A twisting spot in the air, with some kind of morphing mass at its center.

data.name: giant wasp
data.description: A gigantic slender-bodied wasp with an evil-looking stinger protruding from its abdomen.  Its exoskeleton glowers with ominous red markings.

death_drops.//: 40% chance of an item from group bees

data.name: weasel
data.description: The long-tailed weasel, a small but ubiquitous predator whose range extends across the continent.  It forms its den in small burrows, preferring to occupy the nesting holes of its prey.

data.name: wolf
data.description: A cunning pack predator, once extinct in the New England area, the wolf was successfully reintroduced and their numbers reached record highs in the decade before the cataclysm.  Lucky you.

data.name: giant worm
data.description: An enormous, mutated creature that might once have been a nightcrawler.  It possesses a large fanged mouth and a long slender body that comes up to your shoulder, with even more surely hiding underground.

data.name: yugg
data.description: An enormous white flatworm that burrows beneath the earth.  Its mouth is lined with pointed teeth, and it is covered in fine hairs which can be shed and fired like darts.

data.name: grim howler
data.description: A zombified wolf.  Its mouth oozes with a black substance, coating the vicious-looking white fangs.

data.name: zombear
data.description: This black bear's eyes ooze with black fluid, and its flesh is torn and scarred.  It shuffles as it walks.

data.name: zombie
data.description: A human body, swaying as it moves, an unstoppable rage is visible in its oily black eyes.

data.name: acidic zombie
data.description: A sickly-looking dead one.  Its skin looks especially thin, with a sticky, yellow fluid flowing through the clearly visible veins.

data.name: armored zombie
data.description: Despite being encased in a what was once a nigh-impenetrable suit of power armor, something still managed to kill this soldier.

data.name: zombie bio-operator
data.description: This armored and augmented soldier's bionics crackle with energy.  Worse, it appears to remember its training.

data.name: slavering biter
data.description: A distorted and swollen human body.  Its jaws have elongated into a crocodile like snout, dripping with foul smelling saliva.

data.name: zombie brute
data.description: Its entire body bulges with distended muscles and swollen, festering wounds.

data.name: zombie wrestler
data.description: A slab of festering muscle the size of a well-toned bodybuilder.  Seems eager to strangle the life from you.

data.name: zombie nightstalker
data.description: Somehow this brute hides in the dark like some kind of boogeyman.  Very agile for such a large zombie.

data.name: shocker brute
data.description: A huge beast covered in visible scarring from what you can only guess was 'research'.  Being near it, you can hear a slight humming, like that of an electrical transformer.

data.name: zombie cop
data.description: A human body covered by a weather-beaten and badly damaged set of riot gear.

data.name: corrosive zombie
data.description: This body has swollen to immense proportions, but still manages to hold itself together with semi-congealed acid all over its bloated body.  It clumsily moves around, but attacks with a large reserve of acid.

data.name: crawling zombie
data.description: This human corpse drags itself along slowly with its arms.  Its legs are damaged beyond repair.

data.name: zombie dancer
data.description:
The foulest stench is in the air, 
The funk of forty thousand years, 
And grisly ghouls from every tomb, 
Are closing in to seal your doom!

The dancer doesn't even notice you, it seems like something nearby is controlling it.

data.name: zombie dog
data.description: The deformed, animated corpse of a canine, a sinewy beast which can easily outpace its two-legged friends.

data.name: shocker zombie
data.description: A human body with pale blue flesh, crackling with electrical energy.

data.name: fat zombie
data.description: Stumbling as it moves, this corpse of an overweight human regards its surroundings with an empty black gaze.

data.name: fiend
data.description: Charred zombie with bony plates, spikes and protursions.  Moves stiffly, but swiftly.

data.name: firefighter zombie
data.description: A decaying human body clad in tattered firefighting gear.  It staggers aimlessly, reeking of smoke and decay.

data.name: fungal zombie
data.description: Once human, fungal tendrils now sprout from its mouth, eyes, and other orifices, holding together a shambling mass of mold-covered flesh.

data.name: bloated zombie
data.description: With its gray skin swollen to near rupture with putrid gas, this cyst covered zombie looks like it could violently burst under the slightest of disturbances.

data.name: grabber zombie
data.description: A deformed human body, once living.  Its arms dangle from its sides like the limbs of some skinless ape, mindlessly groping at their surroundings.

data.name: grappler zombie
data.description: An undead humanoid, its elongated arms drag along the ground as it moves.  It looks to almost have a hunch from the swollen back and shoulder muscles tearing though its skin.

data.name: hazmat zombie
data.description: This zombie's face and body is completely covered by a protective suit.  It wanders around, unsteadily.

data.name: zombie hollow
data.description: Black hollow eyes survey the surroundings as the zombie stretches and bends in ways that whoever the original body belonged to never could.  The only thing that seems solid, on this flexible black-veined body, is the rows of sharp black teeth.  You get the feeling that the only human thing remaining is the skin, worn as one would wear clothes.

data.name: zombie hulk
data.description: A human body now swollen to the size of six men, with arms as wide as a trash can.

data.name: feral hunter
data.description: This once-human body is barely recognizable, scrambling about on all fours, its nails and teeth both sharpened into dangerous looking spikes.

data.name: Thriller
data.description:
And though you fight to stay alive, 
Your body starts to shiver. 
For no mere mortal can resist, 
The evil of the thriller.

data.name: zombie snapper
data.description: With a crocodile-like snout and rows of protuding teeth, this swimwear-clad zombie lurks in the water.

data.name: zombie master
data.description: Once human, its features have tightened, its lips pulled back into an unnatural grin, revealing rows of blackened teeth beneath its large, piercing eyes.  It stands tall and its movements are fluid and tightly controlled.  A feeling of danger permeates the air around it, and the light that falls on it seems somehow harsher and more glaring.

data.name: zombie necromancer
data.description: A twisted mockery of the human form, emaciated, with jet black skin and glowing red eyes.  It is somehow painful to look at, awakening fears deep within your psyche, and even the air around it seems more sinister, somehow darker and more dangerous.

data.name: festering boar
data.description: A zombified omnivore descended from the wild boar.  Now it's got black goo all over it, instead of mud.
data.//: 1d8->2d5, minor bonus over 1d9

data.name: feral predator
data.description: With its joints in odd places and angles, this humanoid creature prowls across the landscape with surprising speed.  Its teeth and arms are sharpened into fine points, and black ooze seeps out from cuts between its muscles.

data.name: decayed zombie
data.description: A once-dead human corpse.  Its discolored swollen flesh is riddled with festering wounds and open sores.

data.name: feral runner
data.description: This recently-risen body moves quickly, darting its head back and forth and gnawing at its hands.

data.name: zombie scientist
data.description: Apart from the jet black eyes it would be easy to believe this scientist was still alive.  Clad in a tattered lab coat, it looks to have some measure of situational awareness and resourcefulness.

data.name: scorched zombie
data.description: Heavily burned zombie that still reeks of charred flesh.  Its flesh has mended into a leathery shell.

data.name: screecher zombie
data.description: A thin corpse, its chest is swollen in what appears to be preparation.  A thick black ooze drips from its open mouth.

data.name: shady zombie
data.description: An uncanny shadow envelops this creature, as if light itself were too repulsed to touch it.  All you can make out is its shambling, human shaped outline.

data.name: shrieker zombie
data.description: An elongated human body with a swollen chest and a gaping hole where its jaw used to be.

data.name: smoker zombie
data.description: A blackened and twisted naked human body, strips of flesh hang from its body, and it emits a constant haze of thick black smoke.

data.name: zombie soldier
data.description: Once a soldier, it is dressed head to toe in combat gear and carries itself rather steadily for a zombie.

data.name: spitter zombie
data.description: A hunched human body with its eyes pushed up into its forehead and drooping cheeks, most of its face is occupied by a puckered mouth.  Its stomach is swollen and nearly translucent, with a sickly yellow tint.

data.name: survivor zombie
data.description: Still wearing the tattered remnants of improvised armor and weaponry, it is plain to see that this zombie was once a survivor like you.

data.name: swimmer zombie
data.description: A slick and glistening human body.  Its hands and feet are webbed, and it is clad in swimwear.

data.name: zombie technician
data.description: Still wearing its work clothes and hardhat, this zombie likely used to work on power lines or other electrical equipment.

data.name: tough zombie
data.description: Once an athletic human, now a brutal monster.  Its facial features are twisted into an expression of pure rage.

data.name: antlered horror
data.description: This formerly-majestic moose has succumbed to the infection which is killing the world.  Shiny green blowflies swarm the vast suppurated patches of purulent flesh where its skin has sloughed away, and its remaining fur is black and matted with necrotic discharge.

data.name: decayed pouncer
data.description: An otherwise normal-looking cougar, except that its hind legs are swollen, and its eyes bulge with black goo.

data.name: Any
data.mutagen_message: mutagen message here
data.iv_message: You inject yoursel-arRGH!
data.iv_sleep_message: You writhe and collapse to the ground.

data.name: Plant
data.mutagen_message: You feel much closer to nature.
data.iv_message: You inject some nutrients into your phloem.

data.name: Insect
data.mutagen_message: You hear buzzing, and feel your body harden.
data.iv_message: You sting yourself...for the Queen.

data.name: Spider
data.mutagen_message: You feel insidious.
data.iv_message: Mmm...the *special* venom.
data.memorial_message: Found a place in the web of life.

data.name: Slime
data.mutagen_message: Your body loses all rigidity for a moment.
data.iv_message: This stuff takes you back.  Downright primordial!
data.memorial_message: Gave up on rigid human norms.
data.junkie_message: Maybe if you drank enough, you'd become mutagen...

data.name: Fish
data.mutagen_message: You are overcome by an overwhelming longing for the ocean.
data.iv_message: Your pulse pounds as the waves.

data.name: Rat
data.mutagen_message: You feel a momentary nausea.
data.iv_message: You squeak as the shot hits you.
data.//: Sound of ratlike squeaking

data.name: Beast
data.mutagen_message: Your heart races and you see blood for a moment.
data.iv_message: Your heart races wildly as the injection takes hold.

data.name: Bear
data.mutagen_message: You feel an urge to...patrol?  the forests?
data.iv_message: You feel yourself quite equipped for wilderness survival.

data.name: Feline
data.mutagen_message: As you lap up the last of the mutagen, you wonder why...
data.iv_message: Your back arches as the mutagen takes hold.

data.name: Wolf
data.mutagen_message: You feel an urge to mark your territory.  But then it passes.
data.iv_message: As the mutagen hits you, your ears twitch and you stifle a yipe.

data.name: Cattle
data.//: ~rBGH is a bovine growth hormone, unpopular with consumers
data.mutagen_message: Your mind and body slow down.  You feel peaceful.
data.iv_message: You wonder if this is what rBGH feels like...
data.memorial_message: Stopped worrying and learned to love the cowbell.

data.name: Cephalopod
data.//: ~Zork reference, but it's talking about your blood vessels
data.mutagen_message: Your mind is overcome by images of eldritch horrors... and then they pass.
data.iv_message: You watch the mutagen flow through a maze of little twisty passages.  All the same.

data.name: Bird
data.mutagen_message: Your body lightens and you long for the sky.
data.iv_message: Your arms spasm in an oddly wavelike motion.

data.name: Lizard
data.mutagen_message: For a heartbeat, your blood cools down.
data.iv_message: Your blood cools down.  The feeling is... different.

data.name: Troglobite
data.mutagen_message: You yearn for a cool, dark place to hide.
data.iv_message: As you press the plunger, it all goes so bright...

data.name: Alpha
data.//: Alpha doesn't make a lot of massive morphological changes, so less nutrients needed.
data.mutagen_message: You feel... better.  Somehow.
data.iv_message: You took that shot like a champ!

data.name: Medical
data.//: Medical's are pretty much all physiology, IIRC
data.mutagen_message: You can feel the blood rushing through your veins and a strange, medicated feeling washes over your senses.
data.iv_message: You can feel the blood in your medication stream.  It's a strange feeling.
data.junkie_message: Ahh, there it is.  You can feel the mutagen again.

data.name: Chimera
data.//: Chimera's all about the massive morphological changes Done Quick, so lotsa nutrition needed
data.mutagen_message: You need to roar, bask, bite, and flap.  NOW.
data.iv_message: everyanimalthateverlived..bursting.from.YOU!
data.iv_sleep_message: With a final *pop*, you go out like a light.

data.name: Fey
data.//: Should be out for two minutes.  Ecstasy Of Green
data.mutagen_message: Nature is becoming one with you...
data.iv_message: Everything goes green for a second.
data.memorial_message: Accepted a more natural way of life.

data.name: Raptor
data.//: Little more painful than average, but nowhere near as harsh & effective as Chimera.
data.mutagen_message: Mmm...sweet, bloody flavor...tastes like victory.
data.iv_message: You distinctly smell the mutagen mixing with your blood ...and then it passes.

data.name: Fleet-Footed
data.description: You can move more quickly than most, resulting in a 15% speed bonus on sure footing.

data.name: Good Hearing
data.description: Your hearing is better than average, and you can hear distant sounds more easily.

data.name: Outdoorsman
data.description: You are accustomed to being exposed to the elements.  This decreases morale penalties for being wet.

data.name: Parkour Expert
data.description: You're skilled at clearing obstacles; terrain like railings or counters are as easy for you to move on as solid ground.

data.name: Indefatigable
data.description: Whether due to exercise and good diet, or due to a natural propensity to physical endurance, you tire due to physical exertion much less readily than others.  Your maximum stamina is 25% higher than usual.

data.name: Quick
data.description: You're just generally quick!  You get a 10% bonus to action points.

data.name: Optimist
data.description: Nothing gets you down!  You savor the joys of life, ignore its hardships, and are generally happier than most people.

data.name: Fast Healer
data.description: You heal faster when sleeping and will even recover small amount of HP when not sleeping.

data.name: Light Eater
data.description: Your metabolism is a little slower, and you require less food than most.

data.name: Accomplished Sleeper
data.description: You have always been able to fall asleep easily, even when sleeping in less than ideal circumstances.

data.name: Pain Resistant
data.description: You have a high tolerance for pain.

data.name: Night Vision
data.description: You possess natural night vision, and can see further in the dark than most.  Activate to toggle NV-visible areas on or off.

data.name: Poison Resistant
data.description: Your system is rather tolerant of poisons and toxins, and most will affect you less.

data.name: Fast Reader
data.description: You're a quick reader, and can get through books a lot faster than most.

data.name: Tough Feet
data.description: The bottoms of your feet are tough and you are accustomed to going barefoot.  You receive no movement penalty for not wearing shoes.

data.name: Tough
data.description: It takes a lot to bring you down!  You get a 20% bonus to all hit points.

data.name: Durable
data.description: You can shrug off almost anything!  You get a 30% bonus to all hit points.

data.name: Unbreakable
data.description: Nothing can break you!  You get a 40% bonus to all hit points.

data.name: Thick-Skinned
data.description: Your skin is tough.  Cutting damage is slightly reduced for you.  Slightly decreases wet penalties.

data.name: Packmule
data.description: You can manage to find space for anything!  You can carry 40% more volume.

data.name: Strong Back
data.description: You are capable of carrying far more than someone with similar strength could.  Your maximum weight carried is increased by 35%.

data.name: Fast Learner
data.description: You have a flexible mind, allowing you to learn skills much faster than others.  Note that this only applies to real-world experience, not to skill gain from other sources like books.

data.name: Strong Stomach
data.description: You are less likely to throw up from food poisoning, alcohol, etc.  If you throw up nevertheless, you won't suffer a residual nausea.
data.//: nope.  This does NOT lead to EATPOISON.  Stomach problems are part of the GI upgrades--one advantage to not having Robust Genetics.

data.name: Good Memory
data.description: You have a an exceptional memory, and find it easy to remember things.  Your skills will erode slightly slower than usual.

data.name: Deft
data.description: While you're not any better at melee combat, you are better at recovering from a miss, and will be able to attempt another strike faster.

data.name: Drunken Master
data.description: The ancient arts of drunken brawling come naturally to you!  While under the influence of alcohol, your melee skill will rise considerably, especially unarmed combat.

data.name: Spiritual
data.description: You've always felt that there is more to the world than we can see.  Whether driven by religious beliefs or philosophical interest, you find great inspiration in studying holy texts and experiencing mystical things.

data.name: Substance Tolerance
data.description: You can handle intoxicants well.  Their effects clear up more quickly for you.

data.name: Gourmand
data.description: You eat faster, and can eat and drink more, than anyone else!  You also enjoy food more; delicious food is better for your morale, and you don't mind unsavory meals as much.  Activate to skip prompt for overeating.

data.name: Addiction Resistant
data.description: Whether due to a lifetime of exposure or through simple willpower, it's harder for you to become addicted to substances, and easier to rid yourself of these addictions.

data.name: Animal Empathy
data.description: Peaceful animals will not run away from you, and even aggressive animals are less likely to attack.  This only applies to natural animals such as woodland creatures.

data.name: Terrifying
data.description: There's something about you that creatures find frightening, and they are more likely to try to flee.

data.name: Disease Resistant
data.description: It's very unlikely that you will catch ambient diseases like a cold or the flu.

data.name: High Adrenaline
data.description: If you are in a very dangerous situation, you may experience a temporary rush which increases your speed and strength significantly.

data.name: Less Sleep
data.description: You need less sleep than the average person.

data.name: Self-Aware
data.description: You get to see your exact amount of HP remaining and health, instead of only having a vague idea of whether you're in good condition or not.

data.name: Inconspicuous
data.description: While sleeping or staying still, it is less likely that monsters will wander close to you.

data.name: Masochist
data.description: Although you still suffer the negative effects of pain, it also brings a unique pleasure to you.

data.name: Stylish
data.description: Practicality is far less important than style.  Your morale is improved by wearing fashionable and attractive clothing.

data.name: Light Step
data.description: You make less noise while walking.  You're also less likely to set off traps.

data.name: Robust Genetics
data.description: You have a very strong genetic base.  If you mutate, the odds that the mutation will be beneficial are greatly increased.

data.//: Can't change the ID as that breaks save-compatibility.
data.name: Scout
data.description: You're an excellent navigator and your ability to spot distant landmarks is unmatched.  Your sight radius on the overmap extends beyond the normal range.

data.name: Cannibal
data.description: For your whole life you've been forbidden from indulging in your peculiar tastes.  Now the world's ended, and you'll be damned if anyone is going to tell you that you can't eat people.

data.name: Psychopath
data.description: You don't experience guilt like others do.  Even when you know your actions are wrong, you just don't care.

data.name: Martial Arts Training
data.description: You have received some martial arts training at a local dojo.  You start with your choice of Karate, Judo, Aikido, Tai Chi, or Taekwondo.

data.name: Self-Defense Classes
data.description: You have taken some self-defense classes at a nearby gym.  You start with your choice of Capoeira, Krav Maga, Muay Thai, Ninjutsu, or Zui Quan.

data.name: Shaolin Adept
data.description: You have studied the arts of the Shaolin monks.  You start with one of the five animal fighting styles: Tiger, Crane, Leopard, Snake, or Dragon.

data.name: Venom Mob Protege
data.description: You are a pupil of the Venom Clan.  You start with one of the five deadly venoms: Centipede, Viper, Scorpion, Lizard, or Toad.

data.name: Melee Weapon Training
data.description: You have practiced fighting with weapons.  You start with your choice of Eskrima, Fencing, Pentjak Silat or Niten Ichi-Ryu.

data.name: Weak Scent
data.description: Your scent is quite weak.  Animals that track your scent will do so with more difficulty.

data.name: Skilled Liar
data.description: You have no qualms about bending the truth, and have practically no tells.  Telling lies and otherwise bluffing will be much easier for you.

data.name: Pretty
data.description: You are a sight to behold.  NPCs who care about such thing will react more kindly to you.

data.name: Bad Knees
data.description: Whether due to injury or age, your knees aren't particularly strong or flexible.  Moving over rough terrain will slow you down more than normal.

data.name: Languorous
data.description: Whether due to lack of exercise and poor diet, or due to a natural disinclination to physical endurance, you tire due to physical exertion much more readily than others.  Your maximum stamina is 25% lower than usual.

data.name: Near-Sighted
data.description: Without your glasses, your seeing radius is severely reduced!  However, while wearing glasses this trait has no effect, and you are guaranteed to start with a pair.

data.name: Slow Healer
data.description: You heal a little slower than most; sleeping will heal less lost HP.

data.name: Far-Sighted
data.description: Without reading glasses, you are unable to read anything, and take penalties on melee accuracy and electronics/tailoring crafting.  However, you are guaranteed to start with a pair of reading glasses.

data.name: Heavy Sleeper
data.description: You're quite the heavy sleeper.  Noises are unlikely to wake you up.

data.name: Sleepy
data.description: You need sleep more often, but still spend most of your time awake.

data.name: Asthmatic
data.description: You will occasionally need to use an inhaler, or else suffer severe physical limitations.  However, you are guaranteed to start with an inhaler.

data.name: Bad Back
data.description: You simply can not carry as much as people with a similar strength could.  Your maximum weight carried is reduced by 35%.

data.name: Bad Temper
data.description: Things just keep getting you down.  You tend to be unhappy, and it takes some doing to cheer you up.

data.name: Disorganized
data.description: You are terrible at organizing and storing your possessions.  You can carry 40% less volume.

data.name: Illiterate
data.description: You never learned to read!  Books and computers are off-limits to you.

data.name: Poor Hearing
data.description: Your hearing is poor, and you may not hear quiet or far-off noises.

data.name: Slow Learner
data.description: You are slow to grasp new ideas and thus learn things more slowly than others.  Note that this only applies to real-world experience, not to skill gain from other sources like books.

data.name: Insomniac
data.description: You have a hard time falling asleep, even under the best circumstances!

data.name: Meat Intolerance
data.description: You have problems with eating meat.  It's possible for you to eat it, but you will suffer morale penalties due to nausea.
data.//: Intolerances are presumed a psychological issue unless stated otherwise, and cancelled by digestive mutations, which force the issue.

data.name: Thin-Skinned
data.description: Your skin is fragile.  Cutting damage is slightly increased for you.

data.name: Hates Vegetables
data.description: You, like many children, hated eating your vegetables; however, you didn't outgrow it.  It's possible for you to eat them, but you will suffer morale penalties due to nausea.

data.name: Hates Fruit
data.description: You despise eating fruits.  It's possible for you to eat them, but you will suffer morale penalties due to nausea.

data.name: Lactose Intolerance
data.//: Actual digestive issue, on even footing with the -vore mutations.
data.description: You, like 75 percent of the world, cannot tolerate milk or milk based products.  It's possible for you to eat them, but you will suffer morale penalties due to nausea.

data.name: Junkfood Intolerance
data.description: Something in those heavily processed foods doesn't agree with you.  It's possible for you to eat them, but you will suffer morale penalties due to nausea.

data.name: Wheat Allergy
data.//: Actual digestive issue, on even footing with the -vore mutations.
data.description: You have a rare allergy that prevents you from eating wheat.  It's possible for you to eat them, but you will suffer morale penalties due to nausea.

data.name: Glass Jaw
data.description: Your head can't take much abuse.  Its maximum HP is 20% lower than usual.

data.name: Forgetful
data.description: You have a hard time remembering things.  Your skills will erode slightly faster than usual.

data.name: Lightweight
data.description: Alcohol and drugs go straight to your head.  You suffer the negative effects of these for longer.

data.name: Addictive Personality
data.description: It's easier for you to become addicted to substances, and harder to rid yourself of these addictions.

data.name: Trigger Happy
data.description: On rare occasion, you will go full-auto when you intended to fire a single shot.  This has no effect when firing semi-automatic firearms.

data.name: Strong Scent
data.description: Your scent is particularly strong.  It's not offensive to humans, but animals that track your scent will do so more easily.

data.name: Chemical Imbalance
data.description: You suffer from a minor chemical imbalance, whether mental or physical.  Minor changes to your internal chemistry will manifest themselves on occasion, such as hunger, sleepiness, narcotic effects, etc.

data.name: Animal Discord
data.description: Most animals don't like you, and aggressive animals are more likely to attack you.  This only applies to natural animals such as woodland creatures.

data.name: Slow Reader
data.description: You're a slow reader, and it takes you longer to get through books than most.

data.name: Schizophrenic
data.description: You will periodically suffer from delusions, ranging from minor effects to full visual hallucinations.  Some of these effects may be controlled through the use of Thorazine.

data.name: Clumsy
data.description: You make more noise while walking.  You're also more likely to set off traps.

data.name: Jittery
data.description: During moments of great stress or under the effects of stimulants, you may find your hands shaking uncontrollably, severely reducing your dexterity.

data.name: Hoarder
data.description: You don't feel right unless you're carrying as much as you can.  You suffer morale penalties for carrying less than maximum volume (weight is ignored).  Xanax can help control this anxiety.

data.name: Savant
data.description: You tend to specialize in one skill and be poor at all others.  You advance at half speed in all skills except your best one.  Note that combining this with Fast Learner will come out to a slower rate of learning for all skills.

data.name: Pacifist
data.description: You don't like thinking about violence.  Your combat skills advance much slower than usual, and you feel more guilt about killing.

data.name: Mood Swings
data.description: Your morale will shift up and down at random, often dramatically.

data.name: Slow Footed
data.description: You can't move as fast as most, resulting in a 15% speed penalty on flat ground.

data.name: Weak Stomach
data.description: You are more likely to throw up from food poisoning, alcohol, etc.

data.name: Wool Allergy
data.description: You are badly allergic to wool, and can not wear any clothing made of the substance.

data.name: Truth Teller
data.description: When you try to tell a lie, you blush, stammer, and get all shifty-eyed.  Telling lies and otherwise bluffing will be much more difficult for you.

data.name: Ugly
data.description: You're not much to look at.  NPCs who care about such things will react poorly to you.

data.name: Albino
data.description: You lack skin pigmentation due to a genetic problem.  You sunburn extremely easily, and typically use an umbrella and a sunglasses when going out in the sun.

data.name: Flimsy
data.description: Your body can't take much abuse.  Its maximum HP is 25% lower than usual and you heal slightly slower.  Stacks with Glass Jaw.

data.name: Frail
data.description: Your body breaks very easily.  Its maximum HP is 50% lower than usual and you heal slower.  Stacks with Glass Jaw.

data.name: Fragile
data.description: Your body is extremely fragile.  Its maximum HP is 75% lower than usual and you heal much slower.  Stacks with Glass Jaw.

data.name: Rough Skin
data.description: Your skin is slightly rough.  This has no gameplay effect.

data.name: High Night Vision
data.description: You can see incredibly well in the dark!  Activate to toggle NV-visible areas on or off.

data.name: Full Night Vision
data.description: You can see in pitch blackness as if you were wearing night-vision goggles.  Activate to toggle NV-visible areas on or off.

data.name: Cephalopod Eyes
data.description: Your eyes still bulge, yet your pupils look Different somehow.  Water doesn't seem to cause any trouble at all, though.

data.name: Cephalopod Vision
data.description: Your brain has caught up with your eyes.  You can see much better in the dark, but sunlight seems much brighter now.  Activate to toggle NV-visible areas on or off.

data.name: Fey Eyes
data.description: Your eyes have turned...green.  It's tough to tell the exact shade as it seems to shift.  The effect is ...pleasant.

data.name: Fey Vision
data.description: The shadows don't seem as dark now.  Activate to toggle NV-visible areas on or off.

data.name: Fey Nightsight
data.description: You have great low-light vision now, though that doesn't allow you to perform fine tasks such as crafting and reading in darkness.  Activate to toggle NV-visible areas on or off.

data.name: Feline Eyes
data.description: Your eyes have mutated, now having a slitted pupil and glittering in light, much like those of cats.  This is visually striking, but it isn't helping you see at night.

data.name: Feline Vision
data.description: Your optic nerves and brain caught up with your eyes.  Now you can see pretty well at night.  Activate to toggle NV-visible areas on or off.

data.name: Ursine Vision
data.description: Your visual processing has shifted: though you can see better in the dark, you're nearsighted in the light.  Maybe glasses would help.  Activate to toggle NV-visible areas on or off.

data.name: Avian Eyes
data.description: Your vision has become particularly acute: you suspect you could pick out zombies much farther away.  Perception +4.

data.name: Infrared Vision
data.description: Your eyes have mutated to pick up radiation in the infrared spectrum.

data.name: Reptilian Eyes
data.description: Your eyes have mutated, with a brilliant iris and slitted pupil similar to that of a lizard.  This is visually striking, but doesn't seem to affect your vision.

data.name: Reptilian IR
data.description: Your optic nerves and brain have mutated to catch up with your eyes, allowing you to see in the infrared spectrum.

data.name: Very Fast Healer
data.description: Your flesh regenerates slowly, and you will regain HP even when not sleeping.

data.name: Regeneration
data.description: Your flesh regenerates from wounds incredibly quickly.

data.name: Reptilian Healing
data.description: Your broken limbs mend themselves without significant difficulty.

data.name: Very Little Sleep
data.description: You don't sleep often.  But when you do, you need very little of it.

data.name: Tireless
data.description: You defend the realm all night and all day.

data.name: Fangs
data.description: Your teeth have grown into two-inch-long fangs, allowing you to make an extra attack when conditions favor it.

data.name: Incisors
data.description: Your big teeth have grown in.  Folks had best show some more respect.

attacks.attack_text_u: You bite into %s with your ratlike incisors

data.name: Nictitating Membrane
data.description: You have a second set of clear eyelids which lower while underwater, allowing you to see as though you were wearing goggles.  Slightly decreases wet penalties.

data.name: Gills
data.description: You've grown a set of gills in your neck, allowing you to breathe underwater.  Slightly increases wet benefits.

data.name: Cephalopod Gills
data.description: You've grown a set of gills, running from your neck up behind your ears.  They allow you to breathe underwater and slightly increase wet benefits.

data.name: Mycus Flesh
data.description: We have adapted local physical structure to Mycus physiology.  Greatly reduces wet effects.

data.name: Mycus Fireproofing
data.description: We have incorporated the dense amphibole fibers used in Mycus core towers.  Greatly reduces speed, but also damage, flammability, and wet effects.

data.name: Scales
data.description: A set of flexible green scales has grown to cover your body, acting as natural armor.  Somewhat reduces wet effects.

data.name: Thick Scales
data.description: A set of heavy green scales has grown to cover your body, acting as natural armor.  While difficult to penetrate, it also limits your flexibility, resulting in a -2 penalty to Dexterity.  Greatly reduces wet effects.

data.name: Sleek Scales
data.description: A set of very flexible and slick scales has grown to cover your body.  These act as weak natural armor, improve your ability to swim, and make you difficult to grab.  Mostly reduces wet effects.

data.name: Light Bones
data.description: Your bones are very light.  This enables you to move and attack 10% faster, but also reduces your carrying weight by 20% and makes bashing attacks hurt a little more.

data.name: Feathers
data.description: Iridescent feathers have grown to cover your entire body, providing a marginal protection against attacks and minor protection from cold.  They also provide a natural waterproofing.

data.name: Down
data.description: You shan't need to migrate south with your layer of down.  It's even better with no apes around to kill you for it!

data.name: Lightly Furred
data.description: Light fur has grown to cover your entire body, providing slight protection from cold.

data.name: Furry
data.description: Thick black fur has grown to cover your entire body, providing a marginal protection against attacks, and considerable protection from cold.

data.name: Shaggy Fur
data.description: Your fur has grown out and thickened, providing noticeable protection from attacks as well as considerable insulation.

data.name: Gray Fur
data.description: Dense gray fur has grown to cover your entire body, providing a marginal protection against attacks, and considerable protection from cold.

data.name: Sleek Fur
data.description: You've grown sleek brown fur, providing some protection from cold.

data.name: Lynx Fur
data.description: Your fur's grown out significantly around your cheeks and neck.  It provides minor protection against attacks.

data.name: Chitinous Skin
data.description: Your epidermis has turned into a thin, flexible layer of chitin.  It provides minor protection from cutting wounds.  Slightly reduces wet effects.

data.name: Chitinous Armor
data.description: You've grown a chitin exoskeleton, much like that of an insect.  It provides considerable physical protection, but reduces your dexterity by 1.  Somewhat reduces wet effects.

data.name: Chitinous Plate
data.description: You've grown a chitin exoskeleton made of thick, stiff plates.  It provides excellent physical protection, but reduces your dexterity by 1 and encumbers all body parts but your eyes and mouth.  Greatly reduces wet effects.

data.name: Hairy Chitin
data.description: You've developed some sort of hair growing out of your chitin.  It's a bit warmer than not having hair.

data.name: Furred Chitin
data.description: Your chitin hair has thickened and spread across your body.  It provides minor warmth and helps you sense nearby vibrations.

data.name: Furred Plate
data.description: Your exoskeleton has hardened considerably--restricting movement, granted--and boasts a fine coat of hairs that put feline whiskers to shame.

data.name: Urticating Hairs
data.description: Significant amounts of your hairs have loosened.  If some creature tries to attack you, your assailant is quite likely to get fine, bristly chitin in an irritating spot; it doesn't carry your venom but it will be distracting.

data.name: Spines
data.description: Your skin is covered with fine spines.  Whenever an unarmed opponent strikes a part of your body that is not covered by clothing, they will receive moderate damage.

data.name: Quills
data.description: Your body is covered with large quills.  Whenever an unarmed opponent strikes a part of your body that is not covered by clothing, they will receive significant damage.

data.name: Phelloderm
data.description: Your skin is light green and has a slightly woody quality to it.  This provides a weak armor, and helps you retain moisture, resulting in less thirst.  Greatly decreases wet penalties.

data.name: Bark
data.description: Your skin is coated in a light bark, like that of a tree.  This provides resistance to bashing and cutting damage and minor protection from fire.  Greatly reduces wet effects.

data.name: Thorns
data.description: Your skin is covered in small, woody thorns.  Whenever an unarmed opponent strikes a part of your body that is not covered by clothing, they will receive minor damage.  Your punches may also deal extra damage.

data.name: Leaves
data.description: All the hair on your body has turned to long, grass-like leaves.  Apart from being physically striking, these provide you with a minor amount of nutrition while in sunlight.  Slightly reduces wet effects.

data.name: Flowering
data.description: You've started blooming where your scalp used to be.  Your blossoms have a pleasant aroma, are visually striking, and are quite sensitive.

data.name: Mycus Spores
data.description: We have developed local spore sacs.  The Mycus must grow.

data.name: Mycus Sporogenesis
data.description: Local organisms seem to regard open spore-dispersal as a danger, and attack the Mycus.  Accordingly our local spore sacs remain quiescent, until local guidance determines that it is safe to germinate.  Rapid development taxes local nutrient reserves but ensures rapid and effective growth.

data.name: Mycus Blossoms
data.description: We have developed local blossoms.  The Mycus must grow.

data.name: Mycus Bloom
data.description: Local organisms seem to regard open spore-dispersal as a danger, and attack the Mycus.  Accordingly our local blossoms remain quiescent, until local guidance determines that it is safe to germinate.  Rapid development taxes local nutrient reserves but ensures rapid and effective growth.

data.name: Long Fingernails
data.description: Your fingernails are long and sharp.  If you aren't wearing gloves, your unarmed attacks deal a minor amount of cutting damage.

data.name: Claws
data.description: You have claws on the ends of your fingers.  If you aren't wearing gloves, your unarmed attacks deal a minor amount of cutting damage.

data.name: Rat Claws
data.description: Your claws have grown tougher and slightly gnarled.

data.name: Stainless Claws
data.description: Your paws are bone, muscle, and claw with a thin layer of skin and fur.  They might as well be made of stainless steel.

data.name: Retractable Claws
data.description: You have claws on the ends of your fingers, and can extend or retract them as desired.  Gloves will still get in the way, though.

data.name: Tentacle Rakes
data.description: Your upper tentacles have grown large, hook-barbed rakes on the ends.  They're quite vicious, but really aren't suited for fine manipulation.

data.name: Large Talons
data.description: Your index fingers have grown into huge talons.  After a bit of practice, you find that this does not affect your dexterity, but allows for a deadly unarmed attack.  They also prevent you from wearing gloves.

data.name: Radiogenic
data.description: Your system has adapted to radiation.  While irradiated, you will actually heal slowly, converting the radiation into hit points.

data.name: Marloss Carrier
data.description: Ever since you ate that Marloss berry, you can't get its scent out of your nose, and you have a strong desire to try some seeds and...sap?

data.name: Marloss Vessel
data.description: Ever since you ate that Marloss seed, you can't get its taste off of your tongue, and you have a strong desire to try some berries and...sap?

data.name: Marloss Vector
data.description: Ever since you ate that Marloss jelly, you can't stop thinking of it, and you have a strong desire to eat some seeds and berries.

data.name: Marloss Rejection
data.description: Ever since you had that life-threatening reaction to that Marloss junk, you can't bear the thought of ever eating it again!

data.name: Mutagenic Aversion
data.description: Ever since you had that life-threatening reaction to those mutagen and purifier things, you can't bear the thought of ever using them again!

data.name: Insect Pheromones
data.description: Your body produces low-level pheromones, identifying you as a friend to many species of insects.  Insects will attack you much less.

data.name: Mammal Pheromones
data.description: Your body produces low-level pheromones which puts mammals at ease.  They will be less likely to attack or flee from you.

data.name: Disease Immune
data.description: Your body is simply immune to diseases.  You will never catch an ambient disease.

data.name: Infection Resistant
data.description: Your immune system is particularly good at resisting infections.  You have an increased chance for bad wounds and infections to heal on their own, and only suffer reduced penalties from them.

data.name: Infection Immune
data.description: Your bloodstream has developed antibiotic properties.  Your wounds will never become infected.

data.name: Mycus Identity
data.description: We have synchronized our local physiology with that of our reproductive systems.  Any spores we may encounter will not attempt to germinate inside the local system.

data.name: Parasite Immune
data.description: Your body is unusually inhospitable to parasitic lifeforms.  You will never become infested with internal parasites.

data.name: Venomous
data.description: Your body produces a potent venom.  Cutting or stabbing attacks from mutations have a chance to poison your target.

data.name: Strongly Venomous
data.description: Your venom has become particularly strong.  You're confident that your bites or other cutting/stabbing natural attacks will take your target down quickly.

data.name: Slime Hands
data.description: The skin on your hands is a mucous membrane and produces a thick, acrid slime.  Attacks using your hand will cause minor acid damage.  Slightly increases wet benefits.

data.name: Stretchy Limbs
data.description: Your limbs seem to have a little more 'give' to them.  +1 Dexterity.

data.name: Rubbery Limbs
data.description: Your limbs are significantly more flexible than any pathetic human arm or leg.  +3 Dexterity, -2 Strength.

data.name: Pseudolimbs
data.description: Your pseudopod-like limbs can fit into anything!  +4 Dexterity, -4 Strength.

data.name: Compound Eyes
data.description: Your eyes are compound, like those of an insect.  This increases your perception by 2 so long as you aren't wearing eyewear.

data.name: Padded Feet
data.description: The bottoms of your feet are strongly padded.  You receive no movement penalty for not wearing shoes, and even receive a 10% bonus when moving barefoot.

data.name: Toe Talons
data.description: You have grown large, curved, and wickedly sharp talons in place of your big toes.  Fortunately, they don't get in the way of your movement.  Unfortunately, they do prevent you from wearing footgear.

data.name: Hooves
data.description: Your feet have fused into hooves.  This allows kicking attacks to do much more damage, provides natural armor, and removes the need to wear shoes; however, you can not wear shoes of any kind.  Reduces wet effects.

data.name: Alcohol Metabolism
data.description: So it's fermented?  Whatever, it's still good drinking.  You've developed the ability to metabolize alcohol as a food source.
data.//: It's unlikely but possible to get EATPOISON without ALCMET.  Since EATPOISON's arguably a stronger version, it serves as both prereqs.

data.name: Subterranean Fortitude
data.description: The aches and pains of living underground don't bother you as much.

data.name: Subterranean Build
data.description: Your frame has adapted for life in confined spaces.  You seem a little shorter and bulkier, trading muscle mass for mobility.  (+2 Strength, -2 Dexterity)

data.name: Saprovore
data.description: Your digestive system is specialized to allow you to consume decaying material.  You can eat rotten food, albeit for less nutrition than usual.

data.name: Saprophage
data.description: You prefer to sustain yourself using your roots and direct nutrient extraction/synthesis.  You can still consume 'food', though, if you have to: you merely prefer it aged a little.

data.name: Gizzard
data.description: You seem to get full faster now, and food goes through you more rapidly as well.

data.name: Mycus Feeder
data.description: We have streamlined our nutritional requirements.  We rely on the Mycus for sustenance, as it relies on us.

data.name: Ruminant
data.description: Your digestive system is capable of digesting cellulose and other rough plant material.  You can eat underbrush by activating this, standing over your target, and pressing E.

data.name: Grazer
data.description: You're accustomed to eating plants directly, and can get nutrition from grass as well as underbrush.  Eat either one by activating this, standing over your target, and pressing E.

data.name: Intestinal Fortitude
data.description: Your guts have developed the ability to handle poisonous food.  Mostly.
data.//: Yes, you eventually got over the massive digestive upset.  Mutations aren't easy on a system!

data.name: Eater Of The Dead
data.description: Eating rotting, long-dead flesh is good for the struggle, and safe--if still completely unappealing--for you.

data.name: Burrowing
data.description: Between your claws and teeth, you can tunnel through just about anything.

data.name: Saber Teeth
data.description: Your fangs have grown extremely large and incredibly sharp.  They make it impossible to wear mouthgear and difficult to eat...  but leave nasty wounds when you bite.

attacks.attack_text_u: You tear into %s with your saber teeth
attacks.attack_text_npc: %1$s tears into %2$s with their saber teeth

data.name: Hyper-Metabolism
data.description: You metabolize nutrients so rapidly that you can convert food directly into useful tissue.  Excess nutrition will convert to HP, rather than being wasted.  Activate to skip prompt for overeating.

data.name: Horns
data.description: You have a pair of small horns on your head.  They allow you to make a weak piercing headbutt attack.

data.name: Curled Horns
data.description: You have a pair of large curled horns, like those of a ram.  They allow you to make a strong bashing headbutt attack, but prevent you from wearing any headwear.

attacks.attack_text_u: You headbutt %s with your curled horns

data.name: Pointed Horns
data.description: You have a pair of long, pointed horns, like those of an antelope.  They allow you to make a strong piercing headbutt attack, but prevent you from wearing any headwear the is not made of fabric.

attacks.attack_text_u: You stab %s with your pointed horns

data.name: Antlers
data.description: You have a huge rack of antlers, like those of a moose.  They prevent you from hearing headwear that is not made of fabric, but provide a weak headbutt attack.

data.name: Antennae
data.description: You have a pair of antennae.  They allow you to detect the presence of monsters up to a few tiles away, even if you can't see or hear them, but prevent you from wearing headwear that is not made of fabric.

data.name: Road-Runner
data.description: Your legs are extremely limber and fast-moving.  You move 30% faster on flat surfaces.

data.name: Stubby Tail
data.description: You have a short, stubby tail, like a rabbit's.  It serves no purpose.

data.name: Tail Fin
data.description: You have a fin-like tail.  It allows you to swim more quickly, but prevents wearing non-fabric pants.  Slightly increases wet benefits.

data.name: Long Tail
data.description: You have a long, graceful tail, like that of a big cat.  It improves your balance, making your ability to dodge higher, but prevents wearing non-fabric pants.

data.name: Cattle Tail
data.description: You have a long tail with a tuft on the end.  You find yourself instinctively swatting away flies with it, though it's not as effective at balancing you as you'd like.  Prevents wearing non-fabric pants.

data.name: Rat Tail
data.description: You have a long but hairless tail.  It's a pretty effective balancing aid, but does look, uh, ratty.  Prevents wearing non-fabric pants.

data.name: Thick Tail
data.description: You have a long, thick, lizardlike tail.  It helps you balance a bit but also makes a serviceable whip.  Prevents wearing non-fabric pants.

data.name: Raptor Tail
data.description: You have a long and semi-stiff lizardlike tail.  You can't effectively lash it in combat, but it significantly improves your balance.  Prevents wearing non-fabric pants.

data.name: Fluffy Tail
data.description: You have a long, fluffy-furred tail.  It greatly improves your balance, making your ability to dodge much higher.  Prevents wearing non-fabric pants.

data.name: Spiked Tail
data.description: You have a long tail that ends in a vicious stinger, like that of a scorpion.  It does not improve your balance at all, but allows for a powerful piercing attack.  Prevents wearing non-fabric pants.

data.name: Club Tail
data.description: You have a long tail that ends in a heavy, bony club.  It does not improve your balance at all, but allows for a powerful bashing attack.  Prevents wearing non-fabric pants.

data.name: Hibernation
data.description: You've developed the ability to stockpile calories and then sleep for extended periods of time.

data.name: Resilient
data.description: You can survive injuries that would incapacitate humans: you get a 20% bonus to all hit points.  Stacks with Tough, etc.

data.name: Solidly Built
data.description: Not much scares you.  You get a 30% bonus to all hit points.  Stacks with Tough, etc.

data.name: TAAANK
data.description: You can simply take the punishment from lesser beings and keep going.  You get a 40% bonus to all hit points.  Stacks with Tough, etc.

data.name: Pain Recovery
data.description: You recover from pain slightly faster than normal.

data.name: Quick Pain Recovery
data.description: You recover from pain faster than normal.

data.name: Very Quick Pain Recovery
data.description: You recover from pain much faster than normal.

data.name: Pain Junkie
data.description: You've developed a serious appetite for pain, and take pride in your scars.
data.//: MASOCHIST_MED and NOPAIN don't cancel each other.  By design.  Poor painless folks...

data.name: Cenobite
data.description: You positively adore pain, in all its varied forms.
data.//: CENOBITE and NOPAIN also don't cancel each other.  By design.  Poor painless cenobites...

data.name: Deadened
data.description: Nothing hurts any more.  Those bites tickle and the wounds itch a bit, but that's it.
data.//: MASOCHIST_MED, CENOBITE, and NOPAIN don't cancel each other.  By design.  Poor painless people...

data.name: Culler
data.description: You've had a revelation: by killing the weaker creatures, who would only die anyway, you preserve resources for those better able to survive.  You are less bothered by death of others: their own weakness invited these fates upon them.

data.name: Hunter
data.description: Your brain has a lot more in common with predatory animal than a human, making it easer to control misplaced reactions to death of your prey.  Additionally, combat skills, which you use to hunt, are easer to learn and maintain.

data.name: Predator
data.description: You consider yourself something other than human and no longer empathise with them.  Combat skills are easy to learn and maintain, but your critical thinking, so characteristic to these creatures, suffers.

data.name: Apex Predator
data.description: Your mind and brain have adapted to your new place in the world: as one on top the food chain.  You can effortlessly master and maintain combat skills, but your critical thinking has atrophied further.

data.name: Sapiovore
data.description: The hairless apes are as good eating as any other meat.

data.name: Mycus Defender
data.description: From time to time the Mycus requires protection from non-Mycus that, for whatever reason, wish it ill.  We have adapted to better carry out this task.

data.name: Bird Wings
data.description: You have a pair of large, feathered wings.  Your body is too heavy to be able to fly, but you can use them to slow your descent during a fall, and will not take falling damage under any circumstances.

data.name: Insect Wings
data.description: You have a pair of large, translucent wings.  They are too small to lift you, but are powerful enough to greatly speed your movement, with some effort and noise.

data.name: Mouth Tentacles
data.description: A set of tentacles surrounds your mouth.  They allow you to eat twice as fast.  Slightly decreases wet penalties.

data.name: Mandibles
data.description: A set of insect-like mandibles have grown around your mouth.  They allow you to eat faster and provide a slicing unarmed attack, but prevent you from wearing mouthwear.  Slightly reduces wet effects.

data.name: Folding Fangs
data.description: Your mandibles have developed extensible fangs, allowing you to bite quickly or ensure your venom goes home, as desired.  Activate to extend or retract your fangs.

data.name: Canine Ears
data.description: Your ears have extended into long, pointed ones, like those of a canine.  They enhance your hearing, allowing you to hear at greater distances.

data.name: Lupine Ears
data.description: Your hearing has evolved further and is now on par with wolves.  You can hear things significantly farther away.

data.name: Feline Ears
data.description: Your ears have extended into long, pointed, velvety ones, like those of a feline.  You find it easier to tune in on sounds from afar.

data.name: Ursine Ears
data.description: Your ears have grown longer and rounder, much like those of a bear.  You can hear things a little farther away.

data.name: Pointed Ears
data.description: Your upper earlobes have grown noticeably higher.  Fortunately, they don't get in the way of your headgear, much.  Unfortunately, they also don't seem to help your hearing any.

data.name: Web Walker
data.description: Your body excretes very fine amounts of a chemical which prevents you from sticking to webs.  Walking through webs does not affect you at all.

data.name: Web Spinner
data.description: Your body produces and anchors webbing.  Too bad you can't seem to control the process.  There is a chance that you will leave webs in your wake.

data.name: Web Weaver
data.description: You've developed the necessary anatomy and techniques to control your web-generation.  Activate this to start or stop weaving webs.

data.name: Web Diver
data.description: Your webbing is easily strong enough to support your weight.  You'll use it to descend down any sheer drops you may encounter.

data.name: Rope Webs
data.description: With spinnerets like THESE, who needs rope?!  Activate to produce rope.

spawn_item.message: You spin a rope from your silk.

data.name: Whiskers
data.description: You have a handsome set of feline whiskers around your mouth.  These make you more aware of vibrations in the air, and improve your ability to dodge very slightly.

data.name: Wiry Whiskers
data.description: You have a set of prominent rodent-like whiskers around your mouth.  These make you more aware of vibrations in the air, and improve your ability to dodge slightly.

data.name: Fat Deposits
data.description: You've put on some additional weight around your body.  It slows you down a little, but helps your swimming and warmth.

data.name: Inconveniently Large
data.description: You have grown noticeably taller and broader.  Much of it is useful muscle mass (Strength +2), but you find it throws off your balance and you get in your own way (+10 torso and arm encumbrance).

data.name: Large
data.description: You carry your rugged body with the dignity you deserve.  Strength +2.

data.name: Freakishly Huge
data.description: You have grown even more massive, to the point where you cannot usefully fit into human-sized clothing or vehicles.  Much of it is powerful muscle mass (Strength +4), but it's a real pain to haul around.

data.name: Huge
data.description: Your cardiovascular system has caught up with your muscular physique, so who needs pathetic human cars?  Strength +4.

data.name: Strong
data.description: Your muscles are a little stronger.  Strength + 1

data.name: Very Strong
data.description: Your muscles are stronger.  Strength + 2

data.name: Extremely Strong
data.description: Your muscles are much stronger.  Strength + 4

data.name: Insanely Strong
data.description: Your muscles are noticeably bulging.  Strength + 7

data.name: Prime Strength
data.description: Your muscles are perfectly developed.

data.name: Dextrous
data.description: You are a little nimbler.  Dexterity + 1

data.name: Very Dextrous
data.description: You are nimbler.  Dexterity + 2

data.name: Extremely Dextrous
data.description: You are nimble and quick.  Dexterity + 4

data.name: Insanely Dextrous
data.description: You are much nimbler than before.  Dexterity + 7

data.name: Prime Dexterity
data.description: You're perfectly coordinated.

data.name: Smart
data.description: You are a little smarter.  Intelligence + 1

data.name: Very Smart
data.description: You are smarter.  Intelligence + 2

data.name: Extremely Smart
data.description: You are much smarter, and your skull bulges slightly.  Intelligence + 4

data.name: Insanely Smart
data.description: Your skull bulges noticeably with your impressive brain.  Intelligence + 7

data.name: Prime Intelligence
data.description: You understand almost everything about which you think, with minimal effort.

data.name: Distributed Neurology
data.description: Your brain has evolved beyond human imagination.  You'll show them the REAL meaning of 'gray goo'!

data.name: Perceptive
data.description: Your senses are a little keener.  Perception + 1

data.name: Very Perceptive
data.description: Your senses are keener.  Perception + 2

data.name: Extremely Perceptive
data.description: Your senses are much keener.  Perception + 4

data.name: Insanely Perceptive
data.description: You can sense things you never imagined.  Perception + 7

data.name: Prime Perception
data.description: Your senses are keenly honed.

data.name: Sensory Disintegration
data.description: Your sense organs are all over the place: eyes extending and retracting, 'ears' of various shapes migrating about, and taste & smell are uncontrollable.  The world is a horrible mixup.  Ugh!

data.name: Distributed Senses
data.description: You can now extend and reabsorb sensory organs at will, and can therefore ignore most shocks that would overwhelm lesser beings.

data.name: Metallassomaiphile
data.//: name courtesy of wiktionary's Greek for 'mutate'.  Greek-speakers, feel free to correct the term
data.description: Just thinking of mutagen (such a lovely word!  'Mutagen'.  Perfect!) makes you thirsty.  And you so love your new parts.  You simply must have more mutagen!

data.name: Head Bumps
data.description: You have a pair of bumps on your skull.

data.name: Slit Nostrils
data.description: You have a flattened nose and thin slits for nostrils, giving you a lizard-like appearance.  This makes breathing slightly difficult and increases mouth encumbrance by 10.

data.name: Forked Tongue
data.description: Your tongue is forked, like that of a reptile.  This has no effect.

data.name: Bulging Eyes
data.description: Your eyes bulge out several inches from your skull.  This does not affect your vision in any way.

data.name: Mouth Flaps
data.description: Skin tabs and odd flaps of skin surround your mouth.  They don't affect your eating, but are unpleasant to look at.

data.name: Wing Stubs
data.description: You have a pair of stubby little wings projecting from your shoulderblades.  They can be wiggled at will, but are useless.

data.name: Bat Wings
data.description: You have a pair of large, leathery wings.  You can move them a little, but they are useless, and in fact put you off balance, reducing your ability to dodge slightly.

data.name: Butterfly Wings
data.description: You have a very large and very beautiful pair of brightly-colored wings.  They can't lift you, and they make balancing tricky, but they certainly catch air and attention!

data.name: Pale Skin
data.description: Your skin is rather pale.

data.name: Spots
data.description: Your skin is covered in a pattern of red spots.

data.name: Smelly
data.description: You smell awful.  Monsters that track scent will find you very easily, and humans will react poorly.

data.name: Deformed
data.description: You're minorly deformed.  Some people will react badly to your appearance.

data.name: Badly Deformed
data.description: You're hideously deformed.  Some people will have a strong negative reaction to your appearance.

data.name: Grotesque
data.description: Your visage is disgusting and liable to induce vomiting.  People will not want to interact with you unless they have a very good reason to.

data.name: Beautiful
data.description: You're a real head-turner.  Some people will react well to your appearance, and most people have an easier time trusting you.

data.name: Very Beautiful
data.description: You are a vision of beauty.  Some people will react very well to your looks, and most people will trust you immediately.

data.name: Glorious
data.description: You are incredibly beautiful.  People cannot help themselves for your charms, and will do whatever they can to please you.

data.name: Snout
data.description: Your face and jaw have begun...changing.  Masks and such fit OK, but you're noticeably mutated.

data.name: Bovine Snout
data.description: Your face resembles that of a bull, with a significant snout.  It looks fearsome but prevents you from wearing mouthgear.

data.name: Lupine Muzzle
data.description: Your jaw and nose have extended into a wolfish muzzle.  It lends itself to biting in combat and looks impressive, but prevents you from wearing mouthgear.

data.name: Ursine Muzzle
data.description: Your jaw and nose have extended into a bearish muzzle.  You could bite with it, and it looks impressive, but it prevents you from wearing mouthgear.

data.name: Ratlike Muzzle
data.description: Your face and jaw have extended, giving you an alert and attentive appearance.

data.name: Reptilian Muzzle
data.description: Your face and jaws are a shorter version of those found on alligators.  They look NASTY-as do the bite wounds they can inflict-but prevent you from wearing mouthgear.

attacks.attack_text_u: You bite a chunk out of %s

data.name: Proboscis
data.description: You've gotten rid of that terribly imprecise mouth and now imbibe your food like a proper person.  Chewing was tiresome anyway.

data.name: Hollow Bones
data.description: You have Avian Bone Syndrome--your bones are nearly hollow.  Your body is very light as a result, enabling you to move and attack 20% faster, but also frail; you can carry 40% less, and bashing attacks injure you more.

data.name: Nausea
