data.description: A short-sleeved cotton shirt.

data.name: t-shirt
data.description: A short-sleeved cotton shirt.

snippet_category.text: A short-sleeved cotton shirt with the text "chown -R us ~your/base" printed on the front.

data.name: tunic
data.description: A simple garment long enough to cover down to the knees.

data.name: rag tunic
data.description: A poorly made long tunic with a string tied around the waist to keep it all in place.

data.name: turban
data.description: Rags worn around the head.

data.name: tuxedo
data.description: A full-body tuxedo.  Makes the apocalypse feel a little more classy.

data.name: compression top
data.description: Nylon sportswear that clings to your chest and maintains body temperature.

data.name: compression shorts
data.description: Nylon sportswear that clings to your upper legs, aiding muscle tone and maintaining warmth.

data.name: undershirt
data.description: A simple white undershirt.  Worn beneath your regular clothes, it provides a little extra warmth.

data.name: union suit
data.description: A one-piece suit of full-body long underwear that helps to maintain body temperature.  It laces closed in the front.

data.name: pair of leather vambraces
data.description: A pair of light leather arm guards, made for archery.

data.name: wedding veil
data.description: A lacy white wedding veil.

data.name: utility vest
data.description: A light vest covered in pockets and straps for storage.

data.name: leather vest
data.description: A vest made from thick leather.  Offers excellent protection from cuts.

data.name: armored leather vest
data.description: An armored vest made from thick leather and metal plates.  Cumbersome, but offers excellent protection from harm.

data.name: waistcoat
data.description: An elegant waistcoat.  Ideal for those occasions when wearing only a shirt would be too casual and a suit would be just overdoing it.

data.name: wetsuit
data.description: A full-body neoprene wetsuit.

data.name: pair of swimming gloves
data.description: A pair of very flexible neoprene-silicone rubber gloves, suitable for underwater use.

data.name: wetsuit hood
data.description: A neoprene hood, commonly worn by divers.

data.name: spring suit
data.description: A long-sleeved spring wetsuit with pink color details and cleavage-enhancing, hip-accentuating construction.  Not as protective as a full-body suit, but also less restrictive.

data.name: pair of army winter gloves
data.description: A pair of padded gloves.  Favored by the military.

data.name: army winter jacket
data.description: A tough hooded jacket with lots of pockets, thickly padded for warmth.  Favored by the military.

data.name: army winter pants
data.description: A tough pair of pants lined with pockets, thickly padded for warmth.  Favored by the military.

data.name: wolf suit
data.description: A full body fursuit in the form of an anthropomorphic wolf.  It is quite encumbering and has little storage but is very warm.

data.name: wool hoodie
data.description: A wool hooded shirt.  It offers decent protection against the cold.  The front pocket offers both storage room and shelter for your hands.

data.name: wool suit
data.description: An encumbering wool suit covered in nice patterns.  It looks like a full body armor but it only protects against cold, sadly.

data.name: wrist watch
data.description: A simple wristwatch on a plastic band.  Tells the time and has an alarm clock feature.

data.name: winter survivor suit
data.description: A warm and heavy home-built combination armor made from a reinforced bulletproof vest and an insulated jumpsuit made out of leather.  Protects from the elements as well as from harm.

data.name: XL survivor suit
data.description: A massive home-built combination armor made from a bulletproof vest and a reinforced jumpsuit made out of leather.  Protects from the elements as well as from harm.

data.name: zubon
data.description: Plain white zubon for use in martial arts.

data.name: Adrenaline Pump CBM
data.description: A stimulator system has been implanted alongside your adrenal glands, allowing you to trigger your body's adrenaline response at the cost of some bionic power.

data.name: Active Defense System CBM
data.description: A thin forcefield surrounds your body, continually draining power.  Anything attempting to penetrate this field has a chance of being deflected at the cost of more energy.  Melee attacks will be stopped more often than bullets.

data.name: Advanced Microreactor CBM
data.description: Storage tank and stripped down plutonium reactor, allowing generation of power from small amounts of plutonium.  This one has been heavily upgraded.  Warning: minimal radiation shielding.

data.name: Alarm System CBM
data.description: A motion-detecting alarm system will notice almost all movement within a fifteen-foot radius, and will silently alert you.  This is very useful during sleep, or if you suspect a cloaked pursuer.

data.name: Arms Alloy Plating CBM
data.description: The flesh on your arms has been replaced by a strong armor, protecting you greatly.

data.name: Protective Lenses CBM
data.description: Your eye sockets have been sealed with highly protective mirrored lenses and your tear ducts have been re-routed to your mouth.  When you cry, you must spit out or swallow your tears.

data.name: Head Alloy Plating CBM
data.description: The flesh on your head has been replaced by a strong armor, protecting both your head and jaw regions.

data.name: Legs Alloy Plating CBM
data.description: The flesh on your legs has been replaced by a strong armor, protecting you greatly.

data.name: Torso Alloy Plating CBM
data.description: The flesh on your torso has been replaced by a strong armor, protecting you greatly.

data.name: Battery System CBM
data.description: You have a battery draining attachment, and thus can make use of the energy contained in normal, everyday batteries.  Use 'E' to consume batteries.  Can be toggled on and off at will.

data.name: Monomolecular Blade CBM
data.description: A deadly foot-long blade made of advanced material now resides inside your forearm, capable of being extended through the back of your wrist at the cost of a small amount of power.  Though exceptionally sharp, it will prevent you from holding anything else while extended.

data.name: Fusion Blaster Arm CBM
data.description: Your left arm has been replaced by a heavy-duty fusion blaster!  You may use your energy banks to fire a damaging heat ray; however, you are unable to use or carry two-handed items, and may only fire handguns.

data.name: Blood Analysis CBM
data.description: Small sensors have been implanted in your heart, allowing you to analyze your blood.  This will detect many illnesses, drugs, and other conditions.

data.name: Blood Filter CBM
data.description: A filtration system in your heart allows you to actively filter out chemical impurities, primarily drugs.  It will have limited impact on viruses.  Note that it is not a targeted filter; ALL drugs in your system will be affected.

data.name: Cable Charger System CBM
data.description: You have a complex port mounted above your hip.  While active, it will drain power through a jumper cable held on your person.

data.name: Subdermal Carbon Filament CBM
data.description: Lying just beneath your skin is a thin armor made of carbon nanotubes.  This reduces bashing damage by 2 and cutting damage by 4.

data.name: Chain Lightning CBM
data.description: Your body is equipped with a chain lightning generator, allowing you to emit a blast of lightning at a target, leaving a trail of lightning in its wake, jumping to additional targets within 4 tiles of the previous target.

data.name: Bionic Claws CBM
data.description: Vicious claws have been installed inside your fingers, allowing you to extend and retract them at the cost of a small amount of power.  These do considerable cutting damage, but prevent you from holding anything else while extended.

data.name: Internal Climate Control CBM
data.description: Throughout your body lies a network of thermal piping which eases the effects of high and low ambient temperatures.

data.name: Cloaking System CBM
data.description: This high-power system uses a set of cameras and LEDs to make you blend into your background, rendering you fully invisible to normal vision.  However, you may be detected by infrared, sonar, etc.

data.name: Close Quarters Battle CBM
data.description: Databanks and processors loaded with extensive martial arts combat programs are integrated directly into your spinal column.  While active, your close combat skills are superseded by the machine's programming.  You have the option of activating Karate, Judo, Muay Thai, or Bio Combatives algorithms.  The cybernetic disconnect prevents you from improving the affected combat skills while this bionic is active.  However, with extended use in combat, it is possible to learn the chosen martial art.

data.name: Wired Reflexes CBM
data.description: Your reaction time has been greatly enhanced with bionic nerve stimulators, giving you a +2 bonus to dexterity.

data.name: Expanded Digestive System CBM
data.description: You have been outfitted with three synthetic stomachs and industrial-grade intestines.  Not only can you extract much more nutrition from food, but you are highly resistant to foodborne illness, and can sometimes eat rotten food.

data.name: Enhanced Hearing CBM
data.description: When this bionic is active, your hearing will be drastically improved, allowing you to hear ten times better than the average person.  Additionally, high-intensity sounds will be automatically dampened before they can damage your hearing.  You can also toggle those sound dampeners on demand, should you wish to reduce the effect of the bionic or become completely deaf.

data.name: Directional EMP CBM
data.description: Mounted in the palms of your hand are small parabolic EMP field generators.  You may use power to fire a short-ranged blast which will disable electronics and robots.

data.name: Ethanol Burner CBM
data.description: You burn alcohol as fuel in an extremely efficient reaction.  However, you will still suffer the inebriating effects of the substance.

data.name: Aero-Evaporator CBM
data.description: This unit draws moisture from the surrounding air, which then is poured from a fingertip in the form of water.  It may fail in very dry environments.

data.name: Diamond Cornea CBM
data.description: Your vision is greatly enhanced, giving you a +2 bonus to perception.

data.name: Telescopic Eyes CBM
data.description: Much of the material in your inner eye has been removed and replaced with an array of high-powered, auto-focusing lenses.  You can now see much farther and more clearly than before, any vision problems you might have had are now gone.

data.name: Facial Distortion CBM
data.description: Through controlled application of electrochemical impulses, you are capable of altering your facial structure so as to subtly affect the reactions of others.  This grants a bonus to all social interactions.

data.name: Dielectric Capacitance System CBM
data.description: Throughout your body lies a network of miniature piezoelectric capacitors which can be charged with bionic power to temporarily protect you from external electrical discharge.

data.name: Fingerhack CBM
data.description: One of your fingers has an electrohack embedded in it; an all-purpose hacking unit used to override control panels and the like (but not computers).  Skill in computers is important, and a failed use may damage your circuits.

data.name: Flashbang Generator CBM
data.description: Light emitting diodes integrated into your skin can release a flash comparable to a flashbang grenade, blinding nearby enemies.  Speakers integrated into your body mimic the loud sound, deafening those nearby.

data.name: Cranial Flashlight CBM
data.description: Mounted between your eyes is a small but powerful LED flashlight.

data.name: Internal Furnace CBM
data.description: You can burn nearly any organic material as fuel (use 'E'), recharging your power level.  Some materials will burn better than others.  Can be toggled on and off at will.

data.name: Integrated Dosimeter CBM
data.description: Small radiation sensors have been implanted throughout your body, allowing you to analyze your level of absorbed radiation.  They will also alert you whenever exposed to environmental radiation.

data.name: Oxygenator CBM
data.description: A complex oxygen delivery system.  Improves the ability to extract oxygen from air and allows extracting it from water.  Will automatically turn on when drowning.  Turn on to recharge stamina faster, at moderate power cost.

data.name: Terranian Sonar CBM
data.description: Your feet are equipped with precision sonar equipment, allowing you to detect the movements of creatures below the ground.

data.name: Heat Drain CBM
data.description: While fighting unarmed against a warm-blooded opponent, there is a chance that a successful hit will drain body heat, inflicting a small amount of extra damage, and increasing your power reserves slightly.

data.name: Thermal Dissipation CBM
data.description: Powerful heatsinks and supermaterials are woven into your flesh.  While powered, this system will prevent heat damage up to 2000 degrees Fahrenheit.  Note that this does not affect your internal temperature.

data.name: Hydraulic Muscles CBM
data.description: While activated, your muscles will be greatly enhanced, increasing your strength by 20.

data.name: Infrared Vision CBM
data.description: Your range of vision extends into the infrared, allowing you to see warm-blooded creatures in the dark, and even through walls.

data.name: Cerebral Booster CBM
data.description: Your brain has been enhanced with bionic coprocessors, giving you a +2 bonus to intelligence.

data.name: Finger-Mounted Laser CBM
data.description: One of your fingers has a small high-powered laser embedded in it.  This long range weapon is not incredibly damaging, but is very accurate, and has the potential to start fires.

data.name: Leukocyte Breeder System CBM
data.description: You are equipped with bionic stimulators which augment your haematopoiesis system, allowing you to accelerate white blood cell production using bionic power.  It is supposed to run continuously and may cause unpleasant side effects when turned off.

data.name: Mini-Flamethrower CBM
data.description: The index fingers of both hands have powerful fire starters which extend from the tip.

data.name: Fingerpick CBM
data.description: One of your fingers has an electronic lockpick embedded in it.  This automatic system will quickly unlock all but the most advanced key locks without any skill required on the part of the user.

data.name: Electromagnetic Unit CBM
data.description: Embedded in your hand is a powerful electromagnet, allowing you to pull items made of iron over short distances.

data.name: Nictating Membrane CBM
data.description: Your eyes have a thin membrane that closes over your eyes while underwater, negating any vision penalties.

data.name: Enhanced Memory Banks CBM
data.description: Your memory has been enhanced with small quantum storage drives.  Any time you start to forget a skill, if this bionic is active you will retain all knowledge, at the cost of a small amount of power.

data.name: Metabolic Interchange CBM
data.description: Your digestive system and power supply are interconnected.  Energy drains will be regularly counteracted by increasing hunger.  Can be toggled on and off at will.

data.name: Weather Reader CBM
data.description: A multitude of scientific instruments and sensors collect environmental data.  The data is compiled and presented as a simple readout of the current weather.  It also passively tells you your external temperature.

data.name: Repair Nanobots CBM
data.description: Inside your body is a fleet of tiny dormant robots.  Once charged from your energy banks, they will flit about your body, repairing damage and stopping bleeding.

data.name: Artificial Night Generator CBM
data.description: Destructive interference eliminates all light within a 15 tile radius.

data.name: Implanted Night Vision CBM
data.description: Your eyes have been modified to amplify existing light, allowing you to see in the dark.

data.name: Offensive Defense System CBM
data.description: A thin forcefield surrounds your body, continually draining power.  This field does not deflect penetration, but rather delivers a very strong shock, damaging unarmed attackers and those with a conductive weapon.

data.name: Sensory Dulling CBM
data.description: Your nervous system is wired to allow you to inhibit the signals of pain, allowing you to dull your senses at will.  However, the use of this system may cause delayed reaction time and drowsiness.

data.name: Plutonium Filter CBM
data.description: System of tanks and filters to extract plutonium more rapidly from slurry for a microreactor.

data.name: Power Armor Interface CBM
data.description: Interfaces your power system with the internal charging port on suits of power armor.

data.name: Power Armor Mk. II Interface CBM
data.description: Interfaces your power system with the internal charging port on suits of power armor.  The Mk. II was designed by DoubleTech Inc., to meet the popularity of the Mk. II power armor series.

data.name: Power Storage CBM
data.description: Compact Bionics Module that upgrades your power capacity by 100 units.  Having at least one of these is a prerequisite to using powered bionics.  You will also need a power supply, found in another CBM.

data.name: Power Storage CBM Mk. II
data.description: Compact Bionics Module developed at DoubleTech Industries as a replacement for the highly successful Power Storage CBM.  Increases your power capacity by 250 units.

data.name: Probability Travel CBM
data.description: Increases your body's wavelength, allowing you to quantum tunnel through walls, reappearing on the other side.  Power drain in standby is minimal, but each tile tunneled through costs 250 bionic power.

data.name: Air Filtration System CBM
data.description: Implanted in your trachea is an advanced filtration system.  If toxins find their way into your windpipe, the filter will attempt to remove them.

data.name: Radiation Scrubber System CBM
data.description: A system of advanced piezomechanical blood filters have been implanted throughout your body, allowing you to purge yourself of absorbed radiation at the cost of some bionic power.

data.name: Railgun CBM
data.description: EM field generators in your arms double the range and damage of thrown iron and steel objects at a cost of 1 power per throw, causing them to leave a trail of electricity that can cause additional damage.

data.name: Fingertip Razors CBM
data.description: You possess razor-sharp retractable claws underneath your fingernails, ten double-edged blades four centimeters in length that do a small amount of unarmed slashing damage whenever your fingertips are uncovered.

data.name: Internal Microreactor CBM
data.description: Storage tank and stripped down plutonium reactor, allowing generation of power from small amounts of plutonium.  Warning: minimal radiation shielding.

data.name: Microreactor Upgrade CBM
data.description: A kit for upgrading a pre-installed microreactor with enhanced maximum yield and automatic radiation scrubbing.

data.name: Recycler Unit CBM
data.description: Your digestive system has been outfitted with a series of filters and processors, allowing you to reclaim waste liquid and, to a lesser degree, nutrients.  The net effect is a greatly reduced need to eat and drink.

data.name: Remote Controller CBM
data.description: A small module connected to your brain allows you to interface with nearby devices with wireless capabilities.

data.name: Sonic Resonator CBM
data.description: Your entire body may resonate at very high power, creating a short-range shockwave.  While it will not do much damage to flexible creatures, stiff items such as walls, doors, and even robots will be severely damaged.

data.name: Olfactory Mask CBM
data.description: While this system is powered, your body will produce very little odor, making it nearly impossible for creatures to track you by scent.

data.name: Scent Vision CBM
data.description: While this system is powered, you're able to visually sense your own scent, making it possible for you to recognize your surroundings even if you can't see it.

data.name: Electroshock Unit CBM
data.description: While fighting unarmed, or with a weapon that conducts electricity, there is a chance that a successful hit will shock your opponent, inflicting extra damage and disabling them temporarily at the cost of some energy.

data.name: Shockwave Generator CBM
data.description: You generate a powerful shockwave, knocking back all nearby creatures.  Targets are stunned briefly, take damage and additional stun upon impact with impassable terrain, and knockback any creatures they collide with.

data.name: Solar Panels CBM
data.description: You have a few solar panels installed.  While in direct sunlight, your power level will slowly recharge.

data.name: Synaptic Accelerator CBM
data.description: Your nervous system has been enhanced with bionic stimulators, giving you a 10% boost to your speed.

data.name: Internal Storage CBM
data.description: Space inside your chest cavity has been converted into a storage area.  You may carry an extra 2 liters of volume.

data.name: Muscle Augmentation CBM
data.description: Your muscular system has been enhanced with myomer fibers, giving you a +2 bonus to strength.

data.name: Anti-Glare Compensators CBM
data.description: Your eyes have high-power, quick-reacting transition lenses installed over them, negating any glare penalties and protecting you from bright flashes including those of a welder.  Additionally you can toggle them to block out all light.

data.name: Targeting System CBM
data.description: Your eyes are equipped with range finders, and their movement is synced with that of your arms, to a degree.  Shots you fire will be much more accurate, particularly at long range.

data.name: Teleportation Unit CBM
data.description: This highly experimental unit folds space over short distances, instantly transporting your body up to 25 feet at the cost of much power.  Note that prolonged or frequent use may have dangerous side effects.

data.name: Time Dilation CBM
data.description: At an immense cost of power, you may increase your body speed and reactions dramatically, essentially freezing time.  You are still delicate, however, and violent or rapid movements may damage you due to friction.

data.name: Integrated Toolset CBM
data.description: Implanted in your hands and fingers is a complete tool set - screwdriver, hammer, wrench, and heating elements.  You can use this in place of many tools when crafting.

data.name: Joint Torsion Ratchet CBM
data.description: Your joints have been equipped with torsion ratchets that generate power slowly when you move.

data.name: Uncanny Dodge CBM
data.description: Your nervous system has been augmented with bionic processors, allowing you to dodge attacks beyond normal human capability, including bullets.

data.name: Unified Power System CBM
data.description: A UPS fully integrated with your bionic power system.  Allows you to run devices requiring a UPS off of your internal power, which is much more efficient than standard battery power.

data.name: Internal Chronometer CBM
data.description: You have been equipped with an internal atomic clock, ensuring that you will always know the current time.

data.name: Water Extraction Unit CBM
data.description: Nanotubes embedded in the palm of your hand will pump any available fluid out of a dead body, cleanse it of impurities and convert it into drinkable water.  You must, however, have a container to store the water in.

data.name: sulfur
data.description: A handful of yellow grains of pure sulfur.  Primarily used to make battery acid, sulfur is sometimes used as fuel for explosives.  Can be burned to produce acidic smoke, that is deadly to bacteria and humans alike, or oxidized to make paper-bleaching agents.
data.//: NOTE: Weights are given for ONE UNIT.  The actual weight of a spawned pile of sulfur is now 5*100 = 500g.  For reference, 1 C:DDA unit of volume is around a quarter of a liter (calculated from the weight of water).

data.name: chunk of sulfur
data.description: A large chunk of pure sulfur.  Break it up to use it.

data.name: cement
data.description: Portland is most likely long gone, but its memory persists in cement.  This ubiquitous binder can be used for all kinds of advanced masonry.  Just add water.

data.name: limestone
data.description: A handful of small chunks of limestone.  Useful for experiments at science fairs, but pretty useless as ammo.  Maybe something could be crafted from this stuff…

data.name: quicklime
data.description: The product of burning limestone, this white powder is a crucial ingredient in making cement.  That said, it is also extremely caustic and will cause severe burns to any tissue it comes in contact with.  This property could probably be exploited...

data.name: sand
data.description: A handful of New England sand.  If you had a stoked furnace, you could turn it into glass.  Otherwise, it's only good for making cement.

data.name: limestone shard
data.description: A small shard of limestone.  Pretty flimsy and not much of a weapon, but its alkaline properties may yet find some use.

data.name: rock salt
data.description: A handful of rock salt crystals.  Could be refined into table salt.

data.name: bleach
data.description: This is sodium hypochlorite, a common household cleaning agent.  It is highly unsafe to drink.
data.//: $0.67 per charge for a $10 15-charge gallon of bleach.

data.name: ammonia
data.description: This is ammonium hydroxide, a common household cleaning agent.  It is highly unsafe to drink.

data.name: liquid fertilizer
data.description: A nutrient rich elixir for plants.

data.name: commercial fertilizer
data.description: Nutrient rich granules for plants.
data.//: This comes out as one charge in the bag, and the price is accurate-KA101

data.name: fungicide
data.//: Previously 10 doses to a gram, so about 400 to the pound.
data.description: Agricultural grade chemical anti-fungal powder designed to destroy infections in plants.

data.name: salt water
data.description: Water with salt added.  Not good for drinking.

data.name: acid water
data.description: Water collected during an acid rainstorm.  Don't drink it.  Boiling it concentrates the acid.

data.name: weak acid water
data.description: A mixture of rain and acid rain.  Don't drink it.  Boiling it concentrates the acid.

data.name: concentrated acid
data.description: Concentrated acid.  Don't drink it.

data.name: sewage sample
data.description: A sample of sewage from a treatment plant.  Gross.

data.name: aluminum powder
data.description: A handful of finely ground aluminum powder.  This strong reducing agent was used in combination with various oxidants for chemical welding and explosives alike.  Just before the Cataclysm, however, it was the basis of virtually all commercial metallic-hued paints and anti-corrosive coatings.

data.name: zinc powder
data.description: A handful of zinc powder.  While commercially used mostly in cosmetics and for paints, hobbyists used to mix it with sulfur to make basic rocket fuel / smokescreen.  When treated with a strong acid, it will produce hydrogen.

data.name: sulfuric acid
data.description: Sulfuric acid: viscous, foul-smelling and extremely corrosive, particularly to organic matter and evil clowns.  Although used to prepare a number of chemicals, it is mostly known as battery acid, due to its widest commercial application.

data.name: acetone
data.description: Acetone, best known as the primary constituent of most nail polish removers.  Flammable and can be easily used for potent home-made explosives, as demonstrated by the terrorist attacks of 2016.

data.name: nitric acid
data.description: Nitric acid, a strong oxidant and extremely corrosive material.  Mainly used in the production of synthetic fertilizers, for etching of circuit boards and in woodworking.  Remains quite useful both for making a vast array of pyrotechnic and explosive agents and as a direct weapon: not many beings enjoy being doused in nitric acid.

data.name: chromium oxide
data.description: A handful of chromium oxide pellets.  This substance, typically known as the only stable green pigment for paints, is also a mild oxidizer, which can be mixed with aluminum powder to make thermite for welding.  If one had access to a CVD machine and a laboratory worth of reagents, they might be able to produce very durable ceramic layers.

data.name: calcium carbide
data.description: A handful of calcium carbide chunks, giving off a faint, garlic-like smell.  Commercially, calcium carbide was used for on-the-spot manufacture of acetylene and historically to power acetylene lamps.  If mixed with water and sealed, it will explode with little strength, but with relatively loud noise and could maybe be used as a decoy...

data.name: hexamine
data.description: A handful of waxy hexamine tablets.  This ubiquitous fuel was used to start up almost every garden grill and no 'real' camping trip could do its cooking without it, until the Cataclysm.  Nowadays, it is even more valuable then before, being the key component in the preparation of several military-grade explosives.

data.name: hydrogen peroxide (concentrated)
data.description: Concentrated hydrogen peroxide is a powerful oxidant, violently decomposing in contact with most reducing agents.  Can be used as rocket fuel or to make high explosives.  Causes severe burns to any organic matter and may ignite it on contact.

data.name: ammonium nitrate
data.description: A handful of ammonium nitrate.  This white, crystalline powder is commonly used as a component of fertilizers and explosives.  Could also be dissolved in water to sharply lower its temperature, but is there any use for this quality in this new world?

data.name: saltpeter
data.description: A handful of saltpeter.  Sometimes used as a fertilizer, this ubiquitous nitrate is the principal constituent of black gunpowder and simple rocket propellants, such as rocket candy.

data.name: niter
data.description: A large crystal of niter, the mineral form of potassium nitrate.  It can be processed into saltpeter.

data.name: aluminum sulfate
data.description: Several crystals of aluminum sulfate.  Historically, an agent for purifying water and as molluscicide, due to the fact that it degenerates their slime.  Just before the Cataclysm, its main uses were for adjusting the acidity of the soil and as an additive to baking powder.  If mixed with a strong acid, it could be used to saturate the soil with aluminum, causing all but the most resistant of plants to wither and die.

data.name: acetic acid
data.description: Concentrated acetic acid, typically used as a chemical reagent and antifungal agent.  Despite its horrid smell, it was used to prepare several types of perfumes, but would making perfume not be too ...fancy for postapocalyptic New England?

data.name: thermite
data.description: A handful of silvery-greenish powder, produced by mixing aluminum and chromium oxide.  This mixture, burning at a constant pace and at extremely high temperature, was once used for on-the-spot welding.  Can be used as an incendiary material in a pinch.
data.//: Weight might not be accurate.

data.name: ANFO
data.description: Several brownish pellets that were made by absorbing organic fuel on ammonium nitrate.  This ammonium nitrate–fuel oil or ANFO, as it is called, mixture is a common industrial explosive due to its stability and low price.  Burns fast, but needs an explosive primer to detonate...

data.name: black gunpowder
data.description: A handful of black gunpowder, made by mixing charcoal and sulfur with saltpeter.  Pretty useless for making modern cartridges, as the soot produced when it burns will quickly clog any firearm, but it could be used to make some vicious bombs.

data.name: RDX
data.description: Several off-white crystals of RDX or hexogen--a military-grade, shelf-stable high explosive.  Can be cast into shaped charges or mixed with scrap to pepper the blast area with high-velocity shrapnel.

data.name: HMTD
data.description: Hexamine peroxide: this fine, yellowish powder is a powerful primary explosive, used to initiate detonation of more stable explosives, such as RDX.  Relatively stable, but best not store it for too long...

data.name: rocket fuel
data.description: A chunk of a zinc powder and sulfur mixture, bound together by superglue, that can be used as an impromptu rocket fuel.

data.name: water purification tablet
data.description: Intended for the clarification and disinfection of unsafe drinking water, these halazone-based purification tablets remove dangerous contaminants using powerful chemicals.  The label says to use one tablet per unit of water.

data.name: hickory root
data.description: A root from a hickory tree.  It has an earthy smell.

data.name: hickory nuts
data.description: A handful of hard nuts from a hickory tree, still in their shell.

data.name: concrete

data.name: log

data.name: splintered wood
data.description: A splintered piece of wood, could be used as a skewer or for kindling.

data.name: bone skewer
data.description: A thin skewer carved from bone.  Sadly, it won't make squirrel on a stick taste better.

data.name: burnt out torch

data.name: dead flare
data.description: This is a spent magnesium flare.  It is essentially trash.

data.name: spring
data.description: A large, heavy-duty spring.  Expands with significant force when compressed.

data.name: lawnmower
data.description: A motorized pushmower that seems to be broken.  You could take it apart if you had a wrench.

data.name: damaged tent
data.description: A small tent, just big enough to fit a person comfortably.  This tent is broken and cannot be deployed.

data.name: large damaged tent
data.description: A family sized tent, very bulky but with plenty of space.  This tent is broken and can not be deployed.

data.name: heating element
data.description: A heating element, like the ones used in hotplates or kettles.

data.name: television
data.description: A large cathode ray tube television, full of delicious electronics.

data.name: pilot light
data.description: A pilot light from a gas-burning device, this particular one is a simple piezoelectric igniter.

data.name: toaster
data.description: A small two slice toaster, not much use as anything but spare parts

data.name: microwave
data.description: A home microwave, has probably seen its share of baked beans.  Good for scrap parts.

data.name: laptop computer
data.description: A broken laptop, basically a paperweight now.

data.name: broken eyebot
data.description: A broken eyebot.  Much less threatening now that it won't be calling for backup.  Could be gutted for parts.

data.name: broken skitterbot
data.description: A broken skitterbot.  Much less threatening now that it lies limp on solid ground.  Could be gutted for parts.

data.name: broken police bot
data.description: A broken police bot.  Much less threatening now that it's quiet and still.  Could be gutted for parts.

data.name: broken riot control bot
data.description: A broken riot control bot.  Much less threatening now that it's out of gas.  Could be gutted for parts.

data.name: broken miner bot

data.name: broken tribot
data.description: A broken tribot.  Now that its legs lie broken and immobile, the world seems a little less threatening.  Could be gutted for parts.

data.name: broken tank drone
data.description: A broken tank drone.  Still looks intimidating despite being permanently inoperative, possibly due to the sheer size and mass.  Could be gutted for parts.

data.name: broken manhack

data.name: broken grenade hack

data.name: broken mininuke hack
data.description: A broken magenta hack.  Just looking at the wreck makes you shiver.  Could be gutted for parts.

data.name: broken tear gas hack

data.name: broken EMP hack

data.name: broken C-4 hack

data.name: transponder circuit

data.name: signal receiver

data.name: high-quality lens
data.description: A high-quality lens, useful for focusing or diffusing light.  Might be useful for starting a fire.

data.name: pair of tinted glass
data.description: A pair of small darkened glass, like the one that sunglasses are made of.

data.name: burnt out bionic
data.description: Once a valuable bionic implant, it has not held up well under repeated use.  This object has been destroyed by excessive electric current and is now useless.

data.name: antenna

data.name: circuit board
data.description: A printed card that supports and electrically connects electronic components on a non-conductive substrate.

data.name: electronic scrap
data.description: A random collection of resistors, capacitors, and diodes which have been stripped from printed circuits.

data.name: radio repeater mod
data.description: A system designed to convert a radio station into an autonomous repeater.

data.name: alarm clock
data.description: A wind-up alarm clock.  Though the noise it makes is unpleasant to wake up to, it's always good to get an early start to your day.  Can also be disassembled into some useful parts.

data.name: Kevlar dog harness
data.description: A blue bulletproof harness, designed to be worn by canines in the service of local law enforcement.

data.name: desk fan
data.description: A small fan, used to propel air around a room.

data.name: ceramic armor plate
data.description: A ceramic armor plate, specifically engineered for use in a bullet resistant vest.

data.name: ceramic plate
data.description: A ceramic dinner plate, you could probably play frisbee with it.

data.name: fish bowl
data.description: A filled fish bowl, the tag says 'to Ed' and the fish's name, 'Hoss'.  The fish appears to have tiny antlers.

data.name: glass plate
data.description: A glass dinner plate, you could probably play frisbee with it.

data.name: tin plate
data.description: A tin dinner plate, you could probably play frisbee with it.

data.name: fork
data.description: A fork, if you stab something with it you eat it right away.  Wait...  nevermind.

data.name: spoon
data.description: Do not try to bend the spoon.  That is impossible.

data.name: spork
data.description: Foons are for scrubs, real men use sporks.

data.name: foon
data.description: Clearly the superior instrument.  Sporks are just imitators.

data.name: blood soaked rag
data.description: A large rag, drenched in blood.  It could be cleaned with boiling water.

data.name: clock
data.description: A small mechanical clock, it's stopped at 10:10.

data.name: pocket watch
data.description: An old fashioned pocket watch.  This one tells you the time and looks good doing it.  Can also be disassembled into some useful parts.

data.name: clockworks
data.description: A small assortment of gears and other clockwork gubbins.

data.name: Home Frontier Starter Pack
data.description: This not-so-little bundle of joy contains Leadworks, LLC's premier offerings: the Enforcer autorevolver (with holster) and Long Ranger rifle.  Maintenance kit, batteries for same, and a complimentary copy of the Gun Owner's Handbook are included.  The perfect investment for a new family starting out!  Disassemble to unpack and enjoy.

data.name: Mosin-Nagant classic conversion kit
data.description: A beautiful wooden stock and hardware built to support common Mosin-Nagant actions.  With gunsmithing tools, some skill, and a few hours, you could take a 'tacti-cool' rifle and convert it to the classic Russian design.

data.name: Mosin-Nagant EBR conversion kit
data.description: A synthetic stock and hardware designed to accommodate common Mosin-Nagant actions.  With gunsmithing tools, some skill, and a few hours, you could give the classic Russian design modern furniture and customization capacity.

data.name: L523-CAR conversion
data.description: All the parts necessary to convert an L523 to the Carbine configuration, Leadworks LLC's choice for close-quarters work.  In order to reconfigure an already-configured L523, you'll need to disassemble it to the base platform, then assemble with the parts you prefer.

data.name: L523-MBR conversion
data.description: All the parts necessary to convert an L523 to a Main Battle Rifle, a balanced weapon for all situations.  In order to reconfigure an already-configured L523, you'll need to disassemble it to the base platform, then assemble with the parts you prefer.

data.name: L523-DSR conversion
data.description: All the parts necessary to convert an L523 to a Designated Shootist Rifle, suitable for long-ranged work.  In order to reconfigure an already-configured L523, you'll need to disassemble it to the base platform, then assemble with the parts you prefer.

data.name: L523-LMG conversion
data.description: All the parts necessary to convert an L523 to a light machine gun.  In order to reconfigure an already-configured L523, you'll need to disassemble it to the base platform, then assemble with the parts you prefer.

data.name: SD-Memory card

data.description: A pile of dry grass.  Can be used if there is nothing else to sleep on.

data.name: straw doll
data.description: Old straw doll.  Represents a woman in a dress.

data.description: A pillow to rest your head on when sleeping.

data.name: down-filled pillow
data.description: A fluffy pillow to rest your head on when sleeping.

data.name: teddy bear
data.description: An old and half rotten teddy bear.  Looks like this one commemorates the grave of the child who once owned it.

data.name: money bundle
data.description: A bundle holding many 20 dollar bills, pretty useless now though.

data.name: cigar
data.description: The smoke billowing from this cigar has a sweet, musty odor.

data.name: cigar butt
data.description: A true gentleman always finishes his cigars.

data.name: cigarette
data.description: Smoke swirls from the lit end of this cigarette, filling the air with the thrilling smell of burning chemicals.

data.name: cigarette butt
data.description:
What was once a wonderfully addictive tube of dried tobacco leaf is now just a smelly piece of trash.  What a tragedy!
The leftover tobacco in a few of these could probably be used to roll another cigarette.  If you're willing to go that far...

data.name: joint
data.description: The smell of skunk permeates the air as a thin trail of smoke floats off of this joint.

data.name: joint roach
data.description:
The smoked-down butt of a joint, a reminder of some good times.  Pretty much trash now.  Bummer, man.
A few of these could probably be used to roll another joint.

data.name: cannabis plant
data.description: A psychoactive plant indigenous to Central Asia and the Indian subcontinent traditionally cultivated for its fiber, oil, for medicinal purposes, and for use as a recreational drug.  It requires further processing to be useful.

data.name: cash card
data.description: A yellow plastic card used to store money.  These became popular once the government officially moved to all electronic money.  It holds up to 2 million dollars.

data.name: silver gas discount card
data.description: This card gives you a little discount on the purchase of gasoline.

data.name: gold gas discount card
data.description: This card gives you a good discount on the purchase of gasoline.

data.name: platinum gas discount card
data.description: This card gives you a splendid discount on the purchase of gasoline.

data.name: science ID card
data.description: This ID card once belonged to a scientist.  The reverse side describes protocol for using it; this could grant access at one control panel, if you can find one.

data.name: military ID card
data.description: This ID card once belonged to a military officer.  The reverse side describes protocol for using it; this could grant access at one control panel, if you can find one.

data.name: neoprene sheet
data.description: A moderately sized sheet of neoprene.  Can be used to craft light and stretchable clothing.

data.name: TX-5LR Laser Cannon
data.description: A laser cannon stripped from the barrel of a TX-5LR Cerberus laser turret.  Unusable as a weapon on its own without the necessary parts.

data.name: light bulb
data.description: A rather outdated light bulb used in all sorts of light equipment.

data.name: shrapnel
data.description: A twisted shard of jagged metal.

use_action.name: Arm grenade
use_action.message: You pull the pin on the %s.

data.name: tear gas grenade
data.description: This is a canister grenade filled with noxious irritant.  Use this item to pull the pin and light the fuse, turning it into an active tear gas grenade.  In five turns it will begin to expel a highly toxic gas for some time.  This gas damages and slows those who enter it, as well as obscuring vision and scent.

data.name: armed tear gas canister
data.description: This smoke bomb has had its pin removed and is expelling highly toxic gas.

data.name: nail bomb
data.description: A crude and bulky improvised fragmentation grenade.  Use this item to light the fuse.  You will then have five turns before it explodes; throwing it would be a good idea.

use_action.name: Arm grenade
use_action.message: You light the fuse on the %s.

data.name: smoke bomb
data.description: This is a canister grenade filled with a variety of pyrotechnic chemicals.  Use this item to pull the pin and light the fuse, turning it into an active smoke bomb.  Five turns after you do that, it will begin to expel a thick black smoke.  This smoke will slow those who enter it, as well as obscuring vision and scent.

data.name: armed smoke bomb
data.description: This smoke bomb has had its pin removed and is expelling thick smoke.

data.name: blunderbuss slug
data.description: A prepared blunderbuss shot of a large hunk of metal.  Better for distance.

data.name: blunderbuss shot
data.description: A prepared blunderbuss shot of a marbles, pebbles, bearings, basically whatever is at hand.  The homemade pellet spread and number makes up for the shoddy quality.

data.name: blunderbuss flechette
data.description: A prepared blunderbuss shot of homemade flechette made out of nails or glass.  Shreds armor.

data.name: bootleg fusion pack
data.description: In the middle of the 21st Century, military powers began to look towards energy based weapons.  The result was the standard fusion pack, capable of delivering bolts of superheated gas at near light speed with no recoil.  This one has been hand-crafted from spare parts.

data.name: Mjölnir
data.description:
A large hammer, forged from the heart of a dying star.  It bears the inscription:
 
Whosoever holds this hammer,
If he be worthy,
Shall possess the power to...
CRUSH!!'

data.name: heavy stick
data.description: A sturdy, heavy stick.  Makes a decent melee weapon, and can be cut into two by fours for crafting.

data.name: sharpened rebar
data.description: A somewhat sharpened piece of rebar, it is still better at bashing than stabbing but the added flexibility is nice.

data.name: bokken
data.description: This is a solid wood 'training' katana, exactingly crafted to mimic the weight and balance of the real thing.  Despite its lack of a sharp metal edge, it's still quite capable of inflicting deadly wounds.
data.//: MA reference I used held that a bokken crushes rather than cuts (or impales) but is otherwise just as damaging as a katana.  Nerfed by popular demand.

data.name: cudgel
data.description: A slender long rod of wood, while traditionally intended as a training tool for many dueling moves, it still makes a good melee weapon in a pinch.

data.name: quarterstaff
data.description: A smooth and sturdy staff with a leather-wrapped grip.  Light and well-balanced, it is surprisingly easy to handle.

data.name: ironshod quarterstaff
data.description: A smooth and sturdy staff with a leather-wrapped grip, which has been reinforced with metal bands and caps.  Durable and well-balanced, it is surprisingly easy to handle.

data.name: lajatang
data.description: An exotic weapon comprised of a long pole of wood with curved blades on each end.  It can be deadly in skilled hands.

data.name: hatchet
data.description: A one-handed hatchet.  Makes a great melee weapon, and is useful both for chopping things and for use as a hammer.

data.name: butter knife
data.description: A dull knife, absolutely worthless in combat.

data.name: rock
data.description: A rock the size of a baseball.  Makes a decent melee weapon, and is also good for throwing at enemies.

data.name: sharp rock
data.description: A rock with sharp edges, that can be used as a butchering tool, if nothing else is available.  Makes a passable melee weapon.

data.name: ceramic shard
data.description: A broken ceramic shard.  It is heavy and has a somewhat sharp edge, but it's too irregular to cut properly.

data.name: baseball
data.description: A baseball, good for throwing at enemies.  Getting hit with one of these hurts a lot more than you might think.

data.name: hockey puck
data.description: A heavy circular block of solid rubber, normally used for playing hockey.  You can throw it to cause some serious harm.

data.name: football
data.description: An oval made of leather and string, it's easily thrown but does little damage.  You could take it apart into leather if you wanted.

data.name: basketball
data.description: A high-quality indoor basketball.  You may throw it at zombies.

data.name: pointy stick
data.description: A simple wood pole with one end sharpened.

data.name: 2-by-sword
data.description: A two by four with a cross guard and whittled down point; not much for slashing, but much better than your bare hands.

data.name: nord
data.description: The nail sword, or nord for short.  This wooden sword has a dozen nails sticking at jagged angles from edge of the blade, making it much better at chopping than slashing.

data.name: crude sword
data.description: Several bits of thin scrap metal crudely beat into the semblance of an edge over a wooden sword.  The added weight is unbalanced, but the jagged edge offers a good bit of slashing power.

data.name: broom
data.description: A long-handled broom.  Makes a terrible weapon unless you're chasing cats.

data.name: sledge hammer
data.description: A large, heavy hammer.  Makes an acceptable melee weapon for the very strong, but is nearly useless in the hands of the weak.

data.name: war hammer
data.description: A medieval hammer made for battle.  Its odd shape and balance make it an excellent weapon, but an ineffective tool.
data.//: Craftable from steel, shouldn't be silver.  A warhammer is essentially one end of a pickaxe with balancing weight on the other and crushes/pierces the armor.

data.name: nail board
data.description: A long piece of wood with several nails through one end; essentially a simple mace.  Makes an acceptable melee weapon.

data.name: nail bat
data.description: A baseball bat with several nails driven through it, an excellent melee weapon.

data.name: barbed wire bat
data.description: A baseball bat wrapped with barbed wire.  A brutal melee weapon.

data.name: The 7-10 Split
data.description: An improvised weapon, made from two spikes attached to a bowling pin in the shape of a 'T'.

data.name: pair of nail knuckles
data.description: A pair of knuckles consisting of two small squares of wood with several nails coming through them.  Useful in nasty street fights.

data.name: homewrecker
data.description: A long piece of wood with several chunks of steel firmly tied to it.  The resulting weapon is unwieldy and slow but very heavy hitting.

data.name: two by four
data.description: A plank of wood.  Makes a decent melee weapon, and can be used to board up doors and windows if you have a hammer and nails.

data.name: pipe
data.description: A steel pipe, makes a good melee weapon.  Useful in a few crafting recipes.

data.name: baseball bat
data.description: A sturdy wood bat.  Makes a great melee weapon.

data.name: bowling pin
data.description: A blunt bowling pin.  Makes a decent melee weapon, if somewhat short.

data.name: burnt out Louisville Slaughterer
data.description: A sturdy wood bat, wrapped in flame-resistant Nomex fabric.  Makes a good melee weapon but better be disassembled to recycle the baseball bat and some Nomex patches.

data.name: aluminum bat
data.description: An aluminum baseball bat, lighter than a wooden bat and a little easier to swing as a result.

data.name: wooden spear
data.description: A stout pole with an improvised grip and a fire-hardened point.

data.name: forked spear
data.description: A wooden spear with a decent grip and a three-pronged trident-like tip.  Heavy, but good for catching weapons.
data.//: Block 2 until we re-implement defensive-disarm, I'm afraid.

data.name: copper spear
data.description: A stout wooden pole with a spearhead worked from copper.

data.name: steel spear
data.description: A stout wooden pole with a hand-forged steel spearhead.

data.//: stats of original steel spear, after it was made into a less makeshift version
data.name: pipe spear
data.description: A stout metal pole with a sharp point.

data.name: qiang
data.description: An ancient Chinese spear, typically with a tassel just below the spearhead.  One of the four major weapons in folklore, alongside the dao sabre, jian sword, and gun staff.

data.name: halberd
data.description: This is a versatile polearm with an axe blade, a spike, and other fun things attached to a long stick.

data.name: halberd
data.description: This is a dull, cheaply made replica of a polearm with an axe blade, a spike, and other fun things attached to a long stick.

data.name: glaive
data.description: A sturdy polearm with a sizable, single-edged blade on the end.

data.name: naginata
data.description: A sturdy polearm with a curved blade, made in the same manner as the katana and other Japanese blades.  Occasionally used by samurai in early periods, or by their wives in defense of the household.

data.name: survivor naginata
data.description: This sturdy steel shaft with a sword blade at the end is good for both slashing and stabbing.
data.//: Description says it can slash. STAB currently doesn't slash, but at least it doesn't give the spear bonus

data.name: expandable baton
data.description: A telescoping baton that collapses for easy storage.  Makes an excellent melee weapon.  Activate to expand.

data.name: expandable baton (extended)
data.description: A telescoping baton that collapses for easy storage.  Makes an excellent melee weapon.  Activate to collapse.

data.name: bee sting
data.description: A six-inch stinger from a giant bee.  Makes a mediocre melee weapon.

data.name: fungal fighter sting
data.description: A short dart from a fungal fighter.  Makes an poor melee weapon.

data.name: wasp sting
data.description: A six-inch stinger from a giant wasp.  Makes a poor melee weapon.

data.name: walking cane
data.description: Handicapped or not, you always walk in style.  Consisting of a metal headpiece and a wooden body, this makes a great bashing weapon in a pinch.

data.name: mace
data.description: A medieval weapon consisting of a wood handle with a heavy iron end.  It is heavy and slow, but its crushing damage is devastating.
data.//: Same total damage and slightly higher weight than a morningstar - exchanged.

data.name: morningstar
data.description: A medieval weapon consisting of a wood handle with a heavy, spiked iron ball on the end.  It deals devastating crushing damage, with a small amount of piercing to boot.

data.name: pool cue
data.description: A hard-wood stick designed for hitting colorful balls around a felt table.  Truly, the coolest of sports.

data.name: spike
data.description: A large and slightly misshapen spike, could do some damage mounted on a vehicle.

data.name: wooden javelin
data.description: A fire-hardened wooden spear honed to a sharper point.  The grip area has been carved and covered for better grip.

data.name: iron javelin
data.description: An iron-tipped wooden throwing spear.  The grip area has been carved and covered for better grip.

data.name: bionic claws
data.description: Short and sharp claws made from a high-tech metal.

data.name: monomolecular blade
data.description: A foot-long blade made from high-tech alloy and edged with bonded nanocrystals.

data.name: punch dagger
data.description: A short and sharp double edged dagger made to be gripped in the palm, with the blade protruding between the fingers.

data.name: tiger claws
data.description: Also called bagh nakha or iron paw, this is a small claw-like bladed weapon from India designed to be concealed under and against the palm.

data.name: pair of steel knuckles

data.name: bullet crossbow
data.description: A modified version of the classic crossbow which utilizes stones as projectiles instead of the traditional quarrel.  Primarily intended for hunting small game, stronger people can reload it much faster.

data.name: FTK-93 fusion gun
data.description: A very powerful fusion rifle developed shortly before the influx of monsters.  It can only hold two rounds at a time, but a special superheating unit causes its bolts to be extremely deadly.

data.name: M72 LAW
data.description: A disposable light anti-tank rocket launcher.  Once fired, it cannot be reloaded and must be disposed of.
data.//: A tube with a lever.  Unsurprisingly, dirt cheap (at least for a rocket launcher).

data.name: Tankbot Main Gun
data.description: The 120mm cannon from a tankbot.  If you have this, you'd best be debugging!

data.name: Boeing XM-P plasma rifle

data.//: Like the LAW, this thing is basically a tube with a lever.  It's even cheaper in terms of construction, but there's a premium due to being imported.  Also not disposable.

You whistle on the harmonica.
npc_descriptions: produce a happy tune on the harmonica.

data.description: A harmonica with a holder, so that you can play it without a free hand.

data.name: acoustic guitar

player_descriptions: You strum a few chords on the guitar.
You pluck a few notes on the guitar.
You play a slow blues-y tune on the guitar.
npc_descriptions: strum a few chords on the guitar.
pluck a few notes on the guitar.
play a slow blues-y tune on the guitar.

data.description: A simple wooden acoustic guitar with a strap so you can wear it around, even when not playing.

data.name: bagpipes

player_descriptions: Your pipes drone loudly as you strikes a battle hymn from the chanter.
Your pipes drone a slow and piercing dirge.
You strike a lively quick step march on their pipes.
npc_descriptions: pipes drone loudly as it strikes a battle hymn from the chanter.
pipes drone a slow and piercing dirge.
strike a lively quick step march on their pipes.

data.description: A traditional musical instrument using enclosed reeds fed from a reservoir of air contained within a leather bag.  It has a strap so you can wear it around, even when not playing.

data.name: tuba

player_descriptions: You play a little tune on the tuba.
You play a ditty on the tuba.
You play a marching tune on the tuba.
npc_descriptions: play a little tune on the tuba.
play a ditty on the tuba.
play a marching tune on the tuba.

data.//~: ol' is an informal short-form for old, and here is part of big-ol as large-and-cumbersome.
data.description: A big ol' tuba.  Much easier to play when wearing.

data.name: saxophone

player_descriptions: You play a little tune on the saxophone.
You play a soulful jazz piece on the sax.
You play a quick, energetic ditty on the sax.
npc_descriptions: play a little tune on the saxophone.
play a soulful jazz piece on the sax.
play a quick, energetic ditty on the sax.

data.description: A brass alto saxophone with a neck strap, so you can wear it while playing.

data.name: shooter's earmuffs
data.description: A pair of earmuffs favored by shooters.  The earmuffs are turned off.  They will block sounds over a certain decibel amount, assuming it is charged with batteries.

data.name: shooter's earmuffs
data.description: A pair of earmuffs favored by shooters.  The earmuffs are turned on.  They will block sounds over a certain decibel amount, assuming it is charged with batteries.

data.name: stethoscope
data.description: This is a medical listening tool.  Use it to listen to things.  Closely.

data.name: atomic battery mod
data.description: This plutonium cell has been adapted to fit conventional battery connections.  You can attach it to any battery-operated equipment, converting it to use power off the plutonium cell instead.

data.name: extra battery mod
data.description: This is a homemade battery compartment made with spare electronics.  With enough electronics skill, you could attach this to any electronic tool to double the amount of batteries it can hold.

data.name: UPS conversion mod
data.description: This device replaces conventional battery connections with a rechargeable power cell that runs off of a Unified Power System.  Having the UPS on or placing a tool in a special recharging station will slowly charge it.

data.name: reactor core expansion device
data.description: This is an expansion device for use on plutonium-powered equipment.  With enough electronics skill, you could attach this to an atomic tool to double the amount of plutonium it can hold.  Note that this device is incompatible with the atomic battery mod.

data.name: battery compartment mod
data.description: A battery compartment mod that allows using vehicle batteries and small storage batteries in regular tools.

data.name: EMP grenade
data.description: This is a grenade that generates a electromagnetic pulse with a tiny nuclear explosion.  Use this item to pull the pin and light the fuse, turning it into an active EMP grenade.  You will then have three turns before it detonates, creating an EMP field that damages robots and drains bionic energy.

use_action.msg: You pull the pin on the EMP grenade.

data.name: active EMP grenade
data.description: This EMP grenade is active, and will shortly detonate, creating a large EMP field that damages robots and drains bionic energy.  You may not want to be holding it much longer.

use_action.no_deactivate_msg: You've already pulled the %s's pin, try throwing it instead.

data.name: packed M72 LAW
data.description: This is a M72 LAW, packed in its storage form.  Use it to pop it out and make it ready to fire.  Once it is activated, it cannot be repacked.

use_action.msg: You pull the activating lever, readying the LAW to fire.

data.name: UPS
data.description: This is a unified power supply, or UPS.  It is a device developed jointly by military and scientific interests for use in combat and the field.  The UPS is designed to power armor and some guns, but drains batteries quickly.

data.name: acid bomb
data.description: This is a fragile container filled with acid.  Throw it to spill out a pool of potent acid.

data.name: acid bomb
data.description: This is a glass vial, with two chemicals mixing inside.  The vial feels colder and the contents are frothing.  If this mixture is exposed to air (as could happen if you throw the vial), it will spill out as a pool of potent acid.

data.name: advanced UPS
data.description: This is an advanced version of the unified power supply, or UPS.  This device has been significantly redesigned to provide better efficiency as well as to consume plutonium fuel cells rather than batteries.  Sadly, its plutonium reactor can't be charged in UPS charging station.

data.name: advanced electronic cigarette
data.description: An advanced version of the electronic cigarette.  A less harmful way to get your nicotine fix than regular cigarettes, but still addictive.  It needs batteries and nicotine liquid to function.

data.name: compressed air horn
data.description: This is a small can of compressed air attached to a plastic horn.  Pressing the button on top causes it to emit a loud honking sound.

use_action.no_charges_message: You depress the button but no sound comes out.

data.name: anvil
data.description: This is an enormously heavy block of oddly shaped steel with a chisel-like projection set into the corner.  It's used in most metalworking fabrication recipes.

data.name: atomic coffee maker
data.description: Never sacrifice taste for convenience, when you can have both with the Rivtech atomic coffee maker!  Its simple and robust atomic-age construction guarantees a service life of at least 160 million years.

data.name: atomic lamp
data.description: Enjoy the serene Cherenkov-blue glow of the Rivtech atomic desk lamp, and feel confident that you won't have to worry about depleting its power supply for at least 40 million years of faithful service.  Use it to close the cover and hide the light.

data.name: atomic lamp (covered)
data.description: Enjoy the serene Cherenkov-blue glow of the Rivtech atomic desk lamp, and feel confident that you won't have to worry about depleting its power supply for at least 40 million years of faithful service.  The cover is closed.  Use it to open the cover and show the light.

data.name: atomic nightlight
data.description: Enjoy the serene Cherenkov-blue glow of the Rivtech atomic nightlight, and feel confident that you won't have to worry about depleting its power supply for at least 160 million years of faithful service.  Use it to close the cover and hide the light.

data.name: atomic nightlight (covered)
data.description: Enjoy the serene Cherenkov-blue glow of the Rivtech atomic nightlight, and feel confident that you won't have to worry about depleting its power supply for at least 160 million years of faithful service.  The cover is closed.  Use it to open the cover and show the light.

data.name: wood axe
data.description: This is a large, two-handed wood axe.  It makes a good melee weapon, but is a bit slow to recover between swings.

data.name: vacuum-packed fruit slice
data.description: This is a bag of vacuum packed fruit slices in plastic packaging.  Use to open and eat to enjoy.

use_action.msg: You open the vacuum pack, exposing it to the atmosphere.

data.name: vacuum-packed fish slice
data.description: This is a bag of vacuum packed fish slices in plastic packaging.  Use to open and eat to enjoy.

use_action.msg: You open the vacuum pack, exposing it to the atmosphere.

data.name: vacuum-packed salted simpleton slice
data.description: This is a bag of vacuum packed human flesh slices in plastic packaging.  Use to open and eat to enjoy.

use_action.msg: You open the vacuum pack, exposing it to the atmosphere.

data.name: vacuum-packed meat slice
data.description: This is a bag of vacuum packed meat slices in plastic packaging.  Use to open and eat to enjoy.

use_action.msg: You open the vacuum pack, exposing it to the atmosphere.

data.name: vacuum-packed veggy chunk
data.description: This is a bag of vacuum packed vegetable slices in plastic packaging.  Use to open and eat to enjoy.

use_action.msg: You open the vacuum pack, exposing it to the atmosphere.

data.name: banjo
data.description: A standard factory-made banjo.  Looks to be in working condition.

player_descriptions: You play a little tune on your banjo.
You play a bluegrass tune on your banjo.
You play a quick, Southern ditty on your banjo.

data.name: barometer
data.description: A plastic barometer that can read the atmospheric pressure.

data.name: battle axe
data.description: This is a huge axe designed for warfare.  Though intended for use as a weapon, it can also be pressed into service as a rather clumsy woodcutting tool.

data.name: Louisville Slaughterer
data.description: This is sturdy wood bat, wrapped in gasoline-soaked rags and flame-resistant Nomex fabric.  Light it, and the ball game will REALLY heat up.  You'll need a lighter or matches to light it.

data.name: Louisville Slaughterer (lit)
data.description: This is a sturdy wood bat, wrapped in gasoline-soaked rags and flame-resistant Nomex fabric.  It is burning brightly, and makes it much easier to see the baselines at night games (It also makes the umpire FAR more likely to call a ball instead of a strike).

data.name: bear trap
data.description: This is a spring-loaded pair of steel jaws connected to a sensitive pressure plate.  Use it to set it on the ground, creating a trap that will ensnare and damage anything that steps on it.  If you are carrying a shovel, you will have the option of burying it.

use_action.done_message: You set the beartrap.

data.name: military black box
data.description: This is a black box, seemingly pulled from some sort of military vehicle wreckage.  If you can find a system to analyze this you may find something of interest.

data.name: blade trap
data.description: This is a machete attached laterally to a motor, with a tripwire controlling its throttle.  When the tripwire is pulled, the blade is swung around with great force.  The trap forms a 3x3 area of effect.

use_action.done_message: You set the blade trap two squares away.

data.name: nailboard trap
data.description: These are several pieces of wood nailed together, with some nails sticking straight up.  If an unsuspecting victim steps on it, they'll get nails through the foot.

use_action.done_message: You set the board trap on the %s, nails facing up.

data.name: pair of bolt cutters
data.description: This is a large pair of bolt cutters.  You could use them to cut padlocks or heavy gauge wire.

data.name: bone flute
data.description: A polished bone flute with five finger holes.

player_descriptions: You play a little tune on your flute.
You play a beautiful piece on your flute.
You play a piece on your bone flute that resembles the howling wind through Aurignacian caves.
Your bone flute wails for the fallen during the hunt.

data.name: booby trap
data.description: This is a crude explosive device triggered by a piece of string.  Use it to setup and watch some poor bastard trigger it.

use_action.done_message: You set the booby trap up and activate the grenade.

data.name: inactive EMP hack
data.description: This is an inactive EMP hack.  EMP hacks are fist-sized robots that fly through the air.  This one contains a EMP grenade and attacks by flying at its target and detonating.  Use this item to activate the EMP hack.

use_action.friendly_msg: The EMP hack flies from your hand and surveys the area!
use_action.hostile_msg: You misprogram the EMP hack; take cover!

data.name: inactive C-4 hack
data.description: This is an inactive C-4 hack.  C-4 hacks are fist-sized robots that fly through the air.  This one contains some C-4 and attacks by flying at its target and detonating.  Use this item to activate the C-4 hack.

use_action.friendly_msg: The C-4 hack flies from your hand and surveys the area!
use_action.hostile_msg: You misprogram the C-4 hack; take cover!

data.name: inactive flashbang hack
data.description: This is an inactive flashbang hack.  Flashbang hacks are fist-sized robots that fly through the air.  This one contains a flashbang and attacks by flying at its target and detonating.  Use this item to activate the flashbang hack.

use_action.friendly_msg: The flashbang hack flies from your hand and surveys the area!
use_action.hostile_msg: You misprogram the flashbang hack; take cover!

data.name: inactive tear gas hack
data.description: This is an inactive tear gas hack.  Tear gas hacks are fist-sized robots that fly through the air.  This one contains a tear gas canister and attacks by flying at its target and releasing tear gas.  Use this item to activate the tear gas hack.

use_action.friendly_msg: The tear gas hack flies from your hand and surveys the area!
use_action.hostile_msg: You misprogram the tear gas hack; take cover!

data.name: inactive grenade hack
data.description: This is an inactive grenade hack.  Grenade hacks are fist-sized robots that fly through the air.  This one contains a grenade and attacks by flying at its target and detonating.  Use this item to activate the grenade hack.

use_action.friendly_msg: The grenade hack flies from your hand and surveys the area!
use_action.hostile_msg: You misprogram the grenade hack; take cover!

data.name: inactive laser turret
data.description: This is an inactive laser turret.  Using this item involves turning it on and placing it on the ground, where it will attach itself.  The turret will then identify you as a friendly, and attack all enemies with its revolving laser cannons.  It requires sunlight in order to fire.

data.name: inactive antimateriel turret
data.description: This is an inactive antimateriel turret.  Using this item involves loading the unit with the factory-loaded .50 BMG Ball rounds in your inventory (if you wish to divide your ammunition, set aside whatever .50 BMG Ball you do NOT want to give the turret) turning it on, and placing it on the ground, where it will attach itself.  The turret will then identify you as a friendly, and attack all enemies with a built-in rifle.

data.name: inactive manhack
data.description: This is an inactive manhack.  Manhacks are fist-sized robots that fly through the air.  They are covered with whirring blades and attack by throwing themselves against their target.  Use this item to activate the manhack.

use_action.friendly_msg: The manhack flies from your hand and surveys the area!
use_action.hostile_msg: You misprogram the manhack; it's hostile!

data.name: inactive mininuke hack
data.description: This is an inactive mininuke hack.  Twice as large as a normal manhack, mininuke hacks contain a mininuke and attack by flying at their target and detonating.  Use this item to activate the mininuke hack.

use_action.friendly_msg: The mininuke hack floats from your hand and surveys the area!
use_action.hostile_msg: You misprogram the mininuke hack.  Pray.

data.name: inactive rifle turret
data.description: This is an inactive turret.  Using this item involves loading the unit with the factory-loaded 5.56 NATO rounds in your inventory (if you wish to divide your ammunition, set aside whatever 5.56 you do NOT want to give the turret) turning it on, and placing it on the ground, where it will attach itself.  The turret will then identify you as a friendly, and attack all enemies with a built-in rifle.

data.name: inactive turret
data.description: This is an inactive turret.  Using this item involves loading the unit with the factory-loaded 9mm rounds in your inventory (if you wish to divide your ammunition, set aside whatever 9mm you do NOT want to give the turret) turning it on, and placing it on the ground, where it will attach itself.  The turret will then identify you as a friendly, and attack all enemies with a built-in SMG.

data.name: brazier
data.description: This is a large metal stand with slots on the side.  You can set it somewhere through the construction menu and then set fires in it with no risk of spreading.

data.name: brick kiln
data.description: This is a portable charcoal-fired kiln.  It is designed for firing bricks, but you could use it to fire anything made of clay.

data.name: firebrand (off)
data.description: This is a combination of two Dark Age conflict-resolution classics, the broadsword and the torch.  Use to light it up and show those heathen zombies who's Lord around here.

data.name: firebrand (on)
data.description: This is a combination of two Dark Age conflict-resolution classics, the broadsword and the torch.  The blade is glowing with heat.  Excalibur can eat its heart out.  Use to shut it off.

use_action.water_extinguish_message: Your sword hisses in the water and goes out.

data.name: broadsword
data.description: This is an early modern sword seeing use in the 16th, 17th, and 18th centuries.  Called 'broad' to contrast with the slimmer rapiers.

data.name: bubble wrap
data.description: This is a sheet of plastic covered with air-filled bubbles.  Use it to set it on the ground, creating a trap that will warn you with noise when something steps on it.

use_action.done_message: You set the bubble wrap on the ground, ready to be popped.

data.name: C-4 explosive
data.description: This is military grade RDX composition explosive.  A label reads: "Highly explosive, use with extreme caution!" It comes with a small timer.

data.name: C-4 explosive (armed)
data.description: This is military grade RDX composition explosive.  A label reads: "Highly explosive, use with extreme caution!" It comes with a small timer, which is currently ticking down.

use_action.no_deactivate_msg: You've already set the %s's timer, you might want to get away from it.

data.name: loose caltrops
data.description: These are small metal objects covered with many sharp points.  If an unsuspecting victim steps on one, they'll get a spine through the foot.

use_action.done_message: You scatter the caltrops on the %s.

data.name: camera
data.description: A point-and-shoot digital camera, with digital viewfinder, a backup 'iron-sight', and flash.  You can look at your photos on the digital screen, or transfer them with a memory card.  Takes conventional batteries.

data.name: camera pro
data.description: A 35mm digital SLR (single-lens reflex) camera, with optical and digital viewfinders, zoom lens with auto-focus and stabilizer, and flash.  You can view your photos on it or transfer them with a memory card; it runs on conventional batteries.  Before the cataclysm, you could have taken professional-grade photos using this.

data.name: can sealer
data.description: A hand crank powered cast aluminum machine designed to automatically seal tin cans.

data.name: candle
data.description: This is a thick candle.  It doesn't provide very much light, but it can burn for quite a long time.  You'll need a lighter or matches to light it.

data.name: candle (lit)
data.description: This is a thick candle.  It doesn't provide very much light, but it can burn for quite a long time.  This candle is lit.

data.name: goo canister
data.description: There is a label on this canister: "Warning: contains highly toxic and corrosive materials.  Contents may be sentient.  Open at your own risk." You think you can feel something moving inside it.

data.name: carding paddles
data.description: A pair of toothy wooden paddles used to clean fibers for use in textile production.

data.name: electric carver (off)
data.description: An electric meat carver powered by batteries.  Two serrated blades that vibrate together to slice just about anything from turkey to ham...  even zombies!

data.name: electric carver (on)
data.description: This carver is on and the blades are buzzing.  Use it to turn it off.

data.name: cat food
data.description: This is food for cats.  It smells strange, but cats seem to love it.

data.name: cavalry saber
data.description: This is a curved sword associated with cavalry from the Early Modern period onwards.  Lightweight but a deadly slashing weapon.

data.name: cell phone
data.description: This is a typical smartphone that features an LED for use as a flash.  Using this cellphone will turn it on and provide light, assuming it is charged with batteries.

data.name: chainsaw (off)
data.description: This is a lumbering tool moonlighting as weapon of opportunity.  If loaded with gas, using this item will cause it to turn on, turning it into a very powerful but unwieldy melee weapon.

data.name: chainsaw (on)
data.description: This chainsaw is on and making a lot of noise.  Use it to turn it off.

data.name: charcoal forge
