data.description: This is a portable, charcoal fired, metalworking forge.  If combined with the right tools, you could use this for metalworking.

data.name: charcoal kiln
data.description: A stout metal box used for producing charcoal via pyrolysis; the incomplete burning of organic materials in the absence of oxygen.

data.name: charcoal water purifier
data.description: Using this item on a container full of water will purify the water using layered charcoal.  Once the charcoal has purified enough water, it will become unusable and can be disassembled and recycled.  Water taken from uncertain sources like a river may be dirty.

data.name: charcoal smoker
data.description: This is a portable charcoal smoker.  Good for weekend barbecuing and preserving meat with smoke.

data.name: charcoal cooker
data.description: This is a little metal tank for holding charcoal with a pilot light attached.  You could use it for cooking food.

data.name: chemistry set
data.description: This is a chemistry set stored in a box.  The contents include glass containers, hoses, metal wire, a hotplate, and safety glasses.  It might be used to craft some chemistry projects if you're so inclined.

data.name: basic chemistry set
data.description: This is a basic chemistry set which includes glass containers, hoses and safety glasses.  It might be used to craft some chemistry projects if you're so inclined, but you'll need a source of heat.

data.name: paint chipper
data.description: A tool similar to a chisel, designed to remove paint.

data.name: metalworking chisel
data.description: This is a short, stout metalworking chisel.  It's used in some metalworking fabrication recipes.

data.name: circular saw (off)
data.description: A lightweight handheld cordless circular saw.  Spins a circular blade fast enough to cut wood, metal, zombies, or in an emergency, pizza.  The blade, while effective in combat, is hard to hit with due to its small size.

use_action.msg: You turn on the circular saw.

data.name: circular saw (on)
data.description: A lightweight handheld cordless circular saw.  It is currently on and the blade is spinning; use this item to turn it off.

data.name: clarinet
data.description: An ornate clarinet made from wood.

player_descriptions: You play a little tune on your clarinet.
You play a moving, orchestral piece on your clarinet.
You play an uplifting marching tune on your clarinet.

data.name: clay pot
data.description: A crude clay pot with lid used for cooking.

data.name: clay quern
data.description: This is a simple hand-powered clay quern for grinding grain.

data.name: clay teapot
data.description: A clay teapot.  Now all you need is tea and water.

data.name: coffeemaker
data.description: This is a heating element with pot and frame for holding coffee or other powders.  It's got a battery compartment for use when the power goes out.  You can use it to make coffee, or other drinks if you so choose.

data.name: combat chainsaw (off)
data.description: This is a chainsaw that has been lightened, tuned, and extensively modified to be a more effective weapon.  Unfortunately these modifications have rendered it much less effective as a woodcutting tool.

data.name: combat chainsaw (on)
data.description: This combat chainsaw is on, and is continuously draining gasoline.  Use it to turn it off.

data.name: concrete mixer
data.description: A portable concrete mixer.  It is still large and heavy, but it can be operated solo, and runs on batteries.  It also has a heater built in.

data.name: control laptop
data.description: A modified laptop, now capable of transmitting in the ultra high frequencies utilized by robots.  Activate it to command robots from afar.

data.name: copper axe
data.description: This is a decent-sized chunk of worked copper affixed to a wooden shaft, to make a crude yet effective axe.

data.name: copper knife
data.description: A knife consisting of crudely-worked copper, and a simple handle.  Primitive, but a step above stone-age.

data.name: cordless drill
data.description: This is a cordless battery-powered drill with a selection of drill bits.

data.name: cot
data.description: This is a military style fold up cot.  While it may not be quite as comfortable as a bed, it's better than slumming it on the ground.

use_action.done_message: You unfold the cot and place it on the ground.

data.name: cow bell
data.description: A brass cow bell.  Potentially useful in so many ways.

data.name: crack pipe
data.description: This is a fine glass tube with a bulb with a bowl on one end.  It's used to partake of certain illicit substances.

data.name: talking doll
data.description: This is a talking doll, meant for children.  Fortunately it still works, and you could unload the batteries out of it.

data.name: crossbow trap
data.description: This is a simple tripwire, which is attached to the trigger of a loaded crossbow.  When pulled, the crossbow fires.  Only a single round can be used, after which the trap is disabled.

use_action.done_message: You set the crossbow trap.

data.name: crowbar
data.description: This is a hefty prying tool.  Use it to open locked doors without destroying them or to lift manhole covers.  You could also wield it to bash some heads in.

data.name: crucible
data.description: This is a small metalworking crucible.  It's used in some metalworking fabrication recipes.

data.name: clay crucible
data.description: This is a primitive metalworking crucible made of clay.  You could use it for metalworking.

data.name: electric firestarter
data.description: This is a crudely made electric firestarter, which can function as an inefficient lighter.

data.name: improvised lockpick
data.description: This is an improvised set of picks and torsion wrenches made from scrap metal.  You need MacGyver-like skills to open locks with these as they are brittle, but they lower the chances of alarms being set off.

data.name: chainsaw lajatang (off)
data.description: A long wooden pole with chainsaws impractically attached to both ends.  The product of either genius or insanity, but not both; the weight ensures that only someone both strong and very skilled could possibly hope to use it.

data.name: chainsaw lajatang (on)
data.description: A long wooden pole with chainsaws impractically attached to both ends.  They are currently on and draining gasoline; use this item to turn them off.

data.name: cutlass
data.description: This is a broad saber known for its use by sailors and pirates, as its short blade is easy to handle in close quarters.

data.name: damaged shelter kit
data.description: This is a small shelter, made of sticks and skins.  Use it to place.  This shelter has been damaged, and needs repairs.

data.name: food dehydrator
data.description: This is a portable electric food dehydrator.  It's powered by batteries, and could be invaluable in preserving food.

data.name: digging stick
data.description: This is a large stick, with the end carved into a broad blade for digging.  It could be used to dig shallow pits, but not deep ones.

data.name: directional antenna
data.description: This is an antenna designed to pick up signals better when pointed at the source.  You could use this with a radio to receive faint signals.

data.name: distaff and spindle
data.description: A pair of specialized wooden rods used to spin fibers into thread and yarn.

data.name: dive knife
data.//: Too small to be effectively used for butchering, still not bad at it due to serrated edge.
data.description: This is a short, sturdy knife with a serrated edge for cutting lines and straps, and a blunt tip for prying.  Used primarily by divers, it is very light and takes up virtually no space in one's pockets.

data.name: dog whistle
data.description: This is a small whistle.  When used, it produces a high tone that causes nearby friendly dogs to either follow you closely and stop attacking, or start attacking enemies if they are currently docile.

data.name: dog food
data.description: This is food for dogs.  It smells strange, but dogs seem to love it.

data.name: dynamite
data.description: These are several sticks of explosives with a fuse attached.  Use this item to light the fuse.  You will, of course, need a lighter or matches in your inventory to do this.  Shortly after lighting the fuse, this item will explode, so get away!

data.name: dynamite (lit)
data.description: The fuse on this dynamite is lit and hissing.  It'll explode any moment now.

use_action.no_deactivate_msg: You've already lit the %s, try throwing it instead.

data.name: radio dynamite
data.description: Dynamite with a radio detonator.  Activate it to arm, then plant or attach to a RC car, and use the remote detonator.

data.name: activated radio dynamite
data.description: Dynamite with a radio detonator, armed.  Place it, get away and use the remote detonator.

use_action.no_deactivate_msg: You can't disarm your %s'.  Place it, get away and use the remote control to detonate.

data.name: electronic handcuffs
data.description:
A pair of electronic handcuffs, used by police and riot bots to detain captives.  Their continuous siren clearly identifies the wearer as an arrested criminal and alerts human police.  Wait for their arrival, don't try to escape or to remove the cuffs - they will administer an electric shock.
However, since the only police likely to respond are undead, you may have a long wait ahead, unless you get creative...

data.name: entrenching tool
data.description: This is a stout collapsible spade.  It's commonly used by military forces and favored by hikers for digging.

data.name: E-Ink Tablet PC
data.description: A tablet PC using an efficient color e-ink display.  Before the cataclysm, these were nifty gadgets; now, it's an almost priceless resource.  Runs on conventional batteries.

data.name: electric chainsaw (off)
data.description: This is a lumbering tool moonlighting as weapon of opportunity.  If loaded with batteries, using this item will cause it to turn on, turning it into a very powerful but unwieldy melee weapon.

data.name: electric chainsaw (on)
data.description: This electric chainsaw is on and making a lot of noise.  Use it to turn it off.

data.name: electric hair trimmer
data.description: This is a pocket-sized electric trimmer made for cutting hair.  You can use it to cut your hair if it's supplied with batteries.  It requires 10 batteries per use.

data.name: electric jackhammer
data.description: This is a construction tool for drilling through hard rock or other surfaces.  It runs on batteries.  Use it (if loaded) to blast a hole in adjacent solid terrain.

data.name: electrohack
data.description: This device has many ports attached, allowing it to connect to almost any control panel or other electronic machine (but not computers).  With a little skill, it can be used to crack passwords and more.  It requires 25 charges of battery power per use.

data.name: etched human skull
data.description: This is a human skull with strange etchings covering it.

data.name: large fire extinguisher
data.description: This is an emergency fire extinguisher containing three gallons of fire retardant foam.  It would be useful for putting out adjacent fires.

data.name: fertilizer bomb
data.description: This is a volatile homemade explosive.  Use this item to light the fuse.  You will, of course, need a lighter or matches in your inventory to do this.  Shortly after lighting the fuse, this item will explode, so get away!

data.name: fertilizer bomb (lit)
data.description: The fuse on this fertilizer bomb is lit and hissing.  It'll explode any moment now.

use_action.no_deactivate_msg: You've already lit the %s, try throwing it instead.

data.name: fire axe
data.description: This is a large, two-handed pickhead axe normally used by firefighters.  It makes a powerful melee weapon, but is a bit slow to recover between swings.

data.name: fire drill
data.description: This fire drill is a simple item for starting fires; it is made from two pieces of wood and some string.  Since it is constructed out of simple materials, it's slow and rather difficult to get a fire started using this tool.

data.name: camp fire drill
data.description: This stout fire drill is a simple item for starting fires; it is made from two pieces of wood and some string.  Since it is constructed out of simple materials, it's slow and rather difficult to get a fire started using this tool.

data.name: firecracker
data.description: A solitary firecracker with a short fuse.  Use this item to light the fuse.  Of course, you will need a lighter or some matches to do so.  Shortly after you light the fuse it will explode, so throw it quickly!

data.name: firecracker (lit)
data.description: A firecracker that has been lit; the fuse is hissing.  Throw it quickly before it explodes.

data.name: pack of firecrackers
data.description: This is a pack of 25 firecrackers with a starter fuse.  Use this item to light the fuse.  Of course, you will need a lighter or some matches to do so.  Shortly after you light the fuse they will begin to explode, so throw them quickly!

data.name: pack of firecrackers (lit)
data.description: A pack of 25 firecrackers that has been lit; the fuse is hissing.  Throw them quickly before the start to explode.

data.name: Rising Sun (off)
data.description: This is a katana with a nozzle just behind the cutting edge of the blade.  People love fire, and people love katanas, so why not put them together?  The gas burners attached to this blade can really turn up the heat on your foes.  Use to ignite.

data.name: Rising Sun (on)
data.description: This is a katana that glows with the fury and heat of the SUN!  Well, okay it's not THAT hot, but getting hit with it still stings like the dickens.  Use to shut off the gas.

use_action.water_extinguish_message: Your sword hisses in the water and goes out.

data.name: No. 9 (off)
data.description: This huge steel knife has been modified with a fuel tank, insulated handguard, and ignition system.  When filled with gasoline, a system of torches heats the blade, burning your target.

data.name: No. 9 (on)
data.description: This huge steel knife has been modified with a fuel tank, insulated handguard, and ignition system.  The blade is glowing with heat, making it a great plant scorcher and nightlight.

use_action.water_extinguish_message: Your No. 9 hisses in the water and goes out.

data.name: plastic fish trap
data.description: This is a makeshift fish trap made from plastic bottles.  It's simple, even primitive, but easy to use.  The principle of action: the fish swims inside for bait, but can't get out.  Not humane, prohibited by law, but there are no cops left to care.

data.name: fishing hook
data.description: A simple fishing hook.

data.name: improvised fishing hook
data.description: An improvised fishing hook carved from wood or bone.

data.name: basic fishing rod
data.description: 'Fishing rod' might be a bit too charitable of a description.  In truth, this is a stick with a piece of string and a hook.

data.name: pro fishing rod
data.description: A professional fishing rod with a matching set of weights.  With this you should be able to catch 'em all.

data.name: flammable arrow
data.description: This arrow has a rag soaked in a flammable liquid wrapped around the shaft near the head.  You need to light it before shooting.

data.name: flashbang
data.description: This is a military police style flashbang.  Use this item to pull the pin and light the fuse.  You will then have five turns before it detonates with intense light and sound, blinding, deafening and disorienting anyone nearby.

use_action.msg: You pull the pin on the flashbang.

data.name: active flashbang
data.description: This flashbang is active, and will soon detonate with intense light and sound, blinding, deafening and disorienting anyone nearby.  It may be a good idea to throw it!

use_action.no_deactivate_msg: You've already pulled the %s's pin, try throwing it instead.

data.name: sealed yeast culture
data.description: A sealed flask holding sanitized yeast wort.  You may harvest the yeast inside when it's done culturing.

use_action.msg: You open the flask and harvest the culture.
use_action.not_ready_msg: The yeast isn't done culturing yet.

data.name: flute
data.description: A simple silver-plated flute.

player_descriptions: You play a little tune on your flute.
You play a beautiful piece on your flute.
You play a piece on your flute that sounds harmonious with nature.

data.name: folding bicycle
data.description: This is a bicycle folded into a relatively portable package.

use_action.unfold_msg: You painstakingly unfold the bicycle and make it ready to ride.

data.name: electric forge
data.description: This is a portable electric metalworking forge, powered by batteries.  Combined with the right tools, you could use this for metalworking.  With a little mechanical know-how, you could probably even convert it to run directly off a vehicle's power system.

data.name: funnel
data.description: This is a funnel used to collect rainwater.  Use it outside and place a container beneath it to collect water when it rains.

use_action.done_message: You place the funnel, waiting to collect rain.

data.name: fur rollmat
data.description: This is a bedroll made of pelts which can be rolled up for transport.  It insulates you from the floor, making it easier to sleep.  Use it to unroll and place on the ground.

use_action.done_message: You unroll the fur mat and lay it on the ground.

data.name: trowel
data.description: A small, sharp gardening shovel, perfect for digging up grubs and worms.

data.name: makeshift gas canister
data.description: This is a crude gasbomb using household chemicals.  Use this item to arm it.  In three turns it will begin to expel a highly toxic gas for a short time.  This gas poisons those exposed to it, in addition to obscuring vision and scent.

use_action.msg: You arm the makeshift gas canister.

data.name: active makeshift gas grenade
data.description: This homemade canister of poison gas has been unsealed, and is (or will shortly be) expelling highly toxic gas.  You should consider getting rid of it soon.

use_action.no_deactivate_msg: You've already armed the %s, try throwing it instead.

data.name: gasoline cooker
data.description: This is a simple heater powered by gasoline.  It is designed for cooking food.

data.name: gasoline lantern (off)
data.description: This is a small gasoline powered lantern.  It does not provide much light, but it lasts a long time.  Use it to turn it on.

data.name: gasoline lantern (on)
data.description: This is a small gasoline powered lantern.  It does not provide much light, but it lasts a long time.  It is turned on.  Use it to turn it off.

data.name: geiger counter (off)
data.description: This is a tool for measuring radiation.  Using it will prompt you to choose whether to scan yourself or the terrain, or to turn it on, which will provide continuous feedback on ambient radiation.  It is currently off.

data.name: geiger counter (on)
data.description: This is a tool for measuring radiation.  It is in continuous scan mode, and will produce quiet clicking sounds in the presence of ambient radiation.  Using it allows you to turn it off, or scan yourself or the ground.  It is currently on.

data.name: seeing this is a bug
data.description: seeing this is a bug

data.name: glowstick
data.description: This is a small blue light glowstick.  Use it to bend the plastic and break the glass cylinder inside to start the reaction.  It will produce a small amount of light.

data.name: dead glowstick
data.description: This is a spent glowstick.  It is essentially trash.

data.name: active glowstick
data.description: This is an active glowstick and is producing light.  It will last for a few hours before burning out.

data.name: grappling hook
data.description: A folding grappling hook attached to a stout 30-foot long piece of lightweight cord.  Useful for keeping yourself safe from falls.

data.name: grenade
data.description: This is a military grade fragmentary hand grenade.  Use this item to pull the pin and light the fuse.  You will then have five turns before it explodes; throwing it would be a good idea.

use_action.msg: You pull the pin on the grenade.

data.name: active grenade
data.description: This is an active grenade, and will explode any second now.  Better throw it!

use_action.no_deactivate_msg: You've already pulled the %s's pin, try throwing it instead.

data.name: incendiary grenade
data.description: This is a military grade incendiary hand grenade.  Use this item to pull the pin and light the fuse.  You will then have five turns before it explodes into a raging inferno; throwing it would be a good idea.

use_action.msg: You pull the pin on the grenade.

data.name: active incendiary grenade
data.description: This is an active incendiary grenade, likely to burst into an inferno any second now.  Better throw it!

data.name: hacksaw
data.description: This is a sturdy saw, useful for cutting through metal objects.

data.name: Halligan bar
data.description: This is a heavy multiple-use tool commonly carried by firefighters, law enforcement, and military rescue units.  Use it to open locked doors without destroying them or to lift manhole covers.  You could also wield it to bash some heads in.

data.name: hammer
data.description: This is a demagnetized steel hammer with a wooden grip.  With a hammer, nails, and two by fours in your inventory, you could board up adjacent doors and windows.  It has myriad other uses as well.

data.name: hand drill
data.description: A primitive manual drill with a single drill bit.  It is slow and it will exhaust you quickly.

data.name: heat pack
data.description: This is a chemical heat pack.  It's used to treat sports injuries and heat food.  It is usable only once.

data.name: used heat pack
data.description: This is a chemical heat pack.  It's used to treat sports injuries and heat food.  This one has been used and is chemically inert, rendering it useless.

data.name: heavy snare kit
data.description: This is a kit for a simple trap consisting of a rope noose and a snare trigger.  It requires a tree nearby.  It is effective at trapping monsters.

use_action.done_message: You set the snare trap.

data.name: hoe
data.description: This is a farming implement.  Use it to turn tillable land into a slow-to-cross pile of dirt.

data.name: honey scraper
data.description: A sharp, knife-like tool used in harvesting honey from beehives.  Makes a passable melee weapon.

data.name: bicycle horn
data.description: This is a simple bulb horn, found on many bicycles.  Use to honk.  Honk honk.

data.name: truck horn
data.description: This is a very loud horn, usually found on large trucks like semis.

data.name: car horn
data.description: This is a car horn meant to be attached to a car's electrical system.

data.name: rubber hose
data.description: This is a flexible rubber hose.  It could be used for crafting, or siphoning fuel from a vehicle.

data.name: hotplate
data.description: This is a small heating element on a stand, powered by batteries.  It is indispensable for cooking and chemistry.  Try not to burn yourself.

data.name: hygrometer
data.description: A plastic hygrometer that can read the relative humidity in the air.

data.name: ice axe
data.description: This is an ice axe with hammer on its head, a multi-purpose hiking and climbing tool used by mountaineers.  It is sturdy enough, so you can use it to pry open closed doors or lift manhole covers.

data.name: jackhammer
data.description: This is a construction tool for drilling through hard rock or other surfaces.  It runs on gasoline.  Use it (if loaded) to blast a hole in adjacent solid terrain.

data.name: sealed jar of pickles
data.description: This is a sealed glass jar containing pickles.  Use to open and eat to enjoy.

use_action.msg: You open the jar, exposing it to the atmosphere.

data.name: sealed jar of sauerkraut
data.description: This is a sealed glass jar containing sauerkraut.  Use to open and eat to enjoy.

use_action.msg: You open the jar, exposing it to the atmosphere.

data.name: katana
data.description: This is a rare sword from Japan.  Deadly against unarmored targets, and still very effective against armor.

data.name: Kevlar plate
data.description: This is a plate of reinforced Kevlar.  It could be used to repair items made of Kevlar.

data.name: finished charcoal kiln
data.description: A charcoal kiln that has finished burning.  Disassemble it to retrieve the charcoal and kiln.

data.name: filled charcoal kiln
data.description: A kiln filled with wood which will become charcoal after a slow period of burning.

use_action.need_fire_msg: You need something to light it with!

data.name: lit charcoal kiln
data.description: A kiln full of wood that has been lit; better drop it!

use_action.msg: The kilns embers have died out, you can now disassemble it to harvest the charcoal.

data.name: butcher knife
data.description: This is a sharp, heavy knife.  It makes a good melee weapon, and is an ideal item for butchering corpses.

data.name: combat knife
data.description: This is a military combat knife.  It is light and extremely sharp, and could be deadly in either the right hands or when attached as a bayonet.

data.name: hunting knife
data.//: Highest non-powertool butchering quality.  It's made for skinning and butchering game, which is what you're generally doing.
data.description: Commonly used by hunters, this single-edge sheath knife is designed for cutting and skinning game rather than combat.

data.name: survival knife
data.//: This isn't really supposed to be a very good knife, or a very good saw.  It's more for looking scary.
data.description: This massive knife features a hollow handle with a compass built into the pommel and a row of fearsome looking saw teeth along the back of its blade.

data.name: RM42 fighting knife
data.description: This sturdy matte black Rivtech combat dagger features a long and slim double-edged blade with a spear-point and a distinctive slip-resistant grip which can also be used to affix it to a suitable firearm.  Originally manufactured for the military, it was very popular in films and among collectors due to its fearsome appearance.

data.name: steak knife
data.description: This is a sharp knife, designed for cutting meat.  It makes a poor melee weapon, but is decent at butchering corpses.

data.name: Swiss Army knife
data.//: The swiss army knife is a bit more of a knife than a toolkit.
data.description: An iconic pocket knife imported from Europe.  Its red plastic handle conceals many small tools.

data.name: trench knife
data.description: This stout combat knife features a steel guard to protect the user's knuckles.  The guard can also be used for striking or blocking, and the knife can also be used to butcher corpses.

data.name: knitting needles
data.description: A pair of stout wooden needles with round ends used to turn thread and yarn into cloth.

data.name: kris
data.description: This wavy bladed dagger comes from Southeast Asia.  The design of the blade causes it to make broad, painful wounds.

data.name: kukri
data.description: This versatile implement is a modern take on a traditional weapon that originated in Nepal.  Featuring a heavy blade with an inwardly curved edge, it is used as both a tool and as a weapon.

data.name: L-stick (off)
data.description: Produced by the Light corporation, this stylish staff not only functions as a light source, but doubles as a light-weight weapon, due to the superalloy materials it is made of.  Due to proprietary efficiency improvements over standard light sources, the L-stick or light stick as it is commonly called, batteries last longer than other light sources.

data.name: L-stick (on)
data.description: Produced by the Light corporation, this stylish staff not only functions as a light source, but doubles as a light-weight weapon, due to the superalloy materials it is made of.  Due to proprietary efficiency improvements over standard light sources, the L-stick or light stick as it is commonly called, batteries last longer than other light sources.  The staff is glowing brightly, which is slowly draining the batteries.

data.name: land mine
data.description: This is an military anti-personnel mine that is triggered when stepped upon.

use_action.done_message: You set the land mine.

data.name: gunsmith repair kit
data.description: This is a complete toolkit made to repair damaged firearms.  Powered by standard batteries, it is a vital tool for long-term firearms maintenance.  It requires 25 charges of battery power per use.

data.name: large tent
data.description: This is a family sized tent.  It provides a large amount of space, but is very bulky.

data.name: leather funnel
data.description: This is a small, leather funnel used to collect rainwater.  Use it outside and place a container beneath it to collect water when it rains.

use_action.done_message: You place the leather funnel, waiting to collect rain.

data.name: light snare kit
data.description: This is a kit for a simple trap consisting of a string noose and a snare trigger.  It requires a young tree nearby.  It is effective at trapping and killing some small animals.

use_action.done_message: You set the snare trap.

data.name: lighter
data.description: This is a disposable plastic lighter.  A lighter must be carried to use various drugs, like cigarettes, or to light things like Molotov cocktails.  You can also use a lighter to light nearby items on fire.

data.name: lightstrip
data.description: This is a light-emitting circuit wired directly to some batteries.  It provides some weak light and can't be turned off.  When the batteries die, you'll need to scrap it to recover the components that are reusable.

data.name: lightstrip (unpowered)
data.description: This is a unpowered lightstrip.  You could connect it to batteries to get a light-emitting circuit.

data.name: lightstrip (inactive)
data.description: This is a light-emitting circuit wired directly to some batteries.  It will provide some weak light once activated and can't be turned off.  When the batteries die, you'll need to scrap it to recover the components that are reusable.

data.name: lobotomizer
data.description: This is a hand-forged collapsible tool that has two axe heads and sharp shovel-like tip on one end.  It can be used as a shovel, or you could chop some zombies with it instead.

data.name: machete
data.description: This huge steel knife makes an excellent tool for cutting down large vegetation or other 'obstacles.'

data.name: magnifying glass
data.description: This is a magnifying glass.  May be useful for starting fires during sunny skies.

data.name: makeshift crowbar
data.description: This is a pipe whose ends have been bent and hammered flat to resemble a crowbar.  Use it to open locked doors without destroying them, or to lift manhole covers.  You could also wield it to fight with, in a pinch.

data.name: makeshift funnel
data.description: This is a small, makeshift funnel used to collect rainwater.  Use it outside and place a container beneath it to collect water when it rains.

use_action.done_message: You place the makeshift funnel, waiting to collect rain.

data.name: makeshift glaive
data.//: Name changed to glaive, but changing the id would break e.g.  tilesets.
data.description: This is a large blade attached to a long stick.  It could do a considerable amount of damage.

data.name: makeshift hammer
data.description: This is a crude hammer make from a piece of metal affixed to a stick.  It functions adequately as a hammer, but really can't compare to a proper one.

data.name: makeshift knife
data.description: A knife consisting of a long, somewhat sharpened, spike and a tightly wrapped rag as a handle.  It makes a good melee weapon.

data.name: makeshift machete
data.description: This is a large blade that has had a portion of the handle wrapped in duct tape, making it easier to wield as a rough machete.

data.name: makeshift vacuum sealer
data.description: This is a homemade heat sealer unit with an air pump.  It's used for vacuum packing food to preserve it.

data.name: match head bomb
data.description: This is a homemade bomb consisting of a bottle filled with match heads and equipped with a fuse.  Use this item to light the fuse; you will, of course, need a lighter in your inventory to do this.

use_action.msg: You light the match head bomb.

data.name: match head bomb (lit)
data.description: This is a bottle filled with match heads and equipped with a fuse.  This one has been lit, and its fuse is rapidly burning down.  You may not want to hold onto it much longer.

use_action.no_deactivate_msg: You've already lit the %s, try throwing it instead.

data.name: matchbook
data.description: This is a small book of matches with a coarse strike surface on the outside flap.  Matches must be carried to use various drugs like cigarettes, or to light things like Molotov cocktails.  You can also use matches to light nearby items on fire.

data.name: mess kit
data.description: A self-contained camping mess kit, containing everything you might need for wilderness cooking.  This model relies on a battery-operated hotplate, rather than the more commonplace chemical-fueled Esbit stove.

data.name: metal funnel
data.description: This is a large metal funnel used to collect rainwater.  Less portable than plastic funnels, but collects more water.  Use it outside and place a container beneath it to collect water when it rains.

use_action.done_message: You place the metal funnel, waiting to collect rain.

data.name: metallic smoother
data.description: This metallic tool is most often used to smooth concrete, or mortar, in construction projects.

data.name: military mess kit
data.description: Military mess kit designed for long-range reconnaissance patrols deployed behind enemy lines.  All parts are made from thin sheet of aluminum / superalloy composite and are insulated with ceramic coating.  Relies on a battery-operated hotplate, rather than the smoke-producing chemical-fueled Esbit stove.  Compact, durable and lightweight.

data.name: military operations map
data.description: This is a printed topographical map of the local area.  Originally of military origin, it details the locations of evacuation centers and military facilities.  Using it will add points of interest to your map.

use_action.message: You add roads and facilities to your map.

data.name: mininuke
data.description: This is an extremely powerful weapon--essentially a hand-held nuclear bomb.  Use it to activate the timer.  You guess that the explosion would be large enough to take out a small house.

data.name: mininuke
data.description: This miniature nuclear bomb has a light blinking on the side, showing that it will soon explode.  You should probably get far, far away from it.

use_action.no_deactivate_msg: You've already set the %s's timer, you might want to get away from it.

data.name: basic repair kit
data.description: This is a portable toolkit.  When supplied with duct tape, it serves as a vital tool for fixing items made of wood, paper, bone, or chitin.  It requires 50 units of duct tape per use.

data.name: plastic mold
data.description: This is a plastic mold.  It could be shaped and used to craft items made of plastic.

data.name: Molotov cocktail
data.description: A bottle of flammable liquid with a rag inserted.  Use this item to light the rag.  You will, of course, need a lighter or matches in your inventory to do this.  After lighting it, throw it to cause fires.

data.name: Molotov cocktail (lit)
data.description: A bottle of flammable liquid with a flaming rag inserted.  Throwing it will cause the bottle to break, spreading fire.  The flame may go out shortly if you do not throw it.  Dropping it while lit is not safe.

data.name: mop
data.description: This is an unwieldy mop.  Good for cleaning up spills.  Use to mop up any 'mess' you may have made.

data.name: mp3 player (off)
data.description: This battery-devouring device is loaded up with someone's music collection.  Fortunately, there's lots of songs you like, and listening to it will raise your morale slightly.  Use it to turn it on.

data.name: mp3 player (on)
data.description: This mp3 player is turned on and playing some great tunes, raising your morale steadily while on your person.  It runs through batteries quickly; you can turn it off by using it.  It also obscures your hearing.

data.name: multi cooker
data.description: A professional-grade multi-cooker, with a battery slot for camping trips or tailgating.  Its multitude of settings and features promise to handle any sort of cooking, from parboiling potatoes to cooking curry to popping popcorn.  There's no manual, but you're sure you can work it out.

data.name: multi-tool
data.//: The multi-tool is a bit more of a toolkit than a knife.
data.description: A cleverly designed all-in-one tool which combines several smaller tools into the handles of a pair of pliers.

data.name: bone needle
data.description: This is sharp needle made from a bone.  It would be useful for making rough clothing and items.  Its low quality makes it rather unsuitable for anything requiring speed or precision.

data.name: curved needle
data.description: A curved sharp needle made of steel.  Its rounded shape allows it to make stitches that only pierce one side of the material.  While unsuitable for most tailoring projects, it's a necessity for stitching neoprene.

data.name: wooden needle
data.description: This is a wooden needle whittled down to a sharp point.  It has a narrow hole carved into the head for threading.  Its low quality makes it rather unsuitable for anything requiring speed or precision.

data.name: nodachi
data.description: This is a huge, curved, two-handed sword from Japan.  It is surprisingly light for its size.

data.name: noise emitter (off)
data.description: This device was constructed by 'enhancing' a radio with some amplifier circuits.  It's completely lost its ability to pick up a station, but it's nice and loud now.  It could be useful to distract zombies.

data.name: noise emitter (on)
data.description: This device has been turned on and is emitting horrible sounds of radio static.  Quick, get away from it before it draws zombies to you!

data.name: lamp oil cooker
data.description: This is a simple heater powered by lamp oil.  It is designed for cooking food.

data.name: oil lamp (off)
data.description: This is an oil fueled lamp.  It does not provide much light, but it lasts a long time.  Use it to turn it on.

data.name: oil lamp (on)
data.description: This is an oil fueled lamp.  It does not provide much light, but it lasts a long time.  It is turned on.  Use it to turn it off.

data.name: oxygen tank
data.description: This is tank of compressed medical oxygen with a regulator and mask.  Commonly used in emergency situations, it provides immediate relief for asthma attacks or smoke inhalation, and can provide a brief burst of energy.

data.name: paint brush
data.description: A wide brush, suitable for painting walls.

data.name: frying pan
data.description: A cast-iron pan.  Makes a decent melee weapon, and is used for cooking.

data.name: pasta extruder
data.description: A pasta extruder run by a hand-crank.  Useful in making pasta.  It comes with various heads to make various kinds of pasta.

data.name: permanent marker
data.description: This is a King Size(tm) industrial strength permanent marker, about halfway between a typical marker and a can of spray paint in size.  Use it to write something down.  However, writing "Elbereth" probably won't help you.

data.name: pet carrier
data.description: A plastic container meant to hold pets for transport.

data.name: zombie pheromone
data.description: This is some kind of disgusting ball of rotting meat.  Squeezing it causes a small cloud of pheromones to spray into the air, causing nearby zombies to become friendly for a short period of time.

data.name: pickaxe
data.description: This is a large steel pickaxe, suitable for breaking up hard things or (with enough skill) hard targets.  Strike the earth!

data.name: locksmith kit
data.description: This is a locksmith's set of sturdy steel lock picks and torsion wrenches.  It is essential for silently and quickly opening locks, provided you have some mechanical skill.

data.name: fermenting pickle jar
data.description: This jar contains a batch of pickles set to ferment.  You can seal up the jar once the process is completed.

use_action.msg: You test the batch, and it tastes good, so you seal the jar up for storage.
use_action.not_ready_msg: The pickles are not done fermenting yet.
use_action.//: 2 1/3 days, from the suggested recipie of 1 rl week

data.name: awl pike
data.description: This is a medieval weapon consisting of a wood shaft tipped with an iron spike.  Though large and heavy compared to other spears, its accuracy and damage are unparalleled.

data.name: glass pipe
data.description: This is a hand-blown glass pipe.  It's of the type most commonly used to smoke recreational substances.

data.name: tobacco pipe
data.description: This is a hand-carved wooden smoking pipe.  It's designed to facilitate consumption of fire cured tobacco leaves.

data.name: pipe bomb
data.description: This is a section of a pipe filled with explosive materials.  Use this item to light the fuse, which gives you three turns to get away from it before it detonates.  You'll need a lighter or some matches to use it.  It is somewhat unreliable, and may fail to detonate.

use_action.msg: You light the fuse on the pipe bomb.

data.name: active pipe bomb
data.description: This pipe bomb's fuse is lit, and it will explode any second now.  Throw it immediately!

data.name: radio pipe bomb
data.description: A radio-detonated pipe bomb.  Activate it to arm the detonator, then place somewhere and press a button on the radio control.

use_action.msg: You arm your radio-detonated pipe bomb.

data.name: activated radio pipe bomb
data.description: A radio-detonated pipe bomb, armed.  Place it or attach to a RC car, then get away and use the radio-control to detonate.

use_action.no_deactivate_msg: You can't disarm your %s'.  Place it, get away, and use the remote control to detonate.

data.name: plastic chunk
data.description: This is a piece of plastic.  It could be used to fabricate, repair, or reinforce plastic items.

data.name: pliers
data.description: This is a basic pair of slip-joint pliers, able to handle basic mechanical work.  Anything too complex will require a wrench.

data.name: pocket knife
data.description: This is a small pocket knife.  It isn't great for combat, but it's better than nothing.  It's sharp enough to butcher with.

data.name: electric polisher
data.description: An electric polisher which can be used to buff metal surfaces until they are reflective like a mirror.

data.name: soda can stove kit
data.//: Should be 20 but currently recipes do not utilize this value
data.description: This is an ultra-light alcohol-burning stove with simmer ring, crafted by hand from a couple of aluminum soda cans.  It comes with a 500 ml plastic bottle to hold concentrated alcohol fuel.

data.name: handheld game system
data.description: This is a portable games console in working condition, with a backlit screen allowing you to play in the dark.  You can use it to play it for a little while, but this requires batteries.

data.name: portal generator
data.description: This is a rare, bizarre, and arcane device of an otherworldly nature.  It's giving you a headache just looking at it.  It is covered in alien markings.

data.name: pot
data.description: Useful for boiling water when cooking spaghetti and more.

data.name: copper pot
data.description: Useful for boiling water when cooking spaghetti and more.  Made from copper, with a lining of tin to prevent metal from leaching into acidic foods.

data.name: hand press & die set
data.description: This is a small hand press for hand loading firearm ammunition.  It comes with everything you need to start hand loading your own munitions.

data.name: stone adze
data.description: This is a stone adze, somewhat useful for cutting through wood objects.

data.name: stone axe
data.description: This is a sharpened stone affixed to a stick.  It works passably well as an axe but really can't compare to a proper axe.

data.name: stone hammer
data.description: This is a rock affixed to a stick, in the crude facsimile of a hammer.  It functions adequately as a hammer, but really can't compare to a proper one.

data.name: stone knife
data.description: This is a sharpened stone set into a hollowed handle.  Not nearly as usable as a proper knife, but it's better than nothing.

data.name: stone shovel
data.description: This is a flattened stone affixed to a stick.  It works passably well as a shovel but really can't compare to a real shovel.

data.name: bio lockpick
data.description: this a pseudo item

data.name: kinetic bullet puller
data.description: This is a tool used for properly disassembling firearm ammunition.

data.name: rag
data.description: This is a largish piece of cloth, useful in crafting and possibly for staunching bleeding.

data.name: rapier
data.description: This is a thin sword with an ornate hand guard.  It looks like the preferred weapon of gentlemen and swashbucklers.  Light and quick, it makes any battle a stylish battle.

data.name: refillable lighter
data.description: This is a lighter featuring a flip top cover and refuelable tank.  A lighter must be carried to use various drugs, like cigarettes, or to light things like Molotov cocktails.  You can also use a lighter to light nearby items on fire.

data.name: refillable lighter (lit)
data.description: This is a lighter featuring a flip top cover and refuelable tank.  It is lit.

data.name: restaurant guide
data.description: This is glossy printed pamphlet that details dining establishments in the local area.  Printed by the Chamber of Commerce, it lists the addresses of all the best diners and bars.  Using it will add points of interest to your map.

use_action.message: You add roads and restaurants to your map.

data.name: road map
data.description: This is a road map for the local area.  Listing information on civic sites like hospitals and police stations, it can be used to add points of interest to your map.

use_action.message: You add roads and points of interest to your map.

data.name: stone pot
data.description: A large stone, roughly hollowed out into a pot.

data.name: quern
data.description: This is a simple hand-powered stone quern for grinding grain.

data.name: rollmat
data.description: This is a sheet of foam which can be rolled tightly for storage.  It insulates you from the floor, making it easier to sleep.  Use it to unroll and place on the ground.

use_action.done_message: You unroll the mat and lay it on the ground.

data.name: RX12 jet injector
data.description: The Rivtech RX12 jet injector is a small pistol-shaped device used to inject advanced fast-healing chemicals through the skin without using a needle.  A label on the side warns against using more than two doses per hour.

data.name: safe deposit box
data.description: This is a secure combination lock box.  Sadly, you don't know the combination.  Breaking inside it would destroy anything of value.

data.name: sarcophagus access code
data.description: This printout is a string of numbers to access the elevator in the hazardous waste sarcophagus.

data.name: fermenting sauerkraut jar
data.description: This jar contains a batch of sauerkraut set to ferment.  You can seal up the jar once the process is completed.

use_action.msg: You test the batch, and it tastes good, so you seal the jar up for storage.
use_action.not_ready_msg: The sauerkraut isn't done fermenting yet.
use_action.//: 2 1/3 days, from the suggested recipie of 1 rl week

data.name: wood saw
data.description: This is a thin saw, useful for cutting through wood objects.

data.name: scalpel
data.description: This is a very sharp knife designed for surgical cutting.  It's small, sharp blade allows for precision strikes in the hands of the skilled.

data.name: pair of scissors
data.description: These are a long pair of heavy duty scissors.  Use scissors to cut items made from cotton (like clothing) into rags.

data.name: scrambler grenade
data.description: This is a highly modified EMP grenade, designed to scramble robots' IFF control chips, rather than destroy them.  This converts the robot to your side for a short time, before the backup systems kick in.  Use this item to pull the pin and light the fuse, turning it into an active scrambler grenade.

use_action.msg: You pull the pin on the scrambler grenade.

data.name: active scrambler grenade
data.description: This scrambler grenade is active, and will soon detonate, releasing a control wave that temporarily converts robots to your side.

use_action.no_deactivate_msg: You've already pulled the %s's pin, try throwing it instead.

data.name: screwdriver
data.description: This is a Philips-head screwdriver.  It is important for almost all electronics crafting, most mechanics crafting, and has many more uses.

data.name: screwdriver set
data.description: This is a set of screwdrivers in several sizes and blade types.  Guaranteed to have the right tools for more precise work.

data.name: scythe
data.description: This is an old-fashioned farming tool used to cut tall grass.  While it may be a giant blade on the end of a stick, it is incredibly awkward to use for anything but its intended purpose.

data.name: war scythe
data.description: This farming tool has been modified into a weapon by reinforcing and rotating its blade 90 degrees, transforming it into a deadly giant blade on the end of a stick.

data.name: sewing kit
data.description: This is a plastic kit with a variety of needles, some plastic spools for thread, and a few other useful textile tools.  Use a sewing kit on an article of clothing to attempt to repair or reinforce that clothing.  This uses your tailoring skill.

data.name: shaving kit
data.description: This is a compact and lightweight shaving kit made for travelers.  You can use it to shave if it's supplied with soap.  It requires 1 unit of soap per use.

data.name: shelter kit
data.description: This is a small shelter, made of sticks and skins.  Use it to place.

data.name: shishkebab (off)
data.description: This is a large blade with a fuel pipe on the side, and a small tank and igniter built into the insulated hilt.  When filled with gasoline, the blade can be made scorching hot to singe enemies and light your way.  Use to ignite.

use_action.failure_message: Aw, dangit.  It fails to start!

data.name: shishkebab (on)
data.description: This is a large blade with a fuel pipe on the side, and a small tank and igniter built into the insulated hilt.  The blade is glowing brightly.  Use to shut off the gas.

use_action.auto_extinguish_message: Bummer, man!  Your shishkebab's flame flickers and dies out.
use_action.voluntary_extinguish_message: Peace out.  Your shishkebab's flame dies.
use_action.charges_extinguish_message: Uncool, outta gas!  Your shishkebab's flame goes out.
use_action.water_extinguish_message: Your shishkebab hisses in the water and goes out.

data.name: powered quarterstaff
data.description: This is an ironshod quarterstaff that has a high-voltage stun gun built into the handle.  The stun gun is wired to the metal caps at either end of the staff, allowing you to zap a dangerous opponent should beating them senseless with it prove too hazardous.

data.name: tactical tonfa (off)
data.description: This is a reinforced plastic tonfa; the core is hollowed out and is filled with capacitors and a high-yield rechargeable storage battery.  When a switch on the handle is pressed, a high-voltage current is transmitted to the two electrodes mounted in the end of the tonfa, and by extension to anyone unfortunate enough to be in contact with them.  It also has a nifty flashlight, which is off at the moment.

data.name: tactical tonfa (on)
data.description: This is a reinforced plastic tonfa; the core is hollowed out and is filled with capacitors and a high-yield rechargeable storage battery.  When a switch on the handle is pressed, a high-voltage current is transmitted to the two electrodes mounted in the end of the weapon, and by extension to anyone unfortunate enough to be in contact with them.  The integral flashlight is turned on, continually draining power and lighting the surrounding area.

data.name: shotgun trap
data.description: This is a simple tripwire is attached to the trigger of a loaded sawn-off shotgun.  When pulled, the shotgun fires.  Two shells are loaded; the first time the trigger is pulled, one or both shells may be discharged.

use_action.done_message: You set the shotgun trap.

data.name: shovel
data.description: This is a digging tool.  Use it to dig pits adjacent to your location.

data.name: sickle
data.description: This is an old-fashioned farming tool used to cut tall grass.  While it may be a massive curved blade on a handle, it is incredibly awkward to use for anything but its intended purpose.

data.name: small fire extinguisher
data.description: This is a hand held fire extinguisher containing a liter of highly compressed C02 gas.  It would be useful for putting out adjacent fires.

data.name: firearm repair kit
data.description: This is a portable toolkit made to repair damaged firearms.  Powered by standard batteries, it is a vital tool for long-term firearms maintenance.  It requires 100 charges of battery power per use.

data.name: smart lamp (off)
data.description: This is a smart lamp, it can be activated remotely.

use_action.msg: You turn the smart lamp on.
use_action.need_charges_msg: The smart lamp batteries are dead.

data.name: smart lamp (on)
data.description: This is a smart lamp, this smart lamp is turned on.  It can be deactivated remotely.

data.name: emergency oxygen pack
data.description: This is a small tank of compressed medical oxygen with a folding regulator and mask.  Commonly used in emergency situations, it provides immediate relief for asthma attacks or smoke inhalation, and can provide a brief burst of energy.

data.name: snare trigger
data.description: This is a stick that has been cut into a trigger mechanism for a snare trap.

data.name: soldering iron
data.description: This is a device with a metal tip that can get very hot.  It is necessary for advanced electronics crafting.  You could also use it to cauterize wounds, if you had to.

data.name: knife spear
data.description: This is a simple wood pole made much more deadly by the blade tied to it.

data.name: spray can
data.description: This is a spray can, filled with paint.  Use this tool to make graffiti on the floor.

data.name: stepladder
data.description: This is a wooden stepladder.  Use it to set it down.

data.name: still
data.description: This is a still.  It's useful for creating distillation of alcohol and other, more curious substances.

data.name: survival marker
data.description: This is a sharpened piece of charcoal that is almost guaranteed to make your hands all covered in charcoal.  Use it to write something down.

data.name: makeshift haircut kit
data.description: This is a kit with tools for cutting hair.

data.name: survivor machete
data.description: This common gardening tool has been customized and rebalanced to improve its performance as a weapon.

data.name: survivor mess kit
data.description: A homemade mess kit, containing everything you might need for creating post-apocalyptic cuisine.  Powered by a lamp oil burner, it is composed of simple yet durable tools and materials.

data.name: survivor telescope
data.description: A homemade collapsible telescope.  Too large and inaccurate to use as a weapon scope, but carrying this item in your inventory will double the distance that is mapped around you during your travels.

data.name: makeshift shaving kit
data.description: This is a makeshift shaving kit.  You can use it to shave if it's supplied with soap.  It requires 1 unit of soap per use.

data.name: survivor's map
data.description: This is a hand-drawn map of the local area.  Whomever created it has marked down the locations of nearby supply sources including gun stores and gas stations.  Using it will add points of interest to your map.

use_action.message: You add roads and possible supply points to your map.

data.name: swage and die set
data.description: These are a set of swages and dies for metalsmithing.  These loops and metal blocks are used in some metalworking fabrication recipes.

data.name: switchblade
data.description: This is a long and thin knife with a spring-loaded blade that rests inside the handle while not in use.

data.name: sword bayonet
data.description: A sword bayonet is a large slashing weapon that can be attached to the front of a firearm or crossbow converting it into a pike.

data.name: syringe
data.description: A medical syringe.  Used for administering intravenous drugs.

data.name: tailor's kit
data.description: This is a high quality, plastic kit with a variety of needles, some plastic spools for thread, some small scissors, even a small heating element for melting and joining plastic.  Use a tailor's kit to customize your clothing and armor.  This uses your tailoring skill.

data.name: talking doll
data.description: This is a talking doll, meant for children.  Fortunately it still works, and you could unload the batteries out of it.

data.name: tanning leather hide
data.description: A treated animal hide which is undergoing the chemical processes required to become leather.  You will be able to activate it to unroll and make use of it when it is done.

use_action.msg: You carefully unfold the tanning leather hide and shake it clean.
use_action.not_ready_msg: The tanning leather hide isn't done yet.

data.name: tanning fur pelt
data.description: A treated animal pelt which is undergoing the chemical processes required to become fur.  You will be able to activate it to unroll and make use of it when it is done.

use_action.msg: You carefully unfold the tanning fur pelt and shake it clean.
use_action.not_ready_msg: The tanning fur pelt isn't done yet.

data.name: tanto
data.description: Long Japanese knives like this more-modern remake were the samurai's backup weapon, before the advent of the larger wakizashi.  It's still a deadly blade, even if it's smaller than its more famous relatives.

data.name: tazer
data.description: This is a high-powered stun gun.  Use this item to attempt to electrocute an adjacent enemy, damaging and temporarily paralyzing them.  Because the shock can actually jump through the air, it is difficult to miss.

data.name: teapot
data.description: A small metal teapot.  Teatime wouldn't be complete without one.

data.name: teleport pad
data.description: This is a kit for a teleporter trap consisting of a teleporter and a solar cell that is triggered when stepped upon.

use_action.done_message: You place the telepad.

data.name: teleporter
data.description: This is an experimental device that will teleport you a short distance when activated.

data.name: telescoping umbrella
data.description: A telescoping umbrella which collapses down for easy storage, useful for keeping dry when wielded.

data.name: tent
data.description: This is a small personal tent, it's just big enough to fit you comfortably.

data.name: Flaming Chunk of Steel +2
data.description: HOLY SHIT THIS THING IS ON FIRE

data.name: thermometer
data.description: A plastic thermometer that can read the air temperature.

data.name: throwable fire extinguisher
data.description: This is a fire extinguisher in grenade form.  While not as effective as a regular fire extinguisher, you can use it from a distance.  It is activated by heat, so just throw it into the flames.

data.name: pair of metal tongs
data.description: These are long, metal tongs.  They are commonly used for cooking or in metalworking fabrication recipes.

data.name: ANFO charge
data.description: This is a large metal keg filled with ANFO pellets and equipped with a dynamite primer.  Use this item to light the fuse.  You will then have twenty turns before it explodes and creates a large fireball.

explosion.//: Fire would burn away/degrade some of the ANFO before the detonator would trigger.

use_action.msg: You light the fuse on the ANFO charge.  Run survivor, run!

data.name: active ANFO charge
data.description: This is a large metal keg filled with ANFO pellets and equipped with a dynamite primer.  The fuse has been lit - better run like hell!

explosion.//: Fire exposure would burn away/degrade some of the ANFO before the detonator would trigger.

use_action.no_deactivate_msg: You've already lit the fuse - run!

data.name: black gunpowder bomb
data.description: This is a tin can filled to the brim with black gunpowder and with a bit of fuse sticking out of it.

use_action.msg: You light the fuse on the black gunpowder bomb.  Throw it before it blows in your face!

data.name: active black gunpowder bomb
data.description: This is a tin can filled to the brim with black gunpowder and with a lit fuse stuck inside of it.

use_action.no_deactivate_msg: You've already lit the fuse - throw it!

data.name: black gunpowder charge
data.description: This is a home-made explosive device, consisting of a large plastic jug filled with black gunpowder and scrap metal, equipped with a long fuse.  Use this item to light the fuse.  Should explode in no more than five turns...

use_action.msg: You light the fuse on the black gunpowder charge.  Get rid of it quickly!

data.name: active black gunpowder charge
data.description: This is a home-made explosive device, consisting of a large plastic jug filled with black gunpowder and scrap metal, whose fuse has been lit, its final countdown starting.

use_action.no_deactivate_msg: You've already lit the fuse - run!

data.name: RDX charge
data.description: This is an metal keg, filled with 50 litres worth of RDX and scrap metal.  Contains a core of primary explosive to ensure that the charge detonates completely and delivers its entire destructive power to everything in sight.

explosion.//: Fire exposure would destroy most of the RDX before the HMTD core triggered, resulting in a far smaller blast (relatively speaking).

use_action.msg: You light the fuse on the explosive charge.  Clear the area!

data.name: active RDX charge
data.description: This is an metal keg, filled with 50 litres worth of RDX and scrap metal.  The fuse has been lit and once it ignites the primary explosive, the charge will detonate and rain fire and steel on everything in sight.

explosion.//: Fire exposure would destroy most of the RDX before the HMTD core triggered, resulting in a far smaller blast (relatively speaking).

use_action.no_deactivate_msg: You've already lit the fuse - clear the area immediately!

data.name: RDX sand bomb
data.description: This is a steel pipe, containing a mixture of RDX and sand, the former propelling the latter into a deadly mist of vicious shrapnel.  Use this item to light the fuse.

explosion.//: Fire exposure would burn away the RDX, leaving the HMTD detonator as nearly the sole source of the blast.

use_action.msg: You light the fuse on the sand bomb.  Throw it!

data.name: active RDX sand bomb
data.description: This is a steel pipe, containing a mixture of RDX and sand, the former propelling the latter into a deadly mist of vicious shrapnel.  The fuse has been lit, so why are you still holding it?

explosion.//: Fire exposure would burn away the RDX, leaving the HMTD detonator as nearly the sole source of the blast.

use_action.no_deactivate_msg: You've already lit the fuse - what are you waiting for?

data.name: rocket candy
data.description: A pear-shaped chunk of rocket candy obtained by heating saltpetre with sugar and casting the obtained liquid.  Can serve as a rocket fuel, but also as a smokescreen – if you lit the narrow end, you should be able to throw it before the flame reaches the broad end.

use_action.msg: You light the rocket candy on fire.  Throw it!

data.name: burning rocket candy
data.description: This is a chunk of rocket candy that has been lit on fire and burns with a loud hiss, spewing forth large amounts of smoke.

use_action.no_deactivate_msg: You've already lit the fuse – get rid of it immediately!

data.name: toolbox
data.description: This is a stout metal box containing a complete tool kit suitable for most household maintenance and construction activities.

data.name: torch
data.description: This is a large stick, wrapped in rags that are soaked with a flammable material.  When lit, produces a fair amount of light.  You'll need a lighter or matches to light it.

data.name: torch (lit)
data.description: This is a large stick, wrapped in rags that are soaked with a flammable material.  It is burning, producing plenty of light.

data.name: tourist guide
data.description: This is glossy printed pamphlet for tourists that details local hotels and attractions.

use_action.message: You add roads and tourist attractions to your map.

data.name: hedge trimmer (off)
data.description: A cordless, double-sided, gasoline-powered hedge trimmer.  A long line of sharp-edged teeth extends from the engine; turning the trimmer on will make them rapidly vibrate.  The poor man's chainsaw as far as the zombies are concerned.

data.name: hedge trimmer (on)
data.description: A cordless, double-sided, gasoline-powered hedge trimmer.  It is currently on, ready to do some zombie topiary; use this item to turn it off.

data.name: tripwire trap
data.description: This is some thin strong cable with some affixing tools on either end.  A tripwire trap must be placed across a doorway or other thin passage.  Its purpose is to trip up bypassers, causing them to stumble and possibly hurt themselves slightly.

use_action.done_message: You string up the tripwire.

data.name: trumpet
data.description: A brass trumpet with only a few dents here and there.

player_descriptions: You play a little tune on your trumpet.
You play a slow, mourning piece on your trumpet.
You play a little ballad on your trumpet.

data.name: ukulele
data.description: A small factory made ukulele.  Looks to be in working condition.

player_descriptions: You play a little tune on your ukulele.
You play a cute little ditty on your ukulele.
You play a small jam on your ukulele.

data.name: umbrella
data.description: An umbrella with a pointy end, useful for keeping dry when wielded.

data.name: vacuum sealer
data.description: This is a portable heat sealer unit with an air pump.  It's used for vacuum packing food to preserve it.

data.name: blood draw kit
data.description: This is a kit for drawing blood, including a test tube for holding the sample.  Use this tool to draw blood, either from yourself or from a corpse you are standing on.

data.name: vibrator
data.description: This battery-devouring device is just the thing to knead the tension out and help you relax.  Use it to take a break and unwind.

data.name: violin
data.description: A cheap, factory-made violin with a built-in holder for a bow.  Still produces a nice sound.

player_descriptions: You play a little tune on your violin.
You play a beautiful orchestral piece on your violin.
You play a quick, southern ditty on your fiddle.

data.name: golden fiddle
data.description: A shiny golden fiddle, with a strange aura around it.  You feel like it once belonged to the best there's ever been.

player_descriptions: You play a quick, folksy tune on your fiddle.
As you pull the bow across its strings, it makes an evil hiss.
You play a tune so fierce, it feels like hell's broke loose.

data.name: vortex stone
data.description: This is a stone with spirals all over it, and holes around its perimeter.  Though it is fairly large, it weighs next to nothing.  Air seems to gather around it.

data.name: waffle iron
data.description: A waffle iron.  For making waffles.

data.name: wakizashi
data.description: This is a comparatively-common Japanese short sword.  Smaller and lighter than a katana, but still effective in combat.

data.name: washboard
data.description: This is a wooden washboard.  You can use it to wash filthy clothing if it's supplied with cleansing agent.

data.name: water purifier
data.description: This is a battery-powered device designed to purify drinking water.  Using this item on a container full of water will purify the contents.  It could be useful for water taken from uncertain sources like a river, as it may be non-potable.

data.name: Doppler Radar Turbo 2000
data.description: A briefcase with built-in laptop that looks like it's from the 80s.  Its vintage monochrome monitor displays a plethora of meteorological data.  No sign of the FLDSMDFR, however.

data.name: welder
data.description: This is a battery powered tool for welding metal pieces together.  It is an indispensable tool for construction or repair.

data.name: makeshift welder
data.description: This crude welder has been fashioned from a bundle of copper wire, scrap metal, and complete disregard for personal safety.  While it's not as efficient as a factory welder, it will serve in a pinch.

data.name: wooden smoother
data.description: This large makeshift tool is used in smoothing concrete or mortar in construction projects.  You could also use it as an improvised head-basher.

data.name: wool staple
data.description: The natural cluster of wool fibers.  Could be processed to the felt patches or yarns.

data.name: wrapped radiation badge
data.description: This is a badge that detects radiation dosage sealed in a radiation-blocking bag.  Use it to remove it from the bag.

use_action.msg: You remove the badge from its wrapper, exposing it to ambient radiation.

data.name: wrench
data.description: This is an adjustable crescent wrench.  It could be a decent melee weapon, and is used in many mechanics crafting recipes.

data.name: X-Acto knife
data.description: This is a small, sharp knife, designed for making precise cuts for textiles or crafts.  It could cause decent damage, but is difficult to hit things with it.  Its small, sharp blade allows for precision strikes in the hands of the skilled.  It is too small to butcher corpses with.

data.name: flammenschwert (aus)
data.//: All of this is SUPPOSED to be in German.
data.description: Ein großes zweihändiges Schwert aus Deutschland, an dessen Klinge sich, unter Zuführung von Benzin, eine anhaltende Flamme erzeugen lässt.  Es ist eine sehr mächtige Waffe.

use_action.lacks_fuel_message: Dein Flammenschwert hat keinen Brennstoff mehr.

data.name: flammenschwert (an)
data.//: All of this is SUPPOSED to be in German.
data.description: Ein großes zweihändiges Schwert aus Deutschland, an dessen Klinge sich, unter Zuführung von Benzin, eine anhaltende Flamme erzeugen lässt.  Es ist eine sehr mächtige Waffe.

use_action.noise_message: Das Feuer um deine Schwertklinge leuchtet hell!
use_action.charges_extinguish_message: Deinem Flammenschwert ist der Brennstoff ausgegangen!

data.name: zweihänder
data.description: This is a huge two-handed sword from Germany.  It packs a real wallop.

data.name: food processor
data.description: This is a kitchen appliance capable of slicing, chopping, shredding, grinding, pureeing and mixing.

data.name: cattle fodder
data.description: What cattle eats.  Mainly made of grass, silages or legumes, is perfect for ruminants.

data.name: foldable-light frame
data.description: A small foldable lightweight frame made from pipework.

data.name: foldable wooden frame

data.name: Blinky
data.description: A strange three-eyed fish.

data.name: freshwater eel
data.description: An American eel.  Used to be quite common in these parts until the dams were built.  Guess they'll get a second chance now that they aren't running.

data.name: bowfin
data.description: A Bowfin.  These fish are related to gar but without the huge teeth, skin rending scales, and aggression.

data.name: bullhead
data.description: A bullhead, a type of catfish.  Delicious battered and fried.

data.name: trout
data.description: A trout is a trout, without a doubt.  A fish made popular by father-son fishing trips, Except for the part where you have to gut it.

data.name: carp
data.description: A golden-yellow common carp.  Some people think they don't taste great, but you can't afford to be choosy in the cataclysm.

data.name: pike
data.description: A pike.  Pike can be a pretty aggressive fish, careful around those teeth.

data.name: bluegill
data.description: A bluegill, An invasive species in Japan.  Commonly gutted and cooked whole.

data.name: smallmouth bass
data.description: A Smallmouth bass.  Being intolerant to pollution in the water, smallmouth bass are a good indicator of how clean it is.  Just because you see them though, doesn't mean you can drink the water without boiling it first.

data.name: largemouth bass
data.description: A largemouth bass.  Very popular with sports fishermen.

data.name: striped bass
data.description: A striped bass.  Mostly a salt water fish, they migrate to fresher water to spawn.

data.name: perch
data.description: A small spritely perch.  A very bony fish, still got some tasty meat on it though.

data.name: salmon
data.description: A salmon.  A very fatty, nutricious fish.  Tastes great smoked.

data.name: sunfish
data.description: A sunfish.  No, not the giant tropical thing.  This one is a small fish related to bass or bluegill.

data.name: whitefish
data.description: A whitefish, closely related to salmon.  One can assume they are just as nice when cooked with smoke.

data.name: pickerel
data.description: A pickerel.  It looks like a pike, but much smaller.

data.name: jawed terror
data.description: A once aggressive and hungry bull shark, this jawed terror is now even more aggressive, possibly thanks to its lack of a functioning brain.

data.name: giant carp
data.description: This thing seems like a carp, only swollen and very very angry.  Death is the gift of the carp god.

data.name: giant salmon
data.description: A mutated salmon, the same size as a large dog and quite dangerous to the inexperienced angler.

data.name: Lobster
data.description: These things were once considered pests not worth eating, then some marketing genius started selling them to people as a delicacy and they took off in popularity...  and price.

data.name: Crayfish
data.description: If you could get ahold of a bunch more of these, a hefty pot of boiling water, and some spicy seasonings...

data.name: laser turret
data.description: The TX-5LR Cerberus is an upgrade to its predecessors.  It features a state of the art revolving laser cannon system with three barrels that charge from solar cells embedded in its hull.

data.name: antimateriel turret
data.description: Leadworks LLC's T-107A1 Interdictor, an automated .50BMG antimateriel rifle.  Credited with forestalling countless car-bombing attempts, it has always been kept under extremely tight control, so as to itself maintain extremely tight control of its area.  And then the Cataclysm struck.

data.name: milspec turret
data.description: Leadworks LLC's T-4A1 Sentry.  It features improved firmware over General Atomics' TX-1 9mm model and an automated M4 carbine.

data.name: centipede
data.description: A predatory segmented arthropod with dozens of legs and a venomous bite.

data.name: deer mouse
data.description: The white-footed mouse, a prolific rodent with a white underbelly and a long fuzzy tail.  A common sight in fields, forests, and research centers.

data.name: dragonfly
data.description: A thin-bodied insectoid predator with a large wingspan and big compound eyes.

data.name: bull frog
data.description: The American bullfrog, in its natural habitat.  It feeds on insects, mice, lizards and any other living thing it can stuff down its gullet.

data.name: mosquito
data.description: A blood-sucking fly with a needle-like proboscis.  Its bite leaves behind itchy welts and can easily spread disease.

data.name: shrew
data.description: The masked shrew, a mouse-like creature with a pointed, whiskery snout.  It digs tunnels into the ground in search of bugs to eat.

data.name: slug
data.description: The leopard slug, an omnivorous gastropod.  It consumes decaying matter as well as planted crops, and will attack and eat other slugs that cross its path.

data.name: jumping spider
data.description: A little spider with elongated forelegs.  It does not build extensive webs, but leaps very quickly, appearing to move instantaneously from one spot to another.

data.name: trapdoor spider
data.description: A midsized spider with a bulbous thorax.  It creates a subterranean nest and lies in wait for prey to draw close enough for capture.

data.name: black widow spider
data.description: An infamous spider with a characteristic red hourglass marking on its black carapace, known for its highly toxic bite.

data.name: wolf spider
data.description: A fairly large spider which tracks and catches prey through agility and stealth.  Its bite can be irritating even to large animals.

data.name: wasp
data.description: A slender-bodied flying insect, with a painful sting.  They can be somewhat aggressive if disturbed.
