data.name: Evacuee
data.description: You have survived the initial wave of panic, and have achieved (relative) safety in one of the many government evac shelters.

data.name: Missed
data.description: Whether due to stubbornness, ignorance, or just plain bad luck, you missed the evacuation, and are stuck in a city full of the risen dead.

data.name: Infected
data.description: In the chaos and panic of evacuation, you got bitten by something!  You didn't get proper medical care, and now the wound has started turning green.

data.name: Burning Building
data.description: The building you had chosen to reside in has suddenly caught fire!  You might want to leave.

data.name: Challenge-Really Bad Day
data.description: You start drunk to the point of incapacitation, depressed, infected, surrounded by fire, naked, and sick with the flu.  This day went downhill really fast.

data.name: Challenge-Medieval Peasant
data.description: Som nigromancie hath brought yow hidder!  Ye have only the hoose on youre legges and the knyf at youre syde and youre prayeres to Marie moder of God.

data.name: Challenge-Lab
data.description: You've been locked in a lab with no (obvious) way out!  Find a way to escape or starve to death.

data.name: Ambush
data.description: It is the winter after zero hour, cold and weary you ducked into a small cabin for the night.  The next morning, you awoke to the sound of lots of movement in the woods.

data.name: The Next Summer
data.description: A little over a year has passed since the apocalypse started, and you're about to face your second summer in Hell.

data.name: Sheltered
data.description: When the apocalypse broke out, you were funnelled into a nearby shelter.  Here you have lived, never leaving, lest the unknowns of the outside world hurt you.  Supplies are running low, and for the first time since the cataclysm, you will be forced to face the outside world.

data.name: Challenge-Abandoned
data.description: Sickly and frail, you have spent most of your life in the patient's ward of the hospital.  When yours was evacuated, you were left behind because you were a lost cause.  You awaken to the sound of movement around the hospital.

data.name: Prison Break
data.description: You were a convicted felon planning your escape before the event.  Now the prisoners have turned into mindless horrors and the security bots are shooting on sight... you might need to expedite your escape plans.

data.name: Experiment
data.description: Since birth, your sole purpose in life has been the advancement of genetic science, willingly or not.  Once the cataclysm struck, you left the lab, and wandered aimlessly, ending up in a forest.

data.name: Mall Cop
data.description: You've survived for as long as you could inside of the mall you worked at as a security guard.  Find a way out and try your best to survive.

data.name: The Last Firefighter
data.description: Against all odds, you managed to make it back to the station house in one piece.  Now the reanimated husks of your former comrades want to make sure you never leave it again.

data.name: Assault on Precinct Z
data.description: You knew the day was going to be bad when it started with your partner getting eaten by a perp before you even had coffee.  The scene back at the station house looks bad, real bad.  This is going to be an all-nighter.

data.name: School
data.description: You were at school when the principal shambled in and ate one of the students, and before you knew it the entire campus was overrun by monsters.  Guess school's out forever.

data.name: Wilderness
data.description: You find yourself amongst trees.  The screaming and the moaning is fainter this far from civilization, but you'd better know what you're doing out here.

data.name: Helicopter Crash
data.description: You've crashed your precious helicopter, it'll never fly again.  Monsters don't bother you, life without your Loach is worthless anyway.

data.name: Bottom of a Mine
data.description: You were mining along when you found...something.  You're not sure what, but it sure is dark down here.

data.name: Fled the Riots
data.description: You were assigned to the last of the real riots; one of the last to flee when the rioters stopped breathing but kept moving.

data.name: Out of Town
data.description: You were outside of civilization when the bombs fell; you didn't even know the end had come, or that everyone was (un)dead.  Will this ignorance save you from the fate of the rest?

data.name: .22 CB
data.description: The .22 Conical Ball is a variety of .22 ammunition that propels its bullet using a primer instead of gunpowder.  The end result is a subsonic round that is so weak as to be nearly useless given your predicament.

data.name: .22 FMJ
data.description: .22 Long Rifle ammunition with 30gr FMJ bullets.  The .22LR round is extremely weak with very low stopping power, short range, and negligible recoil.  It is most useful for rifle training, and hunting small animals.

data.name: .22 LR
data.description: .22 Long Rifle ammunition with 40gr unjacketed bullets.  The .22LR round is extremely weak with very low stopping power, short range, and negligible recoil.  It is most useful for rifle training, and hunting small animals.

data.name: .22 rat-shot
data.description: A .22 caliber cartridge loaded with very small pieces of shot contained within a fragmenting plastic capsule.  It has an extremely short range and penetration ability, but it can hit targets with greater ease.

data.name: .223 Remington
data.description: .223 Remington ammunition with 36gr JHP bullets.  The .223 round has been very popular with civilian shooters for almost a century, finding use in a wide variety of weapons.  It generates lower pressure than 5.56 NATO leading to slightly decreased accuracy and recoil.

data.name: 5.56 NATO M855A1
data.description: 5.56x45mm ammunition with a 62gr FMJ bullet containing a steel penetrator.  Its light weight, high accuracy, and manageable recoil lead to widespread use in the 20th century and it remains popular among militaries and civilians.

data.name: 5.56 NATO tracer
data.description: This ammunition is a one-in-five mix of M855A1 and M856 tracer rounds to help keep the weapon they are fired from on target.

data.name: .300 Winchester Magnum
data.description: .300 Winchester Magnum rounds with 220gr JHP bullets.  The 300WM round is an extremely powerful and accurate rifle round introduced in 1963.  It has proven popular with hunters and snipers, although it is not as common as .308 or .30-06.

data.name: reloaded .300 Winchester Magnum
data.description: The .300 Winchester Magnum is extremely versatile and has been adopted by many shooting disciplines.  The cartridge has found use by hunters, military units, and law enforcement departments.  This one has been hand-reloaded.

data.name: .270 Winchester
data.description: .270 Winchester ammunition with 130gr soft point bullets.  Similar to .30-06, the .270 round was a popular hunting cartridge until the mid 21st century when it was supplanted by new designs.  It is a powerful round capable of taking down large targets with ease.  While not advisable, it may be possible to use it in some firearms chambered for .30-06.

data.name: .30-06 Springfield
data.description: .30-06 Springfield rounds with 165gr soft point bullets.  The .30-06 cartridge has excellent accuracy, range, and stopping power making it popular with hunters and snipers for well over a century.

data.name: .30-06 M14A1 tracer
data.description: Armor piercing incendiary .30-06 M14A1 ammunition containing tracer rounds to help keep the weapon they are fired from on target.  It penetrates all but the strongest body armor with ease.

data.name: .30-06 M2 AP
data.description: Armor piercing .30-06 M2 ammunition with 168gr FMJ bullets.  It is an extremely powerful and accurate cartridge but pays for it's armor penetration abilities with lowered damage.

data.name: .308 Winchester
data.description: .308 Winchester ammunition with 168gr hollow point bullets.  The .308 round is one of the most popular hunting cartridges in the world due to its accuracy and power.

data.name: 7.62x51mm M80
data.description: A 7.62x51mm NATO round with a 147gr FMJ bullet.  It is a powerful rifle cartridge commonly used by hunters and military snipers because of its high accuracy and long range.

data.name: 7.62 NATO tracer
data.description: This ammunition is a one-in-five mix of M80 and M62 tracer rounds to help keep the weapon they are fired from on target.

data.name: .32 ACP
data.description: The .32 ACP was a popular handgun cartridge in the 20th century.  Not so powerful as the .38 or the 9mm though.

data.name: .36 paper cartridge
data.description: A paper cartridge containing a premeasured amount of black powder and a .36 projectile.  Used by the Colt M1861 Navy.

data.name: .38 FMJ
data.description: .38 Special ammunition with brass jacketed 130gr bullets.  The .38 Special round has been known from its inception for its accuracy and low recoil.

data.name: .38 Special
data.description: .38 Special ammunition with 130gr FMJ bullets.  The .38 Special round was extremely common among US police forces during the 20th century.

data.name: .38 Super
data.description: .38 Super ammunition with 90gr JHP bullets.  Designed in 1929, the .38 super cartridge was designed to penetrate body armor and vehicles.

data.name: 10mm Auto
data.description: 10mm Auto ammunition with 180gr FMJ bullets.  The 10mm Auto round is one of the most powerful pistol cartridges available, although its usefulness is limited by high recoil.

data.name: .40 S&W FMJ
data.description: .40 S&W ammunition with 180gr FMJ bullets.  Designed to retain the 10mm Auto cartridge's power with lower recoil, the .40 S&W round became popular for law enforcement and personal defense.

data.name: .40 S&W JHP
data.description: .40 S&W ammunition with 135gr JHP bullets.  The .40 S&W round is a descended from the 10mm Auto cartridge and maintains most of its predecessor's strengths while reducing recoil.

data.name: 40mm beanbag

data.name: smoked sucker
data.description: A heavily smoked portion of human flesh.  Lasts for a very long time and tastes pretty good, if you like that sort of thing.

data.name: clean water
data.description: Fresh, clean water.  Truly the best thing to quench your thirst.

data.name: mineral water
data.description: Fancy mineral water, so fancy it makes you feel fancy just holding it.

data.name: first aid kit
data.description: A full medical kit, with bandages, local anesthetics, and rapid healing agents.  Used for healing large amounts of damage.

data.name: improvised first aid kit
data.description: A medical kit made with cheap, subpar components.  For when nothing else is available.

data.name: Adderall
data.description: Medical grade amphetamine salts mixed with Dextroamphetamine salts, commonly prescribed to treat hyperactive attention deficits.  It suppresses the appetite, and is quite addictive.

data.name: syringe of adrenaline
data.description: A syringe filled with a shot of adrenaline.  It serves as a powerful stimulant when you inject yourself with it.  Asthmatics can use it in an emergency to clear their asthma.

data.name: antibiotic
data.description: Antibacterial medication designed to prevent or stop the spread of infection.

data.name: antifungal drug
data.description: Powerful chemical tablets designed to eliminate fungal infections in living creatures.

data.name: antiparasitic drug
data.description: Broad spectrum chemical tablets designed to eliminate parasitic infestations in living creatures.  Though designed for use on pets and livestock, it will likely work on humans as well.

data.name: aspirin
data.description: Acetylsalicylic acid, a mild anti-inflammatory.  Take to relieve pain and swelling.

data.name: bandage
data.description: Simple cloth bandages.  Used for healing small amounts of damage.

data.name: antiseptic powder
data.description: A powdered form of chemical disinfectant, this bismuth formic iodide cleans wounds quickly and painlessly.

data.name: special brownie
data.description: This is definitely not how grandma used to bake them.

data.name: caffeinated chewing gum
data.description: Chewing gum with added caffeine.  Sugary and bad for your teeth, but it's a nice pick-me-up.

data.name: caffeine pill
data.description: No-doz brand caffeine pills, maximum strength.  Useful in pulling an all-nighter, one pill is about equivalent to a strong cup of coffee.

data.name: chewing tobacco
data.description: Mint flavored chewing tobacco.  While still absolutely terrible for your health, it was once a favorite amongst baseball players, cowboys, and other macho types.

data.name: hydrogen peroxide
data.description: Dilute hydrogen peroxide, for use as a disinfectant and for bleaching hair or textiles.  Foams a little when in contact with organic matter, but otherwise harmless.

data.name: cigarette
data.description: A mixture of dried tobacco leaf, pesticides, and chemical additives, rolled into a filtered paper tube.  Stimulates mental acuity and reduces appetite.  Highly addictive and hazardous to health.

data.name: cigar
data.description:
Rolled, cured tobacco leaf, addictive and hazardous to health.
A gentleman's vice, cigars set the civil man apart from the savage.

data.name: chloroform soaked rag
data.description: A debug item that lets you put NPCs (or yourself) to sleep.

data.name: codeine
data.description: A mild opiate used in the suppression of pain, cough, and other ailments.  While relatively weak for a narcotic, it is still addictive, with a potential for overdose.

data.name: cocaine
data.description: Crystalline extract of the coca leaf, or at least, a white powder with some of that in it.  A topical analgesic, it is more commonly used for its stimulatory properties.  Highly addictive.

data.name: pair of contact lenses
data.description: A pair of extended wear contacts with soft lenses designed to be discarded after a week of use.  They are a great replacement to wearing glasses and sit comfortably on the surface of the eye.

data.name: cotton balls
data.description: Fluffy balls of clean white cotton.  Can serve as makeshift bandages in an emergency.

data.name: crack
data.description: Deprotonated cocaine crystals, incredibly addictive and deleterious to brain chemistry.

use_action.activation_message: You smoke your crack rocks.  Mother would be proud.

data.name: datura seeds
data.description: Small, dark seeds from the spiny pods of a datura plant.  Full of powerful psychoactive chemicals, these tiny seeds are a potent analgesic and deliriant, and can be deadly in cases of overdose.  You could probably plant these.

data.name: non-drowsy cough syrup
data.description: Daytime cold and flu medication.  Non-drowsy formula.  Will suppress coughing, aching, headaches and runny noses, but you'll still need lots of fluids and rest.

data.name: disinfectant
data.description: A powerful disinfectant commonly used for contaminated wounds.

data.name: diazepam
data.description: A strong benzodiazepine drug used to treat muscle spasms, anxiety, seizures, and panic attacks.

data.name: electronic cigarette
data.description: This battery-operated device vaporizes a liquid that contains flavorings and nicotine.  A less harmful alternative to traditional cigarettes, but it's still addictive.  It can't be reused once it's empty.

data.name: saline eye drop
data.description: Sterile saline eye drops.  Can be used to treat dry eyes, or to wash out contaminants.

data.name: flu shot
data.description: Pharmaceutical flu shot designed for mass vaccinations, still in the packaging.  Purported to provide immunity to influenza.
data.//: Yeah, kinda guessing at these ones.

data.name: chewing gum
data.description: Bright pink chewing gum.  Sugary, sweet, and bad for your teeth.

data.name: hand-rolled cigarette
data.description: A roll-your-own made from tobacco and rolling paper.  Stimulates mental acuity and reduces appetite.  Despite being hand crafted, it's still highly addictive and hazardous to health.
data.//: Tougher to market a hand rolled, could be anything in there.

data.name: heroin
data.description: An extremely strong opioid narcotic derived from morphine.  Incredibly addictive, the risk of overdose is extreme, and the drug is contraindicated for nearly all medical purposes.

data.name: potassium iodide tablet
data.description: Potassium iodide tablets.  If taken prior to exposure, they help to mitigate injury caused by radiation absorption.

data.name: joint
data.description: Marijuana, cannabis, pot.  Whatever you want to call it, it's rolled up in a piece of paper and ready for smokin'.

data.name: pink tablet
data.description: Tiny pink candies shaped like hearts, already dosed with some sort of drug.  Really only useful for entertainment.  Will cause hallucinations.

data.name: medical gauze
data.description: This is decent sized piece of cotton, sterilized and sealed.  It's designed for medical purposes.

data.name: low-grade methamphetamine
data.description: A profoundly addictive and powerful stimulant.  While extremely effective at enhancing alertness, it is hazardous to health and the risk of an adverse reaction is great.

data.name: morphine
data.description: A very strong semi-synthetic narcotic used to treat intense pain in hospital settings.  This injectable drug is very addictive.

data.name: mugwort oil
data.description: Some essential oil made from mugwort, which may kill parasites when ingested.  Consume it with water!

data.name: nicotine gum
data.description: Mint flavored nicotine chewing gum.  For smokers who desire to quit.

data.name: cough syrup
data.description: Nighttime cold and flu medication.  Useful when trying to sleep with a head full of virions.  Will cause drowsiness.

data.name: oxycodone
data.description: A strong semi-synthetic narcotic used in the treatment of intense pain.  Highly addictive.
data.//: Fairly controlled substance as they go.

data.name: Ambien
data.description: A habit-forming tranquilizer with a variety of psychoactive side effects.  Used in the treatment of insomnia.  Its generic name is zolpidem tartrate.

data.name: poppy painkiller
data.description: Potent opioid palliative produced by the refining of the mutated poppy.  Notably devoid of euphoric or sedative effects, as an opiate it may still be addictive.

data.name: poppy sleep
data.description: A potent sleep aid extracted from mutated poppy seeds.  Effective, but as an opiate, it may be addictive.

data.name: poppy cough syrup
data.description: Cough syrup made from mutated poppy.  Will make you sleepy.

data.name: Prozac
data.description: A common and popular antidepressant.  It will elevate mood, and can profoundly affect the action of other drugs.  It is only rarely habit-forming, though adverse reactions are not uncommon.  Its generic name is fluoxetine.
data.//: Don't have a cite for this one.

data.name: Prussian blue tablet
data.description: Tablets containing oxidized ferrous ferrocyanide salts.  Capable of purging nuclear contaminants from the body if taken after radiation exposure.

data.name: hemostatic powder
data.description: A powdered antihemorrhagic compound that reacts with blood to immediately form a gel-like substance that stops bleeding.

data.name: saline solution
data.description: A solution of sterilized water and salt for intravenous infusion or washing contaminants from one's eyes.

data.name: Thorazine
data.description: Anti-psychotic medication.  Used to stabilize brain chemistry, it can arrest hallucinations and other symptoms of psychosis.  Carries a sedative effect.  Its generic name is chlorpromazine.

data.name: thyme oil
data.description: Some essential oil made from thyme, which can act as a mildly irritating disinfectant.

data.name: rolling tobacco
data.description:
Loose, fine-cut tobacco leaves.  Popular in Europe and among hipsters.  Highly addictive and hazardous to health.
Can either be rolled into a cigarette with some rolling papers or smoked through a pipe.

data.name: tramadol
data.description: A painkiller used to manage moderate pain.  The effects last for several hours, but are relatively subdued for an opioid.

data.name: gamma globulin shot
data.description: This immunoglobulin booster contains concentrated antibodies prepared for intravenous injection to temporarily strengthen the immune system.  It is still in its original packaging.
data.//: Yeah, kinda guessing at these ones.

data.name: multivitamin
data.description: Essential dietary nutrients conveniently packaged in pill form.  An option of last resort when a balanced diet is not possible.  Excess use can cause hypervitaminosis.

data.name: calcium tablet
data.description: White calcium tablets.  Widely used by elderly people with osteoporosis as a method to supplement calcium before the apocalypse.

data.name: gummy vitamin
data.description: Essential dietary nutrients conveniently packaged in a fruit-flavored chewy candy form.  An option of last resort when a balanced diet is not possible.  Excess use can cause hypervitaminosis.

data.name: injectable vitamin B
data.description: Small vials of pale yellow liquid containing soluble vitamin B for injection.

data.name: injectable iron
data.description: Small vials of dark yellow liquid containing soluble iron for injection.

data.name: marijuana
data.description: The dried flower buds and leaves harvested from a psychoactive variety of hemp plant.  Used to reduce nausea, stimulate appetite and elevate mood.  It can be habit-forming, and adverse reactions are possible.

use_action.activation_message: You smoke some weed.  Good stuff, man!

data.name: Xanax
data.description: Anti-anxiety agent with a powerful sedative effect.  May cause dissociation and loss of memory.  It is dangerously addictive, and withdrawal from regular use should be gradual.  Its generic name is alprazolam.
data.//: Yeah, kinda guessing at these ones, but generic is cheaper.

data.name: long makeshift rope
data.description: A 30-foot long rough rope, woven from natural cordage.  Not strong enough to hold up to falls, but still useful for some things.

data.name: H&K G80 Railgun
data.description: Developed by Heckler & Koch in 2033, the railgun magnetically propels a ferromagnetic projectile using an alternating current.  Powered by UPS.

data.name: RM120c shotgun
data.description: Utilizing a powerful and unusual caliber, the Rivtech RM120c caseless pump-action shotgun was designed for hunting big game, with durability and ease of use as priorities.

data.name: RM20 autoshotgun
data.description: Utilizing a powerful and unusual caliber, the Rivtech RM20 caseless automatic combat shotgun was designed with durability and overwhelming power in mind.

data.name: RM228 PDW
data.description: Chambering the powerful 20x66mm caseless shotgun cartridge, the Rivtech RM228 PDW was designed for the civilian personal defense market with durability and ease of use as priorities.  While lauded for its small size and light weight, its hefty price tag kept it out of the reach of casual collectors.

data.name: American-180
data.description: The American-180 is a submachine gun developed in the 1960's that fires .22 LR, unusual for an SMG.  Though the round is low-powered, the high rate of fire and large magazine makes the 180 a formidable weapon.

data.name: Marlin 39A
data.description: The oldest and longest-produced shoulder firearm in the world.  Though it fires the weak .22 round, it is highly accurate and damaging, and has essentially no recoil.

data.name: Mossberg Brownie
data.description: The first gun produced by O.F. Mossberg & Sons.  A small pocket pistol, marketed to trappers during the early 20th century.  Its four barrels can accept .22 Short and .22 LR cartridges.

data.name: pipe rifle: .22
data.description: A home-made rifle.  It is simply a pipe attached to a stock, with a hammer to strike the single round it holds.

data.name: RM360 rotary carbine
data.description: This unusual Rivtech carbine features five rotating barrels and a large capacity helical magazine.  Durable and easy to handle, it was designed to overcome the deficiencies of its low power .22LR cartridge by rapidly delivering a large number of projectiles.

data.name: Ruger 10/22
data.description: A combination of negligible recoil, high customization, and inexpensive ammunition made the Ruger 10/22 a popular choice among enthusiasts and small game hunters.  Even though it fires the weak .22 round, it's perfectly capable of killing.

data.name: SIG Mosquito
data.description: A popular, small .22 LR pistol.  One of the many polymer frame pistols produced during the latter 20th-early 21st centuries; it has an underbarrel rail.

data.name: S&W 22A
data.description: A popular .22 pistol.

data.name: Bushmaster ACR
data.description: This carbine was developed for military use in the early 21st century.  It is damaging and accurate, though its rate of fire is a bit slower than competing .223 carbines.

data.name: AR-15
data.//: This is assumed to be the standard model matching the (currently not in-game) M16.
data.description: This ubiquitous rifle is the forefather of M16 rifle series.  It is lightweight and accurate, but will malfunction if not properly maintained.  This one is a semi automatic civilian version.

data.name: H&K 416A5
data.//: *Current* milspec gear is now ridiculously overpriced, as seen with the M2010 IRL.
data.description: Designed to replace the M4A1, the Heckler and Koch 416A5 features most of the former's strengths, while being considerably more durable.

data.name: H&K G36
data.description: Designed as a replacement for the early H&K G3 battle rifle, the G36 is more accurate, and uses the much-lighter .223 round, allowing for a higher ammo capacity.

data.name: L2037 Backup
data.//: Most real-life autorevolvers use 6-7.5 inch barrel, but this one's mentioned to be particularly massive.
data.description: Developed by Leadworks as a companion sidearm to the L523 modular system, this massive autorevolver fires the powerful .223 round, but suffers high recoil as a result.  It has a weighted barrel to make recoil more manageable and a 5-chamber cylinder.

data.name: L523 platform
data.//: Current milspec, so Expensive.
data.description: Leadworks LLC's bullpup L523 platform utilizes the ubiquitous 5.56 round in multiple applications, and is designed to part-swap quickly, safely, and effectively from one to the next.  The base mechanism could--theoretically--be used on its own, but such use is inadvisable and will void your warranty.  There's no real place to incorporate aftermarket modifications on this barren proto-weapon.

data.name: L523-CAR carbine
data.description: Leadworks LLC's bullpup L523 platform utilizes the ubiquitous 5.56 round in multiple applications, and is designed to part-swap quickly, safely, and effectively from one to the next.  The carbine model incorporates Leadworks' proprietary gyro-stabilization technology and includes an integral laser sight, but like the rest of the family, doesn't accept third-party modifications.

data.name: L523-DSR rifle
data.description: Leadworks LLC's bullpup L523 platform utilizes the ubiquitous 5.56 round in multiple applications, and is designed to part-swap quickly, safely, and effectively from one to the next.  The designated-shootist rifle incorporates a specially-designed extended barrel with integral bipod and foregrip, along with an integral 8x optic, and trades selective-fire for the Leadworks gyro-stabilization system.  Like the rest of the family, though, it doesn't accept third-party modifications.

relative.//: Volume, range, and bullpup all point to a very large barrel on this one.

data.name: L523-LMG
data.description: Leadworks LLC's bullpup L523 platform utilizes the ubiquitous 5.56 round in multiple applications, and is designed to part-swap quickly, safely, and effectively from one to the next.  The rather ambitious light machine gun variant incorporates a heavy-duty barrel & foregrip as well as the Leadworks gyro system.  Unlike the other configurations, the L523 LMG can be loaded with ammo belts.

data.name: L523-MBR rifle
data.description: Leadworks LLC's bullpup L523 platform utilizes the ubiquitous 5.56 round in multiple applications, and is designed to part-swap quickly, safely, and effectively from one to the next.  The battle rifle's (proprietary) combination optic & red-dot sights provide quick and accurate targeting, with a foregrip available for greater control.  Like the rest of the family, though, it doesn't accept third-party modifications.

data.name: M249
data.description: The M249 is a mountable machine gun used by the US military and SWAT teams.  Quite inaccurate and difficult to control, the M249 is designed to fire many rounds very quickly.

data.name: M27 IAR
data.description: A H&K416 carbine outfitted with a heavier barrel to enable higher amounts of suppressive fire while retaining a good degree of mobility.

data.name: M4A1
data.description: A popular carbine, long used by the US military.  Though accurate, small, and lightweight, it is infamous for its unreliability when not properly maintained.

data.name: Ruger Mini-14
data.description: A small, lightweight semi-auto carbine designed for civilian and police use.  Its superb accuracy and low recoil makes it more suitable than full-auto rifles for some situations.

data.name: FN SCAR-L
data.description: A highly accurate and modular assault rifle specially designed for the United States Special Operations Command.  The 'L' in its name stands for light, as it uses the lightweight .223 round.

data.name: SIG 552
data.description: A compact selective fire automatic rifle designed for the Swiss military.  It features a three-round burst mode and an integrated folding stock.

data.name: Steyr AUG
data.description: The Steyr AUG is an Austrian assault rifle that uses a bullpup design.  It is used in the armed forces and police forces of many nations, and enjoys low recoil and high accuracy.

data.name: survivor carbine
data.//: It's smaller than an M4A1, plus it's a homemade firearm.
data.description: A well designed improvised carbine with a shortened barrel.  Accepting crude detachable magazines this is one of the better homemade weapons.

data.name: M2010 ESR
data.//: http://www.guns.com/2012/05/17/remington-xm2010-army-sniper-system-esr-now-in-stores/.
data.description: A bolt-action, box-magazine-fed, sniper rifle chambered in the powerful .300 Winchester Magnum round.  The M2010 had completely replaced the M24 rifle series by 2017.

data.name: Weatherby Mark V
data.//: MSRP, believe it or not.
data.description: The Weatherby Mark V is one of the finest bolt action rifles.  Designed in 1955 by Roy Weatherby and Fred Jennie, it has a strong action designed to safely fire high-pressure cartridges.  These rifles were presented to celebrities as part of a marketing campaign.

data.name: Winchester Model 70
data.description: The Winchester Model 70 is a bolt action sporting rifle.  It has an iconic place in American sporting culture and has been held in high regard by shooters since it was introduced in 1936.

data.name: Browning BLR
data.description: A highly accurate lever-action hunting rifle chambered for the powerful .30-06 round.  Notable for using a detachable magazine instead of a traditional tube.

data.name: M1 Garand
data.description: A semi-automatic .30-06 battle rifle, developed to replace the M1903 Springfield.  It didn't completely supplant the older bolt-action until after World War II.

data.name: M1903 Springfield
data.description: A powerful military rifle chambered in .30-06, developed to replace the US Army's older Krag rifle.  Served as the main American rifle in World War I, was used alongside the M1 Garand in World War II, and was used as a sniper rifle as late as the Vietnam War.

data.name: Browning Automatic Rifle
data.description: Designed near the end of World War I, the BAR provided fire support for the US Army from World War II all the way to the Vietnam War.  Too much firepower to serve as a battle rifle, but not enough to be an ideal light machine gun, it still found a niche on the battlefield.

data.name: Remington 700
data.description: A very popular and durable hunting or sniping rifle.  Popular among SWAT and US Marine snipers.  Highly damaging, but perhaps not as accurate as the competing Browning BLR.

data.name: pipe rifle: .30-06
data.//: It's the same size as the others, but it's still a scrap weapon.
data.description: A homemade rifle.  It is simply a pipe attached to a stock, with a hammer to strike the single round it holds.  This one is made to support more gun attachments.

data.name: Survivor Special 700
data.description: A rusty receiver, a R700 pattern barrel and half a broken crutch; all held together in the shape of a rifle with nothing more than glue, duct tape, and generous amounts of faith.

data.name: FN FAL
data.description: Originally designed during the Cold War, the FN FAL is probably the most successful battle rifle ever designed.  Even though often labeled as obsolete, its high rate of fire and powerful ammunition make it perfectly capable of holding its ground against modern competitors.

data.name: H&K G3
data.description: An early battle rifle developed after the end of WWII.  The G3 is designed to unload large amounts of deadly ammunition, but it is less suitable over long ranges.

data.name: M134D-H Minigun
data.description: The M134D-H Minigun is a (relatively) lightweight heavy rotary machine gun.  Its six barrels are rotated by an electric motor, powered by UPS or vehicle.  If you could find enough ammo for it, it would become a devastating weapon.  It must be mounted on a vehicle before use.

data.name: M14 EBR-RI
data.description: A highly modified version of the M14 rifle designed to cover both CQB and designated marksman roles.  A very powerful and versatile rifle, if somewhat heavy.

data.name: M1A
data.description: The child of the M1 Garand World War 2 rifle, the M1A is a semi-automatic variant of the M14, favored for its accuracy and modular use.

data.name: M240
data.description: The M240 is a medium machine gun used by the US military, replacing the older M60.  Quite inaccurate and difficult to control, the M240 is designed to fire many rounds very quickly.

data.name: M60
data.description: The M60 is a general-purpose machine gun developed to replace the .30-caliber M1918 and M1919.  Heavy and difficult to handle fired from the shoulder, as most people aren't action-movie heroes.

data.name: pipe rifle: .308
data.//: It's amongst the smallest of the .308 firearms, and a scrap weapon as well. This means a short handmade barrel, and considerable loss of energy.
data.description: A homemade lever-action rifle.  While still a primitive pipe and 2x4 design, some minor improvements have been made, such as an integral magazine for rounds, and chambering the more powerful .308 rounds.

data.name: Savage 111F
data.description: A very accurate rifle chambered for the powerful .308 round.  Its very low ammo capacity is offset by its accuracy and near-complete lack of recoil.

data.name: FN SCAR-H
data.description: A highly accurate and modular battle rifle specially designed for the United States Special Operations Command.  The 'H' in its name stands for heavy, as it uses the powerful .308 round.

data.name: SIG Sauer P230
data.description: The SIG Sauer P230 is a small, semi-automatic handgun chambered in .32 ACP.  Due to its small dimensions, it was often carried as a backup weapon.

data.name: Skorpion Vz. 61
data.description: The Skorpion Vz. 61 is a Czechoslovak submachine gun from the 1950s, chambered in .32 ACP.

data.name: Walther PPK
data.description: One of the most famous handguns of the 20th century.  Your name is not Bond, but you might find this little gun still useful.

data.name: Colt M1861 Navy
data.description: The Colt Model 1861 Navy cap & ball .36-caliber revolver was a six-shot, single-action percussion weapon produced by Colt's Manufacturing Company from 1861 until 1873.

data.name: 2 Shot Special
data.//: It's hard to say just how big this is, although it's (very large) pistol sized. But it is a handmade weapon.
data.description: A crudely made double barrel pistol firing 38 special ammo.  Unfortunately, the name is less about the double barrels and more about the number of shots you'll get before it breaks down on you.

data.name: COP .38
data.description: The COP .38 is a small, chubby derringer pistol that bears a slight resemblance to the Mossberg Brownie.  It has four barrels arranged in a square formation.

data.name: Ruger LCR .38
data.description: A compact, double-action-only revolver designed for easy concealment, with a stainless steel cylinder and aluminum frame.

data.name: S&W 619
data.description: A seven-round .38 revolver sold by Smith & Wesson.  It features a fixed rear sight and a reinforced frame.

data.name: Taurus Pro .38
data.description: A popular .38 pistol.  Designed with numerous safety features and built from high-quality, durable materials.

data.name: Glock 22
data.description: A .40 S&W variant of the popular Glock 17 pistol.  The standard-issue firearm of the FBI and of countless other law enforcement agencies worldwide.

data.name: SIG Pro .40
data.description: Originally marketed as a lightweight and compact alternative to older SIG handguns, the Pro .40 is popular among European police forces.

data.name: survivor's six shooter
data.description: A homemade 6 shot revolver.  While it's not as good as the pre-Cataclysm manufactured weapons, it's a decent piece of work all things considered.

data.name: S&W 610
data.description: The Smith and Wesson 610 is a classic six-shooter revolver chambered for 10mm rounds, or for S&W's own .40 round.

data.name: tube 40mm launcher
data.description: A simple, home-made grenade launcher.  Basically a tube with a pin firing mechanism to activate the grenade.

data.name: M320 stand alone launcher
data.description: Heckler & Koch's M320 grenade launcher offers the functionality of larger launchers in a very small package at the cost of decreased accuracy.  This one is combined with a buttstock for stand alone operation.

data.name: M79 launcher
data.description: A widely-used grenade launcher that first saw use by American forces in the Vietnam war.  Though mostly replaced by more modern launchers, the M79 still sees use with many units worldwide.

data.name: Mark 19 grenade launcher
data.description: A heavy, tripod-mounted belt-fed grenade launcher used by the US Military since the start of the cold war all the way to the cataclysm, and if you can find some 40mm grenades, maybe even beyond.

data.name: Milkor MGL
data.description: The Milkor Multi-Grenade Launcher is designed to compensate for the drawback of single-shot grenade launchers by allowing sustained heavy firepower.  However, it is still slow to reload and must be used with careful planning.

data.name: RM802 grenade launcher
data.//: Either Rivtech or milspec would make it Expensive.  Combined, you could buy a half-decent car for the price.
data.description: The Rivtech RM802 pump-action 40mm grenade launcher was designed to be a step ahead of single-shot grenade launchers by allowing sustained heavy firepower.  However, its capacity is fairly limited so it must be used with careful planning.

data.name: triple-barrel 40mm launcher
data.description: A homemade triple-barrel 40mm grenade launcher.  Capable of launching all three grenades at once, it is extremely powerful for a homemade weapon.

data.name: Desert Eagle .44
data.description: One of the most recognizable handguns due to its popularity in movies and video games, the Desert Eagle is better known for its menacing appearance than its performance.  It's a large pistol, but its heavy weight reduces recoil.

data.name: Henry Big Boy .44
data.//: Modern reproduction M.S.R.P
data.description: One of the most famous lever action rifles ever produced, the Henry Big Boy is chambered in the powerful .44 magnum cartridge.  Go get 'em cowboy!

data.name: LeMat revolver
data.//: Could only find barrel figures for the Baby LeMat; this is a best-guess estimate.
data.description: A modernized version of the original LeMat revolver, a rare and expensive firearm produced during the civil war.  With  a capacity of 9 modern .44 cartridges and a single 12 gauge shell, it makes a great companion for those who wander the "Earth-that-was".

data.name: Ruger Redhawk
data.description: One of the most powerful handguns in the world when it was released in 1979, the Redhawk offers very sturdy construction, with an appearance that is reminiscent of "Wild West" revolvers.

data.name: S&W 629
data.description: A stainless steel, six-shot, double-action revolver with a matte black plastic handle manufactured by Smith & Wesson.  Though hardly the most powerful handgun in the world any more, it could still blow a zombie's head clean off.

data.name: Colt M1860 Army
data.description: The Colt Army Model 1860 is a cap & ball .44-caliber revolver.  It was used during the American Civil War, and made by Colt's Manufacturing Company.

data.name: TDI Vector
data.description: The TDI Vector is a submachine gun with a unique, in-line design that makes recoil very manageable, even in the powerful .45 caliber.

data.name: H&K UMP45
data.description: Developed as a successor to the MP5 submachine gun, the UMP45 retains the earlier model's supreme accuracy and low recoil, but in the higher .45 caliber.

data.name: L2031 Enforcer
data.//: Real-life Autorevolvers tended to vary between 6-7.5 inch barrels, so we'll err on the side of a +1 here.
data.description: An "autorevolver", this Leadworks LLC six-shooter combines the ease-of-action of a semi-auto with the ease-of-reloading and style of a revolver.  It achieved overnight stardom when it appeared in "Treasure Trail", a popular space-Western series running from 2030 through 2037.

data.name: L1820 Long Ranger
data.//: If it's based off the Winchester 94, it's likely got a 20 inch barrel. For sanity's sake though, let's cap it at +4.
data.description: Numbered to bridge the gap between the USian Frontier and modern Civil Defense needs, the Long Ranger was designed to give Enforcer users (or anyone using .45 caliber cartridges) a little extra reach while using the same ammunition.  Synthetic furniture cost it some charm points from the legendary Winchester rifles it was based upon, but users agree that the forty-five's punch with the reach of a rifle is worth it.

data.name: L39B-45
data.description: After the success of the 9mm model, Leadworks LLC released an L39B chambered in .45.  It soon earned a reputation as one of the most intimidating guns on the market, for firer and target alike.  Similar to other Leadworks products it doesn't accept third-party modifications.

data.name: L39-45
data.description: Capitalizing on the L39B-45's reputation as one of the most intimidating pistols on the market, Leadworks LLC manufactured a semiautomatic model as well.  Locking it semi-auto reduced cost and improved performance.  Similar to other Leadworks products it doesn't accept third-party modifications.

data.name: M1911
data.//: You can get 'em for over US$1K if you want.  This is a fairly cheap remake.
data.description: The M1911 was the US Military standard-issue sidearm for most of the 20th Century.  It remains one of the most popular .45 pistols today.

data.name: MAC-10
data.description: The MAC-10 is a popular machine pistol originally designed for military use.  For many years they were the most inexpensive automatic weapon in the US, and enjoyed great popularity among criminals less concerned with quality firearms.

data.name: homemade hand cannon
data.//: On one hand, it's very big for a handgun. On the other, it's still a scrap weapon.
data.description: A large and heavy pistol evidently welded from scrap.  It's not pretty, but the .45 it's chambered with packs a serious punch.  Just watch out for the kick.

data.name: Thompson submachine gun
data.description: An American-made submachine gun developed during the very end of World War I, too late to see action.  Infamous during the 1920s for its use by gangsters, and was used during World War II before being mostly replaced with less-expensive alternatives.

data.name: Taurus Raging Bull
data.description: The Taurus Raging Bull is a 5-shot revolver chambered in .454 Casull.  It has impressive stopping power.

data.name: H&K MP7
data.description: Designed as a personal defense weapon, the MP7 fires the high powered 4.6x30mm round while being lightweight, compact in size, and practically recoil free.

data.name: H&K UCP
data.description: Designed to work with H&K's proprietary 4.6x30mm round, the UCP is a small pistol with a very high capacity, best used against armored opponents.

data.name: Barrett M107A1
data.//: Price based on unit cost quote for fiscal year 2005 listed at inetres.com, with gunmod modifiers to be added later.
data.description: A large, shoulder-fired, .50 caliber anti-materiel rifle.  Its large size, recoil, and noise is offset by its damage and range.

data.name: M2 Browning HMG
data.description: A heavy machine gun used by the US Military from its inception to the cataclysm, and even rarely by cataclysm survivors.  Its massive size and design make it impossible to use unless deployed or mounted to a vehicle.

data.name: .50 caliber rifle
data.description: Modified from the massive M2 Browning, this pared down rifle has been altered to be fired unmounted.  The burst fire has been disabled, and its belt fed mechanism has been modified into a much smaller single round chamber.

data.name: Big Horn Model 89
data.description: Built in the image of the venerable Winchester Model 1886, Big Horn Armory's Model 89 rifle packs all the power of the .500 S&W Magnum cartridge in to a package less likely to break one's wrist.

data.name: S&W 500
data.description: The 5-shot Smith and Wesson 500 revolver fires the comparably-named .500 S&W Magnum.  It's an impressive weapon.

data.name: AK-74M
data.//: AKs likewise aren't commercially traded in the US, plus this is newer.
data.description: The successor to the well-known AK-47 rifle.  It combines the reliability of the AK series with the high-velocity, lightweight 5.45x39mm cartridge.

data.name: AN-94
data.description: Intended to replace the AK-74, this rifle uses a sophisticated mechanism to delay felt recoil, along with a very fast two-round burst mode.  While its increased complexity prevented it from being adopted by the Russian military, it has seen service among their special forces.

data.name: FN Five-Seven
data.description: Designed to work with FN's proprietary 5.7x28mm round, the Five-Seven is a lightweight pistol with a very high capacity, best used against armored opponents.

data.name: FN P90
data.description: The first in a new genre of guns, termed "personal defense weapons."  FN designed the P90 to use their proprietary 5.7x28mm ammunition.  It is made for firing bursts manageably.

data.name: RM216 SPIW
data.description: This light carbine fires 5x50mm armor-piercing flechette cartridges.  Classified as a special purpose individual weapon, this advanced firearm was developed by Rivtech for the US military shortly before the end of the world.  Designed to be fired in bursts, it excels in close combat.

data.name: RM232 IDW
data.description: This lightweight machine pistol fires 5x50mm armor-piercing flechette cartridges.  Classified as an individual defense weapon, this advanced firearm was developed by Rivtech for the US military shortly before the end of the world.  Designed to be fired in bursts, it excels in close combat.

data.name: Elephant gun
data.description: A custom-made single shot rifle specially designed for the hunting of huge game.  You could obviously kill everything with this, EVERYTHING.  If you ever find enough ammo of course.

data.name: AKM
data.description: One of the most recognizable assault rifles ever made, the AKM is renowned for its durability even under the worst conditions.

data.name: Beretta ARX-160
data.description: The Beretta ARX-160 was a Phase II contender in the United States Army Individual Carbine competition to replace the M4 carbine.  It failed to replace it, but it is widely used by military all around the world.  This version is chambered for 7.62x39mm.

data.name: SKS
data.description: Developed by the Soviets in 1945, this rifle was quickly replaced by the full-auto AK47.  However, due to its superb accuracy, low recoil and deployable intergrated bayonet, this gun maintains immense popularity.

data.name: Mosin-Nagant M44
data.description: The Model 44 is the carbine sized variant of the standard 1891/30.  It has a shorter barrel, therefore it is weaker than the 1891/30, but easier to carry.

data.name: Mosin-Nagant M44-EBR
data.description: This carbine packs the classic Mosin-Nagant model 44 action in a modern-day stock capable of accepting modifications.

data.name: Mosin-Nagant 1891/30
data.description: The Mosin-Nagant 1891/30 is a bolt action, internal magazine-fed, military rifle, developed by the Russian Empire, and later used and perfected by the Soviet Union.

data.name: Mosin-Nagant 1891/30-EBR
data.description: This Mosin-Nagant has exchanged the classic wooden stock for a modern synthetic model, carefully balanced to the same weight and handling yet offering support for modern accessories.

data.name: PPSh-41
data.description: The Soviet-made PPSh-41 is a mass-produced selective-fire submachine gun.  It has a relatively high rate of fire.

data.name: Tokarev TT-33
data.//: And it's therefore expensive.
data.description: The Tokarev TT-33 is an antique Russian semiautomatic pistol, famous for its durability, accuracy, and uncomfortable grip angle.  It was chambered for the 7.62x25mm due to the popularity of the C96 pistol among Russian revolutionaries.

data.name: RM103A automagnum
data.//: Rivtech don't come cheap.
data.description: Considered overkill by many, the Rivtech M103A remains one of the most powerful sidearms ever developed.  Accepts stick magazines.

data.name: RM11B scout rifle
data.description: Intended to function as a long-range sharpshooter support weapon for the military, the Rivtech RM11B scout rifle was designed for durability and accuracy under less than ideal circumstances.  Its bullpup layout, integrated suppressor and digital scope, and two round burst mode allows it to deliver precise long-range takedowns, utilizing the proprietary Rivtech 8mm caseless round.  Accepts stick magazines.

data.name: RM2000 submachine gun
data.description: Utilizing a powerful and unusual caliber, the Rivtech RM2000 submachine gun was designed for durability and ease of carrying under less than ideal circumstances.  Accepts stick magazines.

data.name: RM298 HMG
data.description: Utilizing a powerful and unusual caliber, the Rivtech RM298 heavy machine gun was designed for durability and extreme volume of sustained fire under the worst possible circumstances.  Needs to be mounted because of extreme recoil.  Accepts RMXB500 box and RMD250 drum magazines.

data.name: RM51 assault rifle
data.description: Originally produced for military use, the Rivtech RM51 assault rifle was designed for durability and ease of use under less than ideal circumstances, with its considerable bulk minimized by a compact and ergonomic layout.  Accepts box magazines.

data.name: RM614 LMG
data.description: Utilizing a powerful and unusual caliber, the Rivtech RM614 light machine gun was designed for durability and extreme volume of sustained fire under the worst possible circumstances.  Accepts RMXB500 box and RMD250 drum magazines.

data.name: RM88 battle rifle
data.description: Originally produced for military use, the Rivtech RM88 battle rifle was designed for durability and extreme firepower under less than ideal circumstances, with a heavy ported barrel for maximum controllability.  Accepts box and and RMD250 drum magazines.

data.name: RM99 revolver
data.//: Bear in mind that most revolvers don't reach $1K.  Expensive.
data.description: Considered overkill by some, the Rivtech M99 remains an exceedingly powerful addition to the arsenal of any gunslinger.

data.name: briefcase SMG
data.description: A custom built 9mm submachine gun camouflaged to look as the average businessman suitcase, panes of cutting edge materials and its clever internal construction allowed it to bypass even the most scrupulous of security checkpoints.  Due to the fact that the average security guard is now only concerned in eating you, this million dollar baby has been reduced to little more than a novelty item.

data.name: Calico M960
data.description: The Calico M960 is an automatic carbine with a unique circular magazine that allows for high capacities and reduced recoil.

data.name: Cx4 Storm
data.description: A small pistol caliber carbine designed for police use and civilian self-defense, the Cx4 Storm uses magazines that are interchangeable with other Beretta 9mm handguns.

data.name: Glock 19
data.description: Possibly the most popular pistol in existence.  The Glock 19 is often derided for its plastic construction, but it is easy to shoot.

data.name: H&K MP5
data.description: The Heckler & Koch MP5 is one of the most widely-used submachine guns in the world, and has been adopted by special police forces and militaries alike.  Its high degree of accuracy and low recoil are universally praised.

data.name: Kel-Tec SUB-2000
data.description: A uniquely designed pistol caliber carbine with an integral folding stock and that makes use of 9mm Glock magazines.

data.name: L2032 Lookout
data.description: After the Enforcer's success, Leadworks LLC reworked their autorevolver design to cater to the 9mm market.  The Lookout, released in 2032, takes advantage of the smaller 9mm to hold a seventh round, without sacrificing the ease of handling or reloading the Enforcer made legendary.

data.name: L39B
data.//: The M93R can go through up to 110 rounds in six seconds, FWIW.
data.description: A selective-firing 9mm handgun introduced in 2039, Leadworks LLC's L39B provides accurate single-shot placement as well as controllable short-range firepower with its three-round burst mode.  Users praised its accuracy and fearsome appearance.  Similar to other Leadworks products it doesn't accept third-party modifications.

data.name: L39
data.//: L39s are based off the Robocop Auto-9, in turn a dolled-up Beretta 93R.
data.description: A semiautomatic 9mm handgun introduced in 2039, Leadworks LLC's L39 provides accurate single-shot placement in a very robust frame.  Several urban legends describe using it in ways that would have destroyed a lesser weapon.  Similar to other Leadworks products it doesn't accept third-party modifications.

data.name: Beretta M9
data.description: A very popular 9mm pistol, the M9 has been the standard issue sidearm of the US army since 1985.

data.name: pipe rifle: 9mm
data.//: Despite its quality, it IS a small rifle, although not as effective as a genuine pistol carbine.
data.description: A home-made rifle.  It is simply a pipe attached to a stock, with a hammer to strike the single round it holds.

data.name: STEN
data.description: A British submachine gun developed during World War II, to make up for shortages of supplies.  Designed to be made using unskilled labor and not known for reliability, its main advantages were low cost and being able to use German 9mm ammunition.

data.name: TEC-9
data.description: The TEC-9 is a machine pistol made of cheap polymers and machine stamped parts.  Its rise in popularity among criminals is largely due to its intimidating looks and low cost.

data.name: USP 9mm
data.description: A popular pistol, widely used among law enforcement.  Extensively tested for durability, it has been found to stay accurate even after being subjected to extreme abuse.

data.name: Uzi 9mm
data.//: SMGs aren't as commercially traded as rifles/handguns/SGs, so no cite for price points.
data.description: The Uzi 9mm has enjoyed immense popularity, selling more units than any other submachine gun.  It is widely used as a personal defense weapon, or as a primary weapon by elite frontline forces.

data.name: Makarov PM
data.//: 10 and 12-round magazines exist, but were made for the newer PMM, and are not compatible with the old PM.
data.description: The Pistolet Makarova was developed by the Soviet Union to replace the WWII-era TT-33 pistol.  It uses the 9x18mm cartridge, which remains in use among various former Soviet countries.

data.name: Skorpion Vz. 82
data.description: A version of the Skorpion submachine gun chambered in 9x18mm Makarov, with a slightly longer barrel than the original design.

data.name: fusion blaster
data.description: this a pseudo item

data.name: laser finger
data.description: this a pseudo item

data.name: Chain Lightning
data.description: this a pseudo item

data.name: blunderbuss
data.description: A homemade version of a crude precursor to the shotgun.  Able to fire just about anything you put down the barrel, but it will degrade pretty quick.

data.name: flamethrower
data.description: A large flamethrower with substantial gas reserves.  Very menacing and deadly.

data.name: spraycan flamethrower
data.description: A favorite of hooligans around the world, this lighter duct-taped to a spray can is probably as dangerous to the user as anyone else.  The nozzle has been crudely modified to disperse gasoline, and a small pump attached to the side allows for repressurization, though this process takes a few minutes.

data.name: simple flamethrower
data.description: A simple, home-made flamethrower.  While its capacity is not superb, it is more than capable of igniting terrain and monsters alike.

data.name: RM451 flamethrower
data.description: A military-grade combat flamethrower designed by Rivtech, the RM451 flamethrower incorporates a cycling pressure rapid-feed fuel system with a high-speed piezoelectric igniter.  Solidly built with durability in mind, it serves as an incredibly destructive weapon in the right hands.

data.name: flintlock carbine
data.description: This short rifle design once dominated the battlefields of ancient Europe, and may yet re-earn its feared status due to its ease of handling and ability to use easily-crafted ammunition.

data.name: survivor's double-barrel flintlock
data.description: This is a compact muzzle-loading rifle combining a pair of rudimentary flintlock actions and two barrels.  Whereas an antique multiple-barrel flintlock is an intricate work of gunsmithing, this weapon is simpler yet still serviceable.

data.name: flintlock pistol
data.description: A beautifully decorated flintlock pistol.  If using this doesn't makes you feel a pirate, nothing will.

data.name: flintlock rifle
data.description: For once, something *good* came back from the dead.  This ancient design lacks the fire-rate of modern weapons, but packs as much punch as the best of 'em and rewards the skilled shooter with easily-crafted ammunition.

data.name: heavy rail rifle
data.description: This overpowered and overengineered variant of the ferromagnetic rail rifle was designed to deliver electromagnetically-driven obliteration right through whatever obstacles that lies in front of it, be it buildings, vehicles or hordes of walking dead.  However, the hefty bulk and weight of this weapon compared to most contemporary rifles makes it somewhat cumbersome to wield; not to mention that it consumes UPS charges at a tremendous rate, making it impractical for use in prolonged engagements.

data.name: ferromagnetic rail rifle
data.description: A single-shot, electrically propelled, steel rail launcher handcrafted from scrap.  The hypervelocity metal stake that it fires is accelerated to the point of spontaneous combustion by a Lorentz force generated by electromagnetic induction, powered by a standard UPS.

data.name: coilgun
data.//: Hard to make, plentiful and cheap ammo, and silent - people will want this thing.
data.description: A homemade gun, using electromagnets to accelerate a ferromagnetic projectile to high velocity.  Powered by UPS.

data.name: nail gun
data.description: A tool used to drive nails into wood or other material.  It could also be used as a ad-hoc weapon.

data.name: nail rifle
data.description: This is a nailgun that has been extensively modified with the addition of a short barrel, stock and hand guard.  It can be reloaded using detachable magazines and is an overall much more effective weapon.

data.name: 12 gauge pistol
data.description: A single shot pistol that loads 12 gauge shotgun shells, handcrafted from scrap.

data.name: manual autoshotgun
data.//: Hard to value this thing, but considering what a $2000 pricepoint puts it on par with, that is too much.
data.description: A six-barrel hand-cranked automatic shotgun made from bicycle parts.  Though a bit unwieldy, it is exceedingly powerful for such a simple machine.

data.name: Kel-Tec KSG
data.description: A bullpup pump-action shotgun, the Kel-Tec KSG uses a pair of magazine tubes to increase its capacity.  Each tube has to be loaded separately, but this offers the option of loading different ammunition for different situations.

data.name: L12 Defender
data.//: Similar stats to the NeoStead 2000 which has a similar operating mechanism
data.description: Leadworks LLC's sole shotgun offering to date is surprisingly compact thanks to its moving barrel and forward-back pump mechanism.  Like most other Leadworks products it doesn't accept third-party modifications.

data.name: M1014 shotgun
data.description: Its relative simplicity and reliability made the Benelli M4 the most successful semi-automatic shotgun ever created.

data.name: Mossberg 500
data.description: The Mossberg 500 is a popular series of pump-action shotguns, often acquired for military use.  It is noted for its high durability and low recoil.

data.name: double-barrel pipe shotgun
data.description: A home-made double-barreled shotgun.  It is simply two pipes attached to a stock, with a pair of hammers to strike the two rounds it holds.

data.name: pipe shotgun
data.description: A home-made shotgun.  It is simply a pipe attached to a stock, with a hammer to strike the single round it holds.

data.name: Remington 870
data.description: One of the most popular shotguns on the market, the Remington 870 is used by hunters and law enforcement agencies alike thanks to its high accuracy and muzzle velocity.

data.name: shotgun revolver
data.description: A shotgun modified to use a revolver cylinder mechanism, it can hold 6 cartridges.

data.name: Saiga-12
data.description: The Saiga-12 is a semi-automatic shotgun designed on the same Kalashnikov pattern as the AK47 rifle.  It reloads with a magazine, rather than one shell at a time like most shotguns.

data.name: double barrel shotgun
data.description: An old shotgun, possibly antique.  It is little more than a pair of barrels, a wood stock, and a hammer to strike the cartridges.

data.name: single barrel shotgun
data.description: An old shotgun, possibly antique.  It is little more than a barrel, a wood stock, and a hammer to strike the cartridge.  Its simple design keeps it both light and accurate.

data.name: makeshift lever shotgun
data.description: A well designed homemade lever-action shotgun.  With a 8 round magazine, this is one of the better homemade weapons.

data.name: flaregun
data.description: A plastic single shot pistol that can be loaded with signal flares.

data.name: XM34 EMP projector
data.description: A powerful electrolaser developed by the R&D outfit "Aerial Labs".  Especially effective against electronic targets.

data.name: handheld laser cannon
data.description: This is a laser cannon stripped from the barrel of a TX-5LR Cerberus laser turret that has been modified to use UPS power for firing.

data.name: A7 laser rifle
data.description: A state of the art laser rifle developed by the R&D outfit "Aerial Labs".  Initial performance rivaled Rivtech's finest, with rumors flying about corporate skulduggery.  Though the cataclysm put that on the ash heap of history, this weapon can still do the same to your foes.

data.name: fusion blaster rifle
data.description: A cyborg's fusion blaster arm, cannibalized and converted into a rifle.  This improvised weapon is powered by a standard UPS connection.

data.name: V29 laser pistol
data.description: The V29 laser pistol was designed in the mid-21st century and was one of the first firearms to use fusion as its ammunition.  It is larger than most traditional handguns, but displays no recoil whatsoever.

data.name: LACP laser pistol
data.description: The LACP laser pistol was based on the V29 laser pistol designed in the mid-21st century.  While little more than duct tape and electronics, it runs on a standard UPS.

data.name: arrow rest
data.description: A small extension above the grip which an arrow rests upon while being aimed.  Improves accuracy with no drawbacks.

data.name: bow stabilizer
data.description: A counterweight placed forward of the bow's grip allows for greater accuracy.  Aside from increased weight and size, there are no drawbacks.

data.name: brass catcher
data.description: A bag that hangs off the side of your gun and catches ejected casings so you don't have to pick them up.

data.name: shoulder strap
data.description: A shoulder strap allows the rifle to be worn over your shoulders like a piece of clothing.  However, it offers no protection.

data.name: barrel extension
data.description: A longer barrel increases the muzzle velocity of a firearm, contributing to both accuracy and damage but reduces portability and slows aiming.

data.name: rifled barrel
data.description: Rifling a shotgun barrel is mainly done in order to improve its accuracy when firing slugs.  The rifling makes the gun less suitable for shot, however.

data.name: shortened barrel
data.description: A shortened barrel results in markedly reduced accuracy, and a minor increase in noise, but also greatly improves the ease with which the weapon can be carried and wielded.

data.name: upstest
data.description: Testmod for UPS drain on mods, this should never spawn, if you see this, it's a bug. 50 UPS drain.

data.name: .22 caliber conversion kit
data.description: Replacing several key parts of a 9mm, .38, .40, 5.7mm, 4.6mm, 7.62x39mm or .223 firearm converts it to a .22 firearm.  The conversion results in a slight reduction to accuracy.

data.name: .223 caliber conversion kit
data.description: This kit is used to convert a shotgun, 5.45x39mm, 7.62x39mm, .30-06, or .308 rifle to the popular, accurate, and lighter .223 caliber.  The conversion results in slight reductions to both accuracy and ammo capacity.

data.name: .308 caliber conversion kit
data.description: This kit is used to convert a shotgun or 7.62x39mm, .223 or .30-06 rifle to the popular and powerful .308 caliber.  The conversion results in reduced ammo capacity and a slight reduction to accuracy.

data.name: .45 caliber conversion kit
data.description: Replacing several key parts of a 9mm, .38, .40 or .44 firearm converts it to a .45 firearm.  The conversion results in a slight reduction to accuracy.

data.name: 4.6mm caliber conversion kit
data.description: A conversion kit produced by Heckler and Koch, used to convert .22, 9mm, or .38 firearms to their proprietary 4.6x30mm, a round designed for accuracy and armor penetration.

data.name: 5.7mm caliber conversion kit
data.description: A conversion kit produced by FN Herstal, used to convert .22, 9mm, or .38 firearms to their proprietary 5.7x28mm, a round designed for accuracy and armor penetration.

data.name: 9mm caliber conversion kit
data.description: Replacing several key parts of a 9x18mm, .38, .40, .44 or .45 firearm converts it to a 9mm firearm.  The conversion results in a slight reduction to accuracy.

data.name: lightweight replacement furniture
data.description: A set of lightweight composite grips and furniture that reduces a firearm's weight, and as a consequence, its handling and melee damage.

data.name: ergonomic grip
data.description: A set of ergonomic replacement furniture for a firearm improving handling and accuracy.

data.name: beam scatterer
data.description: A set of optics made to fit on laser weapons, which will diffract the laser beam into several lower powered beams.  This increases point-blank damage, but greatly reduces range.

data.name: electrolaser conversion
data.description: A set of high-tech electronics and optics.  These converts a laser pistol into a less-lethal electrolaser capable of stunning targets, at the cost of a decreased damage output and increased power consumption.

data.name: high density capacitor
data.description: A capacitor with a higher energy density increases range and damage;  at the cost of a markedly increased power consumption.

data.name: belt feed adapter
data.description: A kit providing the necessary parts for permanently converting a firearm from magazine to belt-feed.  Guaranteed to void your warranty.

data.name: leadworks magazine adapter
data.description: A bootleg adapter for permanently converting a firearm to accept proprietary Leadworks magazines.  Guaranteed to void your warranty.

data.name: auto-fire mechanism
data.description: A simple mechanism that converts a pistol to a selective fire weapon with a burst size of three rounds.  However it reduces accuracy and increases noise.

data.name: rapid blowback
data.description: An improved blowback mechanism makes your firearm's automatic fire faster, at the cost of reduced accuracy and increased noise.

data.name: match trigger
data.description: A precision weighted trigger assembly that improves a firearm's accuracy.

data.name: tuned mechanism
data.description: A set of finely tuned internal components which increase the precision and reliably of a firearm.

data.name: firearm waterproofing
data.description: A set of seals and gaskets that will allow a firearm to operate reliably while submerged in water.

data.name: ported barrel
data.description: A ported barrel redirects exhaust gases to compensate for muzzle climb, improves recoil but increases noise and reduces accuracy slightly.

data.name: muzzle brake
data.description: A muzzle brake redirects exhaust gases to compensate for muzzle climb, improving recoil but increasing bulk, noise, and reducing accuracy slightly.

data.name: homemade suppressor
data.description: A homemade suppressor cobbled together out of spare parts.  While not nearly as effective as a regular suppressor, it will reduce the amount of noise and muzzle flash generated by the report of a firearm.  Gunfire is extremely loud and can damage your hearing without protection; a suppressor will bring the loudness of a report down to generally safe levels, as well as slightly reducing recoil and muzzle velocity. This simple suppressor is large and, when attached, will interfere with your ability to aim down the base sights of the gun.

data.name: RK6S34 suppressor
data.description: A suppressor reduces the amount of noise and muzzle flash generated by the report of a firearm.  This RK6S34 Mustela is a rather advanced version integral to the RM11B rifle system.

data.name: shotgun suppressor
data.description: A suppressor designed to work with shotguns.  It's a lot more complex than a suppressor for a pistol or rifle.

data.name: compact suppressor
data.description: A compact suppressor designed for pistols and best used with smaller calibers.  A suppressor will slightly reduce recoil and muzzle velocity.

data.name: rail-mounted crossbow

data.name: offset iron sights

data.name: rail laser sight

data.name: gyroscopic stabilizer

data.name: bow sight

data.name: holographic sight

data.name: iron sights

data.name: incendiary
data.description: Material from an incendiary round, useful in constructing incendiary ammunition.

data.name: electric lantern (off)
data.description: This is a battery-powered lamp.  It does not provide much light, but it lasts a long time.  Use it to turn it on.

data.name: flashlight (off)
data.description: This is a typical household flashlight with a plastic handle.  Using this flashlight will turn it on and provide light, assuming it is charged with batteries.

data.name: flare
data.description: This is a slow-burning magnesium flare.  Use it to strike the striker and light it.  It will produce a bright light for about a half hour.

use_action.msg: You strike your flare and light it.

data.name: active flare
data.description: This burning magnesium flare is producing light.  It will last for about a half hour before burning out.

data.name: heavy duty flashlight (off)
data.description: This is a heavy duty tubular aluminum LED flashlight as often used by security guards.  Makes for a passable melee weapon.  Using this flashlight will turn it on and provide light, assuming it is charged with batteries.

use_action.msg: You turn the heavy duty flashlight on.
use_action.need_charges_msg: The heavy duty flashlight's batteries are dead.

use_action.msg: You turn the heavy duty flashlight off.

data.name: acetylene lamp (off)
data.description: An antique brass lamp designed to run from a pressurized cylinder of acetylene.  It is an efficient, if not somewhat dangerous light source.

use_action.need_charges_msg: The %s must be attached to a gas cylinder to light.

data.name: inhaler
data.description: Albuterol inhaler.  Used in the treatment of bronchospasm, it is a lifeline for people with asthma.  A mild stimulant, it may cause nervousness or tremors.

data.name: radio car box
data.description: A RC car, with radio-control and batteries included!  Disassemble to unpack and enjoy.

data.name: RC control
data.description: A remote control for RC cars, with joystick to steer the car and colorful buttons that don't seem to do anything.  Perhaps they were for the deluxe model?

data.name: RC car
data.description: A remote-controlled car.  Fun for young and old alike.

data.name: RC car (on)
data.description: This remote-controlled car is on, and draining its batteries just like a real electric car!  Use a remote control to drive it around.

data.name: radio activation mod
data.description: This small piece of electronics can be attached to certain items and activate them after receiving a radio signal.

data.name: radio (off)
data.description: This is a portable radio.  Using this radio turns it on.  It will pick up any nearby signals being broadcast and play them audibly.

data.name: radio (on)
data.description: This portable radio is turned on, and continually draining its batteries.  It is playing the broadcast being sent from any nearby radio towers.

data.name: two-way radio
data.description: This is a radio with a transmitting unit.  You could use it to contact someone who also has one.  Unfortunately no one seems to use those nowadays...

data.name: remote vehicle controller
data.description: A remote controller for real cars.  Can turn onboard devices on and off.  Some cars can be driven remotely.

data.name: bottle jack
data.description: A portable hydraulic bottle jack used for lifting vehicles.

data.name: makeshift jack
data.description: A poorly constructed improvised scissor jack used for lifting vehicles if you're brave enough to use it.

data.name: scissor jack
data.description: A compact scissor jack used for lifting vehicles.

data.name: acetylene torch
data.description: A compact tool kit intended for welding and cutting metal, this portable oxyacetylene torch includes a torch handle and cutting attachment in an easy-to-carry tote.  It requires connecting to pressurized cylinders of an appropriate welding gas before use.  In addition to its metalworking uses, you can activate it in order to destroy metal barriers.

data.name: car alternator
data.description: A standard alternator used to power vehicle electrical systems.

data.name: motorbike alternator

data.name: truck alternator
data.description: A larger and more powerful alternator used to power vehicle electrical systems.

data.name: 7.5kW generator
data.description: An bulky but efficient electrical generator designed to be attached to an engine.

data.description: A large storage battery containg many lithium ion cells.  Could be installed into a storage battery case for easy removal from a vehicle, or just welded straight in.

data.name: steel boom
data.description: A large rigid steel boom.  If attached to a frame it could be used to lift up to 20 metric tonnes.

data.name: telescopic cantilever
data.description: A small steel telescoping cantilever.  If attached to a frame it could be used to lift up to 3.5 metric tonnes.

data.name: onboard chemistry lab
data.description: Assembled from a chemistry set attached to a complex wiring harness, it is well suited to most any chemistry project you could imagine.  Unable to utilize standard batteries, it requires an external supply of electricity to operate.

data.name: FOODCO kitchen buddy
data.description: Assembled from a set of instructions you found in an old book of DIY projects, the *FOODCO kitchen buddy* claims to be *the perfect solution to all your home-cooking needs!*.  While it is surprisingly handy for vacuum-sealing as well as dehydrating food, the cheery sales pitch neglected to mention A - how awkward the damn thing is, B - That you still need a normal kitchen and C - how it doesn't take batteries.  You're going to have to weld it to a vehicle, or something else with a supply of electricity, if you want to use it.  In addition to the food preservation features, it also has a food processor, a water-purification system, a drawer for holding extra tools, and for some insane reason, a press and die set for hand-loading ammunition.

data.name: vehicle forge rig
data.description: A forge rig made to run off a vehicle's storage battery with integrated tool storage for metalworking equipment.

data.name: RV kitchen unit
data.description: A vehicle mountable electric range and sink unit with integrated tool storage for cooking utensils.

data.name: vehicle welding rig
data.description: A welding rig made to run off a vehicle's storage battery.  It has a soldering iron attachment for delicate work, and a compartment to store your extra tools in.

data.description: A set of casters, like on a shopping cart.

data.name: metal wheel

data.name: motorbike wheel
data.description: A motorbike wheel.

data.name: large steel drum
data.description: A large cylinder fashioned out of thick plates of hardened steel, that is normally found on road rollers.  Numerous massive spokes, attached to a central axis, reinforce its structure even further, making it an unstoppable force once it starts rolling.
